title: 7. atha guṭikādhikārādhyāyaḥ
text: saptamo'dhyāyaḥ | vaṭakāścātha kathyante tannāma guṭikā vaṭī | modako vaṭikā piṇḍī guḍo vartistathocyate ||1|| lehavatsādhyate vahnau guḍo vā śarkarā tathā | guggulurvā kṣipettatra cūrṇaṃ tannirmitā vaṭī ||2|| kuryādavahnisiddhena kvacidguggulunā vaṭīm | draveṇa madhunā vāpi guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ ||3|| Dī. idānīṃ guṭikāḥ kathyante - vaṭakāśceti | atheti cūrṇakalpanānantaraṃ vaṭakā guṭikādisaṃjñāḥ ata eva tannāma guṭikāvaṭīprabhṛtayo jñātavyāḥ | tasya vaṭakasya nāma paryāyavācakāḥ śabdā yathā tannāmeti tasya vaṭakasya nāma paryāyavākyaṃ guṭikādikamityarthaḥ | atha teṣāṃ kartavyavidhimāha - lehavatsādhyata iti | yathāvalehārthaṃ guḍādikaṃ sādhyate tathaivā'tra guḍaḥ, śarkarā, guggulurvāpi paktavya:, pāke sati cūrṇaṃ prakṣipya vaṭakādīn kuryāditi bhāva: | pakṣāntaramāha - kvaciditi | na sarvatra avahnisiddhena kuṭṭitena guggulunā vaṭakāḥ kāryāḥ guḍādikenāpi kvaciditi saṃcārādvā, athavā draveṇa toyakṣīrādinā madhunā kṣaudreṇāpi saṃplāvya guṭikāṃ kārayet budhaḥ paṇḍitaḥ atrāpi vahniṃ vineti sambandhaḥ ||1-3 || Gū. atha guṭikādhikāraḥ || 1-3 || sitā caturguṇā deyā vaṭīṣu dviguṇo guḍaḥ | cūrṇāccūrṇasamaḥ kāryo guggulurmadhu tatsamam || 4 || dravaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ deyaṃ modakeṣu bhiṣagvaraiḥ | Dī. idānīmanukteṣu guḍaśarkarādīnāṃ mānamāha - siteti | sitā śarkarā caturguṇā deyā cūrṇādityarthaḥ | guḍo'tra dviguṇaḥ, atrā'pi cūrṇabhāgāditi bhāvaḥ | (gugguluśca cūrṇasamaḥ cūrṇabhāgasamāna ityarthaḥ | madhu tatsamamiti madhu kṣaudraṃ tatsamaṃ cūrṇasamaṃ dravyaṃ kṣīratoyādikaṃ dviguṇaṃ cūrṇabhāgādityarthaḥ) | cūrṇamatra sakaladravyāṇāṃ bhiṣagvarairiti grahaṇena svabuddhyā vā yathāyogyamavacārayediti sāṃpradāyikāḥ || 4 || karṣapramāṇaṃ tanmānaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā prayujyate || 5 || Dī. atha bhakṣaṇamānamanuktānāṃ darśayannāha - karṣapramāṇamiti | karṣapramāṇaṃ karṣamātraṃ tanmānamiti tat teṣāṃ vaṭakādīnāṃ mānaṃ parimāṇaṃ | balamiti dehabalaṃ doṣabalaṃ vyādhibalaṃ ca | balagrahaṇena karṣamānamatra sāmānyaṃ sūcitam | ata eva dṛṣṭvā vicāryetyarthaḥ | vicāraṇātra bālavṛddhānāmeva madhyānāṃ tu karṣamātraiva || 5 || atha śrībāhuśālo guḍaḥ arśādau - sa yathā - indravāruṇikā mustaṃ śuṇṭhī dantī harītakī | trivṛcchaṭhī viḍaṅgāni gokṣuraścitrakastathā || 6 || tejohvā ca dvikarṣāṇi pṛthagdravyāṇi kārayet | sūraṇasya palānyaṣṭau vṛddhadāru catuṣpalam ||7|| catuṣpalaṃ syādbhallātaḥ kvāthayetsarvamekataḥ | jaladroṇe caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhṇīyātkvāthamuttamam || 8 || kvāthyadravyāttriguṇitaṃ guḍaṃ kṣiptvā punaḥ pacet | samyakpakvaṃ ca taṃ jñātvā cūrṇametatpradāpayet ||9|| citrakatrivṛtādantītejohvā: palikāḥ pṛthak | pṛthaktripalikāḥ kāryā vyoṣailāmalakatvacaḥ ||10|| nikṣipenmadhu śīte ca tasminprasthapramāṇataḥ | evaṃ siddho bhavecchrīmānbāhuśālaguḍā'bhidhaḥ ||11|| jayedarśāṃsi sarvāṇi gulmaṃ vātodaraṃ tathā | āḍhyavātapratiśyāyaṃ mahāntaṃ kṣayapīnasam ||12|| halīmakaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ pramehaṃ ca rasāyanam | Dī. sa yatheti vacanaṃ guṭikāsamūhapratipādanārthamabhihitamācāryeṇa | tatrādau śrībāhuśālo nāma guḍastaṃ darśayannāha - indravāruṇiketi | ayaṃ bāhuśālaguḍo'rśovyādhau śastaḥ, tathendravāruṇikā cirbhaṭī tasyā mūlaṃ, dantī viṭapaviśeṣaḥ tasyāpi mūlaṃ; trivṛnniśothamūlameva, śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, tejohvā'tra cavyaṃ yatra ca tejohvā cavikā tatra tejohvā jyotiṣmatī evaṃ sarvatra | ( etatsarvaṃ pratyekaṃ dvikarṣaparimitaṃ bhavati | śūraṇasya palānyaṣṭāviti sūraṇaḥ kandaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasyāṣṭau palāni bhavanti; vṛddhadāru catuṣpalamiti niśothabhedaḥ tasya catuṣpalāni, bhallātamiti bhallātakaphalāni tāni catuṣpalamitāni bhavanti) etatsakalaṃ pānīyadroṇe saṃkvāthya caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhṇīyāt| jaladroṇamiti caturāḍhakaparimitaṃ jalaṃ tena ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaraśatadvayapalāni jalaparimāṇaṃ bhavati | u- ttamamiti vastragālitādikaṃ tenottamatā kvathitasyetyarthaḥ | caturthāṃśamityāḍhakamātraṃ kvāthyadravyāt triguṇitaṃ guḍa- miti guḍamatra jīrṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, kvāthyadravyāditi indravāruṇikāditejohvāntāt triguṇitaṃ tribhāgam etaduḍaṃ pāda- śeṣakāthe kṣiptvā punaḥ pacedyāvat sāndro bhavati | atra cūrṇamāha - citraketyādi | citrakaścitrakajaṭā, trivṛnniśothaḥ, dantī prasiddhā, tejohvā cavī etaddravyacatuṣṭayaṃ palapramāṇam, anyadapyāha - vyoṣailāmalakatvaca ityādi | vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tvak guḍatvak idamapi dravyaṣaṭkaṃ tripalapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ | śrībāhuśālo guḍa evaṃ siddho bhavati | bāhuśāla ācāryaviśeṣastena nirmito guḍaḥ vaṭakasaṃjña ityarthaḥ | āḍhyavāta ūrustambhabhedaḥ | mahāntaṃ prabalamityarthaḥ | rasāyana iti prabhāvāt | tadyathā “yajjarāvyādhividhvaṃsi bheṣajaṃ tadrasāyanam” iti || 6-12 || Gū. sa yathā sugamam | tejohvā tumburuḥ, kvāthāṃśadravyam indravāruṇikādyā tasmātriguṇaṃ guḍaṃ saṃpakve citrakādīni dāpayet | trivṛtā niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, tejohvā tumburuḥ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, elā sūkṣmā; maricaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ trikaṭumadhye grahaṇāt “ekamapyauṣadhaṃ yasmin yoge yatpunarucyate | mānato dviguṇaṃ jñeyam” ityuktatvāt | dviguṇaṃ maricakaṃ yadvā maricakaṅkolaṃ, tvak prasiddhaṃ, madhu prasthapramitaṃ prasthamānam, evaṃ prasiddhaḥ śrībāhuśālaguḍaḥ bāhuśālo nāma kaścit, tadarthaṃ praṇītatvāt bāhuśālaḥ śrīmān śrīkaratvāt spaṣṭamanyat | nanu ādau jvaraghnī guṭikā kathaṃ noktā rogagaṇanāyāṃ jvarasyaiva prādhānyāt ? ucyate ? asya rasāyanatvāt jvarādivyādhināśakatvaṃ samāgataṃ, “yajjarāvyādhividhvaṃsi bheṣajaṃ tadrasāyana”mityukteḥ | vyādhimātragrahaṇe jvarasyā'pi grahaṇāt | yadvā arśorogasyāpi jvarādivyādhisaṃjñakatvādādāvabhidhānaṃ kramābhāvādvyatikramābhidhānam || 6-12 || atha maricādiguṭikā kāsādau - maricaṃ karṣamātraṃ syātpippalī karṣasaṃmitā || 13 || ardhakarṣo yavakṣāraḥ karṣayugmaṃ ca dāḍimam | etaccūrṇīkṛtaṃ yuñjyādaṣṭakarṣaguḍena hi ||14|| śāṇapramāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ kṛtvā vaktreṇa dhārayet | asyā: prabhāvātsarve'pi kāsā yāntyeva saṃkṣayam ||15|| Dī. idānīṃ maricādiguṭikāṃ darśayannāha - maricamiti | asyā maricādikāyā vaṭikāyāḥ prabhāvādacintyaśaktiḥ | sarve kāsā iti pañcaprakārāḥ | atra dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalabījāni karṣayugmamiti karṣadvayaṃ vakre dhārayediti, atra vakradhāraṇādidamauṣadhaṃ dhūmarūpamityāhureke, cakreṇa tu svasaṃgrahe bhakṣaṇacūrṇadvayaṃ vakre dhārayediti prastāve likhitaṃ vaidyaprasārake'pi || śvāsakāsādau guḍavaṭikā | guḍaśuṇṭhīśivāmustairguṭikāṃ dhārayenmukhe | śvāsakāseṣu sarveṣu bibhītaṃ vāpi kevalam ||16|| Dī. ( guṭikāsvarūpabhakṣaṇamasyoktam, etadabhiprāyeṇātra likhitaṃ | guḍaśuṇṭhīti spaṣṭam) ||13-16|| āmalakyādiguṭikā tṛṣṇādau - āmalaṃ kamalaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lājāśca vaṭarohakaḥ | etaccūrṇasya madhunā guṭikāṃ dhārayenmukhe ||17|| tṛṣṇā pravṛddhāṃ hantyeṣā mukhaśoṣaṃ ca dāruṇam | Dī. athāmalakyādiguṭikāmāha - āmalamiti | āmalamāmalakaphalaṃ kamalamutpalaṃ tadabhāve kamalabījāni grāhyāṇi, lājāḥ bhṛṣṭadhānyodbhavāḥ, vaṭarohaka iti vaṭavṛkṣaprarohaḥ sa ca vaṭarohaśabdavācya:, madhvatra guṭikākaraṇamānaṃ paribhāṣoktam, dhārayenmukha iti | etena yathā yathā guṭikā dravati tathā tathā śīlanīyā punarimāṃ sahasaivābhyavaharediti dṛṣṭaparicayaḥ | pravṛddhāmiti kairapi yogairanivāryām | mukhaśoṣaṃ ca dāruṇamiti dāruṇaṃ duḥkhakaramasādhyamityarthaḥ || 17 || Gū. āmalam āmalakaṃ, kamalaṃ kamalapatraṃ phalaṃ vā, kuṣṭhaṃ prasiddhaṃ, lājā dhānyajā, vaṭarohakaṃ vaṭārohaḥ, kuṣṭhā'bhāve drākṣā vā deyā kuṣṭhasyātīvoṣṇatvāt ||17 || atha jvare sañjīvanīvaṭī tridoṣe ca - viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kṛṣṇā pathyāmalabibhītakam ||18|| vacā guḍūcī bhallātaṃ sadviṣaṃ cātra yojayet | etāni samabhāgāni gomūtreṇaiva peṣayet||19|| guñjābhā guṭikā kāryā dadyādārdrakajai rasaiḥ | ekāmajīrṇagulmeṣu dve viṣūcyāṃ pradāpayet ||20|| tisraśca sarpadaṣṭe tu catasraḥ sāṃnipātike | vaṭī saṃjīvanī nāmnā saṃjīvayati mānavam ||2 1|| Dī. atha sañjīvanīguṭikāṃ darśayannāha - viḍaṅgamiti | atra nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, pathyā harītakī, āmalamāmalakaphalaṃ, bhallātaṃ bhallātakaphalaṃ, sadviṣamiti śuddhaṃ viṣaṃ eteṣāṃ samānamātrā boddhavyā | gomūtramatra guṭikārdhaparimitaṃ | guñjābhā guñjāparimāṇā vaṭī kāryā, ārdrakaraso'trānupānaṃ, ajīrṇagulmayorekaikāvaṭī deyā, visūcyāṃ dve vaṭyau, sarpadaṣṭe tisro guṭikāḥ, sannipāte catasra iti nāmnā kṛtvā sañjīvanī kathitā yato'syāḥ prabhāvānmānavo yadā mumūrṣustadā jīvatīti | vicāraṇātra na kāryā, “avicintyo hi maṇimantrauṣadhīnāṃ prabhāvaḥ” iti vacanāt ||18-21 || Gū. nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, pathyā harītakī, āmalakaṃ, bibhītakam akṣa:; bhallātakaṃ prasiddhaṃ | tadabhāve bākucirdeyā, sadviṣam uttamaṃ viṣaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 18-21 || atha vyoṣādiguṭikā pīnasādau - vyoṣāmlavetasaṃ cavyaṃ tālīsaṃ citrakaṃ tathā | jīrakaṃ tintiḍīkaṃ ca pratyekaṃ karṣabhāgikam || 22 || trisugandhaṃ triśāṇaṃ syādguḍaḥ syātkarṣaviṃśatiḥ | vyoṣādiguṭikā seyaṃ pīnasaśvāsakāsajit ||23|| rucisvarakarī khyātā pratiśyāyapraṇāśinī | Dī. idānīṃ vyoṣādiguṭikāmāha - vyoṣeti | vyoṣamatra trikaṭukam, amlavetasaḥ prasiddhaḥ, cavyaṃ loke cāvaśabdavācyaṃ, tālīsaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, tintiḍīkamityamlaphaladravyaṃ, trisugandhaṃ triśāṇamiti | elā-tvak-patrakaṃ, tacca militaṃ trikaṃ na tu pratyekaṃ, vyoṣādi tintiḍīkāntaṃ dravyaṃ ca pratyekaṃ karṣamātramityarthaḥ | guḍaḥ syāt karṣaviṃśatiriti | guḍo'tra purātano grāhyaḥ | karṣaviṃśatiriti pañcapalāni tena sakaladravyāddviguṇito guḍa ityarthaḥ, tathāhi - ‘vyoṣacitrakatālīsatintiḍīkāmlavetasam | sa cavyājājitulyāṃśamelātvakpatrapādikam | vyoṣādikamidaṃ cūrṇaṃ purāṇaguḍasaṃyutam’ iti ||22||23|| Gū. vyoṣa trikaṭu; amlo'mlavetastasya cukraṃ vā rasaṃ vā deyaṃ, trisugandhaṃ tvak-tvaja-elā etat triśāṇam pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat || 22 || 23 || atha guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikā āmādau - āmeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīmajīrṇe guḍapippalīm ||24|| kṛcchre jīraguḍaṃ dadyādarśaḥsu saguḍābhayām | Dī. atha guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikāṃ vyācaṣṭe - āmeṣviti | guḍacatuṣṭayaguṭikā iti ko'rthaḥ ? guḍena saha catvāro yogāḥ kathitā ityarthaḥ | tadyathā āmeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīmityeko yogaḥ, āmeṣu āmadoṣeṣu saguḍāmityatra guḍadvaiguṇyam evaṃ yogacatuṣṭayeṣu boddhavyam; ajīrṇe guḍapippalīmiti dvitīyaḥ, ajīrṇe viṣṭabdike, kṛcchre jīrakaguḍaṃ dadyāditi tṛtīyo yogaḥ, kṛcchre matrakṛcchre; arśaḥsu ca saguḍābhayāmiti caturtho yoga iti || 24 || Gū. āmeṣu āmarogeṣu saguḍāṃ śuṇṭhīṃ dadyāt | vaṭīṃ tulyaguḍāṃ kṛtvā ajīrṇe ṣaḍvidhājīrṇe guḍapippalīṃ dadyāt; kṛcchre mūtrakṛcchre jīraguḍaṃ jīraṃ śvetajīrakam; arśaḥsu guḍābhayāṃ guḍayuktām abhayāṃ harītakīm ||24|| atha vṛddhadārumodakaḥ - vṛddhadārukabhallātaśuṇṭhīcūrṇena yojitaḥ || 25 || modakaḥ saguḍo hanyātṣaḍvidhārśaḥkṛtāṃ rujam | Dī. idānīṃ vṛddhadārukamodakamāha - vṛddhādāruketi vṛddhadāruko vikhyātaḥ tadabhāve niśothā grāhyā yato'syā bhedo vṛddhadāraka iti | eteṣāṃ dravyatrayāṇāṃ cūrṇa samamātramāhuḥ | saguḍa ityatra modakatvena guḍo dviguṇito jñeyaḥ | kecittu nādriyante yatastatra catuḥsamagrahaṇena sama eva guḍo yujyate sāmyenā'pi kiñciddravaṃ datvā agnau modakāḥ kāryāḥ | rujamiti pīḍām || 25 || Gū. vṛddhadārukaḥ prasiddhaḥ, bhallātakaḥ pratiddhaḥ, tadasahane raktacandanaṃ deyam | ayaṃ modakaḥ ṣahidhārśaḥkṛtāṃ rujāṃ hanyāt || 25 || atha sūraṇapiṇḍī arśoroge - śuṣkasūraṇacūrṇasya bhāgāndvātriṃśadāharet || 26|| bhāgānṣoḍaśa citrasya śuṇṭhyā bhāgacatuṣṭayam | dvau bhāgau maricasyāpi sarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet || 27 || guḍena piṇḍikāṃ kuryādarśasāṃ nāśanīṃ parām | Dī. atha sūraṇapiṇḍīmāha - śuṣkasūraṇeti | sūraṇaḥ kandaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, sa ca śuṣkaḥ kṛtvā cūrṇaṃ kāryaṃ, dvātriṃśadbhāgāḥ pañcadvayabhāgāḥ sūraṇasyetyarthaḥ | citrakasya citrakamūlasya tvacaḥ ṣoḍaśabhāgāḥ, śuṭhyāścatvāro bhāgāḥ, maricasya dvau bhāgau guḍena piṇḍikāṃ kuryāditi sakaladravyadviguṇitenetyarthaḥ | arśasāmiti bahuvacanatvena ṣaḍvidhatvamityarthaḥ | parāmityanena viśiṣṭatvamasyā darśitam || 26 || 27 || Gū. citrasya citrakasya | spaṣṭamanyat||26||27|| sūraṇavaṭakāḥ | sūraṇo vṛddhadāruśca bhāgaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛthak || 28 || muśalīcitrakau jñeyāvaṣṭabhāgamitau pṛthak | śivā bibhītakī dhātrī viḍaṅgaṃ nāgaraṃ kaṇā ||29|| bhallātaḥ pippalīmūlaṃ tālīsaṃ ca pṛthakpṛthak | caturbhāgapramāṇāni tvagelā maricaṃ tathā ||30|| dvibhāgamātrāṇi pṛthaktatastvekatra cūrṇayet | dviguṇena guḍenātha vaṭakānkārayedbudhaḥ || 31|| prabalāgnikarā ete tathārśonāśanāḥ parāḥ | grahaṇīṃ vātakaphajāṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ kṣayāmayam ||32|| plīhānaṃ ślīpadaṃ śothaṃ pramehaṃ ca bhagandaram | nihānyu: palitaṃ vṛdhyāstathā medhyā rasāyanā: ||33|| Dī. atha sūraṇavaṭakānāha sūraṇa iti| sūraṇa: śuṣkasūraṇacūrṇaṃ tacca ṣoḍaśakarṣapramāṇaṃ, vṛddhadāruko'pyevaṃ, muśalī tālamūlī, loke mūśarīśabdavācyā, sāṣṭakarṣamiti bhavati, citrakajaṭācūrṇamapyevameva, śivāditālīsāntaṃ navadravyaṃ pratyekaṃ catuḥkarṣamitam | tatra śivā harītakī, dhātrī āmalakī, kaṇā pippalī, bhallāta: bhallātakaphalāni, tālīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tvagelāmaricamapi dvikarṣamātraṃ pratyekaṃ | tenaiva cūrṇayedityanena cūrṇoktavidhinā cūrṇayedityarthaḥ | dviguṇena guḍeneti sakalacūrṇadravyāt guḍo dviguṇito grāhyaḥ | grahaṇīṃ vātakaphajāmiti vātajāṃ kaphajāṃ (vātakaphajāṃ vā, kṣayāmayaṃ kṣayarogaṃ, palitaṃ vārdhakyaṃ vṛddhyā eke vṛddhyeti sthāne vṛṣyeti paṭhanti) vyākhyānayanti ca medhyā iti | buddhipradāḥ rasāyanā iti jarāvyādhividhvaṃsakāḥ || 28-33 || Gū. arśoroge (sūraṇavaṭakānāha - ) śivā harītakī, dhātrī āmalakī, tvak tajaḥ || 28-33 || maṇḍūravaṭakāḥ kāmalādau - triphalā tryūṣaṇaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau | dāru mākṣikadhātuśca dārvī mustaṃ viḍaṅgakam || 34 || pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi sarvadviguṇitaṃ tathā | maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayecchuddhaṃ gomūtre'ṣṭaguṇe kṣipet || 35 || paktvā ca vaṭakānkṛtvā dadyāttakrānupānataḥ | kāmalāpāṇḍumehārśaḥśothakuṣṭhakaphāmayān ||36 || ūrustambhamajīrṇaṃ ca plīhānaṃ nāśayedapi | Dī. idānīṃ maṇḍūravaṭakānāha - triphaleti | triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, dāru devadāru, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, dārvī dāruharidrā, eke ‘dārumākṣikadhātustvag dārvyā mustaṃ viḍaṅgakam’ iti paṭhanti tatra dāruharidrāyāstvageva grāhyā śreṣṭhatvāt, kāṣṭhaṃ tvagabhāve gṛhyate, na tu tvakśabdena guḍatvak grāhyā; yatastantrāntare caturdaśadravyaṃ militaṃ | sarvadviguṇitaṃ tatheti maṇḍūramityanena saṃbadhyate | samānamilitāt sakaladravyacūrṇāt maṇḍūracūrṇaṃ dviguṇaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | maṇḍūraṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ, lohamalamityarthaḥ | yadvā purāṇamaṇḍūramiti vikhyātaṃ guṇādhikyāt | tathāhi ‘śatotthamuttamaṃ kiṭṭaṃ madhyaṃ cāśītivārṣikam | adhamaṃ ṣaṣṭivārṣīyaṃ tato hīnaṃ viṣopamaṃ’ iti | kecit lohakiṭṭāt pṛthak pārthivadravyaṃ maṇḍūramiti vadanti (śuddhamiti maṇḍūramityarthaḥ | ‘maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇitaṃ śuddham’ iti vacanāt| atra cūrṇamañjanasadṛśaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ etādṛśameva śreṣṭhaṃ bhavati) śuddhamiti dhmāyanena saptadhā gomūtre nirvāpaṇādinā śuddhiḥ, ata evoktaṃ tantrāntare - ‘nirvāpitaṃ hi gomūtre maṇḍūraṃ grāhyamiṣyate’ iti | kartavyatāsya maṇḍūracūrṇameva pṛthaggomūtre paktavyam āsannapāke ca tasmin triphalādicūrṇaprakṣepaḥ yataḥ cūrṇānāṃ pāko nāstīti (atrārthe kvacit ślokaḥ ‘prāyo na pākaścūrṇānāṃ bhūricūrṇasya tena hi | āsannapāke prakṣepaḥ svalpasya pākamāgate’ | pākalakṣaṇamapi prasaṅgato likhyate yathā - ‘rāgo gandhaḥ śubhaḥ pāke vartiḥ syādgāḍhapīḍanāt’ iti | aṣṭaguṇe gomūtre iti mūtraṃ tu maṇḍūrādaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavati | tathāhi ‘grāhyaṃ tvaṣṭaguṇaṃ mūtraṃ śuddhamaṇḍūracūrṇataḥ’ iti | eke ‘maṇḍūraṃ cūrṇayet sarvaṃ gomūtre'ṣṭaguṇe kṣipet’ tatra sakaladravyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ gomūtraṃ grāhyam iti paṭhanti, etadasaṅgatam, ayaṃ pāṭho bahupustakeṣu na dṛṣṭatvāt | kaphāmayāniti kṣayakāsaprabhṛtīn || 34-36 || Gū. triphalā, tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, dāru devadāru:, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddhā nirvamanā māritā ca deyā, maṇḍūraṃ mṛtaṃ purātanaṃ lohakiṭṭaṃ sarvato'ṣṭaguṇaṃ gomūtraṃ datvā pacet | takreṇa ca deyam ||34-36|| dhātugatajvarādau pippalīmodakaḥ - (kṣaudrāddviguṇitaṃ sarpirghṛtāddviguṇapippalī || 37 || sitā dviguṇitā tasyāḥ kṣīraṃ deyaṃ caturguṇam | cāturjātaṃ kṣaudratulyaṃ paktvā kuryācca modakān ||38|| dhātusthāṃśca jvarānsarvān vāsaṃ kāsaṃ ca pāṇḍutām | dhātukṣayaṃ vahnimāndyaṃ pippalīmodako jayet ||39||) atha candraprabhāgugguluḥ pramehādau - candraprabhā vacā mustaṃ bhūnimbāmṛtadārukam | haridrātiviṣā dārvī pippalīmūlacitrakau ||40|| dhānyakaṃ triphalā cavyaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī | vyoṣaṃ mākṣikadhātuśca dvau kṣārau lavaṇatrayam ||41|| etāni śāṇamātrāṇi pratyekaṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | trivṛddantīpatrakaṃ ca tvagelā vaṃśarocanā ||42|| pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi kuryādetāni buddhimān | dvikarṣaṃ hatalohaṃ syāccatuṣkarṣā sitā bhavet ||43|| śilājatvaṣṭakarṣaṃ syādaṣṭau karṣāśca gugguloḥ | ebhirekatra saṃkṣuṇṇaiḥ kartavyā guṭikā śubhā ||44 || candraprabhādivikhyātā sarvarogapraṇāśinī | pramehānviṃśatiṃ kṛcchraṃ mūtrāghātaṃ tathāśmarīm ||45|| vibandhā''nāhaśūlāni mehanaṃ granthimarbudam | antravṛddhiṃ kaṭīśūlaṃ śvāsaṃ kāsaṃ vicarcikām ||46|| aṇḍavṛddhiṃ tathā pāṇḍuṃ kāmalāṃ ca halīmakam | kuṣṭhānyarśāṃsi kaṇḍūṃ ca plīhodarabhagandaram ||47|| dantarogaṃ netrarogaṃ strīṇāmārtavajāṃ rujam | puṃsāṃ śukragatān doṣān mandāgnimaruciṃ tathā || 48 || vāyuṃ pittaṃ kaphaṃ hanyādbalyā vṛṣyā rasāyanī | candraprabhāyāṃ karṣastu catuḥśāṇo vidhīyate || 49 || Dī. idānīṃ candraprabhāguṭikāṃ darśayannāha - candraprabhetyādi | candraprabhā karpūraḥ, eke candraprabhāśabdena śaṭhīṃ śatāvarīṃ vā kathayanti saṃjñāśabdatvāt | bhūnimbaḥ kairātaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī, dārukaṃ devadāru, kvacidbhūnimbāmaradārukamiti pāṭho dṛṣṭaḥ | tatrāmaradāru devadrāru, dārvī dāruharidrā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikam, dvau kṣārāviti svarjikākṣārayavakṣārau, lavaṇatrayamiti saindhavaṃ sauvarcalaṃ viḍam iti lavaṇatrayaṃ trivṛnniśothaḥ, dantīti dantīmūlatvak, tadabhāve dantībījānyapi manāg deyāni iti kasmiṃścit sampradāye na sarvatra | hatalohaṃ samyaṅmṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, śilājatu prasiddhaṃ, taccātra śuddhaṃ grāhyaṃ, śuddhirasyānyatroktā jñātavyā vistareṇa | śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ subodham | mātrāpi caiteṣāṃ vyastā subodhā jñātavyā | candraprabhādivikhyāteti candraprabheyaṃ vaṭī ādivikhyātā pūrvaṃ prasiddhetyarthaḥ, candraprabhevetyarthaḥ | asyāḥ satatābhyāsāccandrasyeva prabhā kāntirbhavatīti, yadvā candraprabhā nāma dravyamādiryasyāḥ | sarvarogamityavaśiṣṭaṃ rogajātamuktarogasamūhāt, tamapi nāśayituṃ yogyā bhavatīti bhāvaḥ | kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, vibandho vātādīnāmapravṛttiḥ, ānāha udarāpūraḥ, mehanamiti grahaṇenaivopadaṃśaśūkadoṣādayo'bhidhīyante, balyā balakarī, vṛṣyā śukravṛddhikarī, rasāyanī jarāvyādhivināśinītyanena paunaruktyena prabhāvotkṛṣṭatvamasyā darśitaṃ | “candraprabhāyāṃ karṣastu catuḥśāṇo vidhīyate’ iti pādadvayaṃ kṣepakamāmananti kecit ||40-49 || Gū. candraprabhā karpūraḥ, candravatprabhā yasyeti vyutpattyā, yadvā candraprabhā gandhālikākhyakarpūrabhedaḥ tathānvayavṛttyā| ‘pathye gandhālikā gandhavadhū: pṛthupalāśikā | śaṭhī sagandhacaṇḍā syātsomabhā somasaṃbhavā’,amaradāru devadāru, dārvī dāruharidrā, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭu, mākṣikadhātuḥ svarṇamākṣikaṃ śuddhaṃ māritaṃ ca, etāni pratyekaṃ śāṇamātrāṇi ṭaṅkamātrāṇi | trivṛt niḥsṛtāṃ, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, patrakaṃ tajaḥ, elā, vaṃśalocanā, etāni pratyekaṃ karṣamātrāṇi | hatalohaṃ mṛtalohaṃ dvikarṣaṃ, sitā sitopalā catuḥkarṣā, śilājatusatvam aṣṭakarṣāṇi, guggulurdaśakarṣaḥ evamekatrīkṛtaḥ candraprabhā bhavati | iyaṃ candraprabhāditvāt candraprabhāguṭikā | kecittu evaṃ vyākhyānayanti candravatprabhā yasyāsau candraprabho gugguluḥ sa tu ādau viḍaṅgamadhikṛtya likhitastathāpi candraprabhānāmnā candraprasādena prāptā, sā vaṅgasenādibhiḥ pramehādhikāre likhitā | tathāca ‘krimiripudahanavyoṣatriphalāmaradārucavyabhūnimbaṃ | māgadhimūlaṃ mustaṃ śaṭhī vacādhātumākṣike caiva’ ityādi || 40-49 || atha kāṅkāyanaguṭikā gulmādau - yamānī jīrakaṃ dhānyaṃ maricaṃ girikarṇikā | ajamodopakuñcī ca catuḥśāṇāḥ pṛthakpūthak ||50|| hiṅgu ṣaṭśāṇikaṃ kāryaṃ kṣārau lavaṇapañcakam | trivṛccāṣṭamitaiḥ śāṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ kalpayetsudhīḥ ||51|| dantī śaṭhī pauṣkaraṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ dāḍimaṃ śivā | citro'mlavetasaḥ śuṇṭhī śāṇaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ pṛthak ||52|| bījapūrarasenaiṣāṃ guṭikāṃ kārayedbudhaḥ | ghṛtena payasā madyairamlairuṣṇodakena vā || 53 || pibetkāṅkāyanaproktāṃ guṭikāṃ gulmanāśinīm | madyena vātikaṃ gulmaṃ gokṣīreṇa ca paittikam ||54|| mūtreṇa kaphagulmaṃ ca daśamūlaistridoṣajam | uṣṭrīdugdhena nārīṇāṃ raktagulmaṃ vināśayet ||55|| hṛdrogaṃ grahaṇīṃ śūlaṃ krimīnarśāṃsi nāśayet | Dī. atha kāṅkāyanaguṭikāvivaraṇamāha - yamānīti | atra girikarṇikā ‘gaṇiyārī’ śabdavācyā, loke ‘isphanda’ iti prasiddhā, upakuñcī kṛṣṇajīrakaḥ, hiṃgvatra bharjitaṃ deyaṃ, kṣārāviti yavakṣāraḥ svarjikākṣāraśca, lavaṇapañcakaṃ prasiddhaṃ, trivṛnniśothaḥ, dantī prasiddhā, śaṭhī karcūrabhedaḥ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ tadabhāve kuṣṭhameva, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimabījaṃ, śivātra harītakī, citraścitrakajaṭā eteṣām uktamānatulitānāṃ cūrṇaṃ kṛtvā guṭikākaraṇārthaparimitena bījapūrarasenāplāvya modakāḥ kāryāḥ | ghṛtādyanupānaṃ sāmānyamuktvā viśeṣānumānaṃ madyādikaṃ yaduktaṃ tadviśiṣṭaroganivṛttyartham iti na doṣaḥ paunaruktyā | mūtramatra gomūtraṃ, daśamūlairiti kvathitadaśamūlajalaiḥ | kāṅkāyanaproktāmiti kāṅkāyanācāryeṇa proktāṃ kathitāṃ guṭikāmityarthaḥ | tantrāntare guṭikeyamarśovināśinī vihitā | tathāhi - ‘kāṅkāyanena śiṣyebhyaḥ śastrakṣārāgnibhirvinā | kathito vaṭako hyeṣa gudajānāṃ vināśanaḥ’ iti ||50-55|| Gū. girikarṇikā aparājitā, upakuñcī kalañjikā, dvau kṣārau svarjitayavakṣārau, trivṛditi niḥsṛtā, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, śivā harītakī, citraścitrakaḥ, amlo'mlavetasastasya cukraṃ vā raso vā, ṣoḍaśaśāṇaṃ | kāṅkāyano munistatproktāṃ guṭikāṃ, spaṣṭamanyat ||50-55|| athaṃ yogarājaguggulurvātaroge āmavāte vā - nāgaraṃ pippalī cavyaṃ pippalīmūlacitrakau ||56|| mṛṣṭaṃ hiṅgvajamodā ca sarṣapo jīrakadvayam | reṇukendrayavāḥ pāṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī || 57 || kaṭukātiviṣā bhārṅgī vacāmūrve tribhāgataḥ | pratyekaṃ śāṇakāni syurdravyāṇīmāni viṃśatiḥ ||58|| dravyebhyaḥ sakalebhyaśca triphalā dviguṇā bhavet | ebhiścūrṇīkṛtaiḥ sarvaiḥ samo deyaśca gugguluḥ || 59 || (vaṅgaṃ raupyaṃ ca nāgaṃ ca lohasārastathābhrakam | maṇḍūraṃ rasasindūraṃ pratyekaṃ palasaṃmitam ||60|| guḍapākasamaṃ kṛtvā imaṃ dadyādyathocitam| ekapiṇḍaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dhārayedghṛtabhājane ||61|| guṭikāḥ śāṇamātrāstu kṛtvā grāhyā yathocitāḥ | gugguluryogarājo'yaṃ tridoṣaghno rasāyanaḥ || 62 || maithunāhārapānānāṃ tyāgo naivātra vidyate | sarvānvātāmayānkuṣṭhānarśāṃsi grahaṇīgadam || 63 || pramehaṃ vātaraktaṃ ca nābhiśūlaṃ bhagandaram | udāvartaṃ kṣayaṃ gulmamapasmāramurograham || 64 || mandāgniṃ śvāsakāsaṃ ca nāśayedaruciṃ tathā | retodoṣaharaḥ puṃsāṃ rajodoṣaharaḥ striyām || 65 || puṃsāmapatyajanako vandhyānāṃ garbhadastathā | rāsnādikvāthasaṃyukto vividhaṃ hanti mārutam ||66|| kāṅkolyādiśṛtātpittaṃ kaphamāragvadhādinā | dārvīśṛtena mehāṃśca gomūtreṇa ca pāṇḍutām || 67|| medovṛddhiṃ ca madhunā kuṣṭhaṃ nimbaśṛtena ca | chinnākvāthena vātāsraṃ śothaṃ śūlaṃ kaṇā śṛtāt||68|| pāṭalākvāthasahito viṣaṃ mūṣakajaṃ jayet | triphalākvāthasahito netrārtiṃ hanti dāruṇām|| 69|| punarnavādikvāthena hanyātsarvodarāṇyapi | Dī. atha yogarājagugguluvaṭakamāha - nāgaramiti | nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, hiṃgvajamodeti bhṛṣṭaṃ bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ utkledabhayāt, ( yataḥ ‘cūrṇeṣu bharjitaṃ hiṅgu deyaṃ notkledakṛdbhavet ’ iti ) | ajamodā'tra yamānī grāhyā, antaḥparimārjanatvāt, jīrakadvayamiti śvetakṛṣṇabhedena vihitaṃ, reṇukā prasiddhā, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, śeṣaṃ prasiddham, etadviṃśatisaṃkhyākaṃ dravyagaṇaṃ viṃśatiśāṇatulitamityarthaḥ | pratyekaṃ ṭaṅkamitamāhuḥ | sakaladravyebhyastu triphalācūrṇaṃ dviguṇitaṃ deyam, tacca catvāriṃśat śāṇamitamityarthaḥ | triphalā'pyatra samamātrā boddhavyā gaṇanāyāṃ tulanāyāṃ vā sāmyatvamasyāḥ, sarvasamo guggulurdeya iti | tena ṣaṣṭiśāṇamito guggulurbhavati | ekapiṇḍamityādi vākyenāsya karaṇārthaṃ yāvat piṇḍībhūtaṃ syāt tāvatparimāṇena ghṛtaṃ grāhyamiti vṛddhānāṃ vyavahāro'sti | piṇḍamatra kuṭṭananirghātādinā , tata eva ghṛtabhājane dhārayet | atisnigdhatvāt | guṭikāḥ śāṇamātrāstviti | yadyapi śāṇaparimitā guṭikā bhavati tathāpi bhakṣaṇavidhau yathocitā grāhyā, tena doṣādikaṃ vīkṣya deyā iti tātparyārthaḥ | tathāhyuktaṃ - ‘catvāro māṣakā hīne madhye tvaṣṭau ca māṣakāḥ | śreṣṭhe dvādaśakāḥ proktāḥ koṣṭhaṃ vijñāya tattridhā’ iti | yadvā śodhanārthaṃ ca gugguloḥ karṣaḥ śamanārthe tu māṣacatuṣṭayamiti vyavahāraḥ | maithunāhārapānānāmityādi asyābhyāse maithunādayo na tyājyāḥ maithunaṃ strīsevā, eke maithunāhārapānābhyāṃ prayojanaṃ cātra vidyāditi paṭhanti | etat saṅgataṃ; tena maithunādayo bāhulyamātraṃ bhavantītyarthaḥ | kiṃtu ucyate yataḥ ‘kṣārāmlarasayūṣāktaṃ doṣadhātvavalocitam | bubhukṣito mātrapānamadyādguggulusevakaḥ’ ityādivacanāt ucitaṃ yathā maithunamapi| tathāhi - ‘seveta kāmataḥ kāmaṃ tṛpto vājīkṛtairhime | tryahādvasaṃtaśaradoḥ pakṣādvṛṣṭinidāghayoḥ || prakāmaṃ ca niṣeveta maithunaṃ śiśirāgame | śīte rātrau divā grīṣme prāvṛṭvarjitavarṣaṇe || vasante ca divā rātrau nā smaret śaradi smaram’ iti | asyānupānaviśeṣamāha - rāsnādikvāthasaṃyukta ityādi | rāsnādikvātha: kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kathitaḥ sa ca bṛhadrāsnādirlaghurvā kāṅkolyādicūrṇakalpanāyāṃ jñātavyaḥ, tacca jīvanīyādigaṇasaṃjñam, asya śṛtena kvāthenetyarthaḥ | āragvadhādineti āragvadhādigaṇakvāthenetyarthaḥ | ayamapi kvāthakalpanāyām uktaḥ | dārvīśṛteneti | dārvī dāruharidrā tasyāḥ śṛtena kvāthena | gomūtreṇa ca pāṇḍutāmiti atra ājaṃ vā mūtraṃ praśastaṃ vyavahārāt | madhunā kṣaudreṇa, nimbaśṛteneti nimbakvāthenetyarthaḥ | chinnā guḍūcī tasyāḥ kvāthena | pāṭalā prasiddhā tasyā mūlatvak grāhyā, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ punarnavādikvāthaḥ kvāthakalpanāyāṃ prasiddhaḥ || 56-69 || Gū. nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, tadādiviṃśatidravyāṇi śāṇamātrāṇi, sarvebhyastriphalā dviguṇā catvāriṃśat ṭaṅkamitā pratyekaṃ trayodaśaṭaṅkagugguluḥ sarvaiḥ samaḥ ṣaṣṭiṭaṅkamitaḥ cūrṇīkṛtya gugguluḥ kavakākhyaḥ ghṛtena saṃkuṭya guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ | śāṇamitaṃ bhakṣayet | kecit gugguluṃ vātaharadravyairdaśamūlādibhirutkvāthya vastrapūtaṃ kṛtvā kṣipanti | tathāca ‘gandhavarṇarasopeto guggulurmātrayā punaḥ| bhaiṣajyaiḥ sahitaḥ kvāthyo yathā vyādhiharaḥ pṛthak || mātrāvaśiṣṭaṃ taṃ jñātvā gālayet śuṣkavāsasā | athavā mardayet kvāthe yaduṣṇe sādhusādhite || mṛṇmaye hemapātre vā rājate sphāṭikepi vā’ | iti gugguluśodhanaṃ guggulukalpāt || 56-69 || atha kaiśoraguggulurvātaraktādau - triphalāyāstrayaḥ prasthāḥ prasthaikā cāmṛtā bhavet||70|| saṃkuṭya lohapātreṇa sārdhadroṇāmbunā pacet | jalamardhaśṛtaṃ jñātvā gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam || 71 || tataḥ kvāthe kṣipecchuddhaṃ gugguluṃ prasthasaṃmitam | punaḥ pacedayaḥpātre darvyā saṃgharṣayenmuhuḥ || 72 || sāndrībhūtaṃ tato jñātvā guḍapākasamākṛtim | cūrṇīkṛtya tatastatra dravyāṇīmāni nikṣipet || 73 || triphalā dvipalā jñeyā guḍūcī palikā matā| ṣaḍakṣaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ pnoktaṃ viḍaṅgānāṃ palārdhakam || 74 || dantī karṣamitā kāryā trivṛtkarṣamitā smṛtā | tataḥ piṇḍīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ ghṛtapātre vinikṣipet || 75 || guṭikāḥ śāṇamātreṇa yuñjyāddoṣādyapekṣayā | anupāne bhiṣagdadyātkoṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payo'thavā || 76 || mañjiṣṭhādiśṛtaṃ vāpi yuktiyuktamutāparam | jayetsarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni vātaraktaṃ tridoṣajam || 77 || sarvavraṇāni gulmāni pramehapiḍikāstathā | pramehodaramandāgnikāsaśvayathupāṇḍujān || 78 || hanti sarvāmayānnityamupayukto rasāyanaḥ | kaiśorakābhidhāno'yaṃ gugguluḥ kāntikārakaḥ ||79|| vāsādinā netragadāngulmādīnvaruṇādinā | kvāthena khadirasyāpi vraṇakuṣṭhāni nāśayet || 80 || amlaṃ tīkṣṇamajīrṇaṃ ca vyāyāmaṃ śramamātapam | madyaṃ roṣaṃ tyajetsamyagguṇārthī purasevakaḥ || 81 || Dī. adhunā kaiśoragugguluvaṭakānāha - triphalāyā ityādi | sammilitatrayasya traya eva prasthāḥ tena dvādaśakuḍavā ityarthaḥ | prasthaikā cāmṛtā bhavet iti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyāḥ prasthaikaṃ, eke ‘dviprasthamamṛtā bhavet’ iti paṭhanti | ayamapi pāṭhaḥ pracarati ādṛtatvāt granthāntaradarśanādvā | tathāca ‘dvātriṃśacchinnaruhāyāḥ phalāni deyāni yatnata’ iti| saṃkuṭyeti triphalāguḍūcīmityarthaḥ | droṇāmbunā pacediti etaddravyaṃ caturāḍhakaparimitena jalena sārdhaṃ paripacediti | kvāthavidhānena kvāthārdhāvaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ vastragālitaṃ gṛhṇīyāt | aparakāryamāha - śuddhaṃ guggulumityādi | śuddhatā'sya niṣpātrāditvena saptarātraṃ ghṛtoṣitatvāt | yadvā śuddhaṃ jātyutkṛṣṭamityāmananti | yataḥ gugguloḥ pañca jātayaḥ, tadyathā ‘suvarṇavarṇaḥ prathamo dvitīyaḥ kusumadyutiḥ | tṛtīyaḥ padmarāgastu caturthaścandranīlakaḥ || pañcamo mahiṣākṣaśca nāmataḥ śāstrakovidaiḥ’ iti | tatra mahiṣākṣaṃ vihitam | uktaṃ ca tantrāntare -‘varamahiṣalocanodarasannibhavarṇasya gugguloḥ prastham’ ityādi | ayaḥpātre lohapātre | darvyā saṅgharṣayenmuhuriti | darvī sañcālanakriyāyāṃ prasiddhaiva | muhuriti vāraṃvāraṃ, kutaḥ ? dagdhabhayāt guḍapākasamākṛtimiti yathā guḍapākaṃ tathā gugguloḥ pākamityarthaḥ | yataḥ ‘guḍavadgugguloḥ pākaḥ sugandhastu viśeṣataḥ’ iti | lakṣaṇamapi guḍapākasya tantrāntare prathitaṃ tadyathā - ‘toyapūrṇe yadā pātre kṣipto na plavate guḍaḥ | kṣiptastu niścalastiṣṭhet patitastu na śīryate || eṣa pāko guḍādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitaḥ’ iti | aparakāryamāha - cūrṇīkṛtya tatastatreti | tata iti guḍapākādanantaraṃ tatra iti guggulupākadravye | triphalā dvipalā jñeyetyādi | saṃmilitatriphalāyā dvipalamitaṃ cūrṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, guḍūcī palaparimitā | vyavahārastu guḍūcyāḥ satvamādāya kṣipediti manoharam | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tacca militvā ṣaḍakṣam, viḍaṅgacūrṇamapyardhapalaṃ, dantīmūlaṃ jayapālamūlaṃ karṣapramāṇam | kecittu dantībījānyatra kṣipanti | tacca sarvamataṃ | trivṛnniśothaḥ| tataḥ piṇḍīkṛtamityādinātra kartavyavidhirapi yogarājavadboddhavyaḥ | guṭikā iti | śāṇamātreti śāṇaparimitā guṭikāḥ kṛtvā doṣādyapekṣayā, na tu niyataśāṇamātrameva | doṣāpekṣayā yathā - kaphe niṣkaikaṃ, pitte dviniṣkaṃ vāyau triniṣkam iti | koṣṭhāpekṣayā yathā ‘catvāro māṣakā hīne, madhye tvaṣṭau ca māṣakāḥ | śreṣṭhe dvādaśakāḥ proktāḥ koṣṭhaṃ vijñāya tattridhā’ iti | ṛtvapekṣayā yathā ‘prāvṛṭkāle ca grīṣme ca ghṛtayuktaṃ pradāpayet | śaratkāle vasante ca dāpayet triphalāyutam | hemante śiśire caiva gomūtreṇa samāyutam’ iti | anupāne tu koṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payo'thavetyādi | payaḥ kṣīraṃ, mañjiṣṭhādiśṛtamiti mañjiṣṭhādikvāthaṃ kvāthakalpanāyāṃ kvathitaṃ, yuktiyuktamutāparamiti utāthavā aparamanupānaṃ yuktiyuktaṃ rogasātmyaṃ dadyāditi sambandhaḥ | tathāhi - ‘yasya rogasya yat sātmyaṃ dadyāt tadanupānakam’ iti | etaccāgre vakṣyamāṇamasti | vāsādinā netragadāniti vāsādinā vāsādikvāthena, varuṇādinā varuṇādikvāthena kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, gulmādīniti ādigrahaṇāt kṛcchrāśmarīprabhṛtīn, khadirasya kvātheneti khadiro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya mūlatvak| asyābhyāse tyājyamāha amlamityādi | amlamamlīkā mātuluṅgādi, tīkṣṇaṃ rājikādi, ajīrṇamannādijaṃ, vyāyāmaṃ śarīrāyāsajanakaṃ karma śramaṃ vahvāyāsakṛtakaṣṭaṃ karma, ātapaṃ dharmasevā, madyaṃ madyapānaṃ, roṣaṃ krodhaṃ, samyak tyajediti yato'mlādīni vātaraktaprakopīṇi bhavanti | eke amlaṃ tīkṣṇamityādi ślokaṃ na paṭhanti kṣepako'yamiti manyante | kaiśoragugguluriti kaiśoro bālakaḥ tasya rūpaṃ kaiśorakaṃ tenāsyābhyāse bālakasyeva rūpaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ | ata eva kāntikārakaḥ kathitaḥ || 70-81 || Gū. triphalā trayaḥ prasthā iti | ekaṃ prasthaṃ harītakī, ekaṃ bibhītakaṃ, ekam āmalakam evaṃ trayaḥ; amṛtā guḍūcī prasthaikā saṃkuṭya lohapātre sārdhadroṇajale pacet, ardhajalaṃ gṛhītvā vastrapūtaṃ punaḥ pacet | darvyā muhuḥ saṃghaṭṭayet, sāndrībhūtaṃ guḍapākaṃ jñātvā imāni kṣipet | triphalārdhapalā jñeyā pratyekamardhapalā, guḍūcī palikā tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭu ṣaḍakṣaṃ pratyekaṃ dvyakṣaṃ, viḍaṅgānām ardhapalaṃ, dantī karṣamitā, trivṛtkarṣamitā | tat piṇḍīkṛtvā ghṛtapātre kṣipet | śāṇikā guṭikā doṣāpekṣayā śuddhaṃ gugguluṃ tṛṇavālaśarkarādirahitaṃ, yadvā vātaraktādau auṣadhaṃ kvāthaśothitaṃ kṣipet | anupāne koṣṇaṃ nīraṃ payaḥ dugdhaṃ mañjiṣṭhādirvā | spaṣṭamanyat | purasevakaḥ guggulubhakṣakaḥ guṇārthī amlādīn tyajet | ayaṃ gugguluḥ kaiśorakābhidhānaḥ kiśorāvasthāvadrūpakaraḥ syāt || 70-81 || atha triphalāguggulurbhagandarādau - tripalaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ kṛṣṇācūrṇaṃ palonmitam | gugguluṃ pāñcapalikaṃ kṣodayetsarvamekataḥ || 82 || tatastu guṭikāṃ kṛtvā prayuñjyādvahnyapekṣayā | bhagandaraṃ gulmaśothāvarśāṃnti ca vināśayet || 83 || Dī. idānīṃ triphalāgugguluvaṭakamāha - tripalamityādi | saṃmilitaphalatrikacūrṇaṃ tripalapramāṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, tena harītakī palamānaṃ, vibhītakaṃ palapramāṇaṃ, āmalakamapi palamānamiti kṛṣṇā pippalī tasyāścūrṇaṃ palapramitamiti | gugguluṃ pāñcapalikamiti | pañcapalapramāṇaṃ gugguluṃ saṃgṛhya ghṛtena saha saṃkuṭya cūrṇena saha modakāḥ kāryāḥ, ata eva kṣodayedityuktaṃ ghṛtamatra vyavahāradarśanāt| vahnyapekṣayetyādinā bhakṣyamāṇasyeti boddhavyam | gulmaśothāviti gulmaśca śothaśca | eke ‘bhagandaraṃ gulmaśothamarśāṃsi ca vināśayet’ iti paṭhanti | tatra gulmena janitaṃ śothamiti ||82||83|| Gū. tripalaṃ triphalācūrṇaṃ pratyekaṃ palaṃ harītakyādīnāṃ, kṛṣṇacūrṇa pippalīcūrṇaṃ palonmitaṃ, gugguluḥ pañcapalaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 82 || 83 || atha gokṣurādigugguluḥ pramehādau - aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni palānyānīya gokṣurāt | vipacetṣaḍguṇe nīre kvātho grāhyo'rdhaśeṣitaḥ ||84|| tataḥ punaḥ pacettatra puraṃ saptapalaṃ kṣipet | guḍapākasamākāraṃ jñātvā tatra vinikṣipet|| 85 || trikaṭu triphalā mustaṃ cūrṇitaṃ palasaptakam | tata: piṇḍīkṛtasyāsya guṭikā mukhyojitā || 86 || hanyātpramehaṃ kṛcchraṃ ca pradaraṃ mūtraghātakam | vātāsraṃ vātarogāṃśca śukradoṣaṃ tathāśmarīm || 87 || Dī. atha gokṣurādigugguluṃ darśayannāha - aṣṭāviṃśatīti | gokṣurāditi pañcāṅgagokṣurakasyāṣṭāviṃśatipalāni grāhyāṇi, tāni saṃkuṭya ṣaḍguṇe pānīye saṃkvāthyārdhāvaśeṣo grāhyaḥ, ṣaḍguṇatā ca gokṣuraparimāṇāt ardhāvaśeṣo jalaparimāṇāt | tataḥ punaḥ pacedityādi punaḥ pacedityardhāvaśeṣitaḥ kvāthaḥ | tatrārdhāvaśeṣite puraṃ gugguluṃ saptapalaparimitam | guḍapākasamākāramiti | yathā guḍapāko bhavati tathāyamapi kartavyaḥ, tacca guḍapākalakṣaṇaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ | tatra vinikṣipediti tatra guggulupāke vinikṣipedvakṣyamāṇadravyāṇītyarthaḥ | tāni kāni ityatrāha - trikaṭutriphalāmustamiti | trikaṭu tryūṣaṇaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, mustaṃ prasiddham, etat sakalaṃ palasaptakaṃ grāhyaṃ, pratyekaṃ palamātramityarthaḥ | guṭikā mukhayojiteti | asya guṭikā śāṇamātrā prakalpya yathādoṣaṃ bhakṣaṇīyā iti bhāvaḥ | kṛcchraṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ, vātarogān hanustambhākṣepakādīn || 84-87 || Gū. gokṣuram aṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyāni palānyānīya ṣaḍguṇe nīre vipacet ardhaśeṣaḥ kvātho grāhyaḥ | punaḥ saptapalaṃ puraṃ gugguluṃ datvā pacet trikaṭu triphalāmustaṃ etāni saptadravyāṇi saptapalāni pratyekaṃ palam | iti gokṣurādiḥ pramehādau || 84-87 || atha triphalāmodakaḥ kuṣṭhādau - triphalāṣṭapalā kāryā bhallātaṃ ca catuṣpalam | vākucī pañcapalikā viḍaṅgānāṃ catuṣpalam || 88 || hatalohaṃ trivṛccaiva gugguluśca śilājatu | ekaikaṃ palamātraṃ syātpalārdhaṃ pauṣkaraṃ bhavet || 89 || citrakasya palārdhaṃ syāddviśāṇaṃ maricaṃ bhavet | nāgaraṃ pippalī mustā tvagelāpatrakuṅkumam ||90|| śāṇonmitaṃ syādekaikaṃ cūrṇayetsarvamekataḥ | tatastatprakṣipeccūrṇaṃ pakvakhaṇḍe ca tatsame ||91|| modakānpalikānkṛtvā prayuñjīta yathocitān | hanyāt sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni tridoṣaprabhavāmayān ||92|| bhagandaraplīhagulmāñjihvātālugalāmayān | śiro'kṣibhrugatānrogānhanyātpṛṣṭhagatānapi ||93 || prāgbhojanasya deyaṃ syādadhaḥ kāyasthite gade | bheṣajaṃ bhaktamadhye ca roge jaṭharasaṃsthite || bhojanasyopari grāhyamūrdhvajatrugadeṣu ca | Dī. atha triphalāmodakamapyāha - triphaletyādi| sammilitaphalatrikamaṣṭapalaparimitaṃ bhavati | bhallātaṃ bhallātakaphalaṃ, hatalohamiti samyaṅmṛtalohacūrṇaṃ, ‘hatalohaṃ gugguluśca śilājatu trikatrikam’ iti pāṭhe trikatrikaṃ tripalamityarthaḥ | ayaṃ pāṭhastvasaṅgata eva, kintu “hatalohaṃ trivṛccaiva gugguluśca śilājatu” iti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | tatra trivṛnniśothaṃ, tena lohacūrṇādiśilājatuparyantaṃ palamātramāhuḥ, pauṣkaraṃ puṣkaramūlaṃ palārdhaṃ grāhyaṃ, nāgarādikuṅkumāntaṃ dravyasaptakaṃ śāṇonmitaṃ, pratyekamiti bhāvaḥ | pakvakhaṇḍe ca tatsame iti tatsame sakala dravyasambhārasāmye tena saptaviṃśatipalānītyarthaḥ | yathocitāniti, yathā doṣāpekṣayā jihvātālugalāmayāni- tyanena jihvāmayān, tālvāmayān, galāmayān, ete mukharoge paṭhitāḥ, hanyāt pṛṣṭhāgatān rogānityarthaḥ | prāgbhojanasyeti prātaḥkāle; adhaḥkāyasthite gade iti gṛdhrasyādau; jaṭharasaṃsthite udarādau ūrdhvajatrugadeṣviti śirorogādiṣu bhojanasyopari sāyaṃkāle ||88-94|| Gū. pakvakhaṇḍaṃ pakvatāṃ prāpte khaṇḍe triphalā'ṣṭapalā pratyekamaṣṭapalā, tvak tajaḥ, elā, patraṃ patrajaṃ, kuṅkumaṃ keśaraṃ; spaṣṭamanyat || iti triphalāmodakaḥ || 88-94 || atha kāñcanāragugguluḥ gaṇḍamālā'pacīgranthībhagandarādau - kāñcanāratvaco grāhyaṃ palānāṃ daśakaṃ budhaiḥ ||95|| triphalā ṣaṭpalā kāryā trikaṭu syātpalatrayam | palaikaṃ varuṇaṃ kuryādelātvakpatrakaṃ tathā || 96 || ekaikaṃ karṣamātraṃ syātsarvāṇyekatra cūrṇayet | yāvaccūrṇamidaṃ sarvaṃ tāvanmātrastu gugguluḥ || 97 || saṃkuṇṭhya sarvamekatra piṇḍaṃ kṛtvā ca dhārayet | guṭikāḥ śāṇamātreṇa prātargrāhyā yathocitam ||98|| gaṇḍamālāṃ jayatyugrāmapacīmarbudāni ca | granthīnvraṇāṃśca gulmāṃśca kuṣṭhāni ca bhagandaram|| 99 || pradeyaścānupānārthaṃ kvātho muṇḍitakābhavaḥ | kvāthaḥkhadirasārasya pathyākvātho'tha koṣṇakam ||10.|| Dī. atha kāñcanāragugguluṃ prakaṭayannāha - kāñcanāratvaca iti | kāñcanāro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddha eva nijanāmnā, tasya tvak daśapalaparimitā grāhyā | triphaleti saṃmilitaphalatrikaṃ ṣaṭpalapramitaṃ; trikaṭorapi militvā palatrayaṃ bhavati varuṇo'pi svanāmaprasiddho vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasyāpi tvageva grāhyā | elā tvak patrakamiti sugandhatrayaṃ pratyekaṃ karṣamātraṃ deyaṃ, gugguluratra sakalacūrṇasamaḥ, tena trikarṣottarāṇi viṃśatipalāni bhavanti; piṇḍaṃ kṛtvetyādinā ghṛtena saha saṃkuṭya snigdhabhāṇḍe dhārayediti saṃpradāyaḥ | yathocitamiti yathādoṣāpekṣayā anupānārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - kvātho muṇḍatikābhava iti | muṇḍatikā bhūkadambakaṃ kedāramuṇḍī iti loke, khadiraḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya sāro madhyabhāgasthitakāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ | pathyā harītakī koṣṇamityuṣṇodakaṃ, yataḥ - ‘kaṃ śirombunoḥ’ iti kośaḥ || 95-10. || Gū. kāñcanāraḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya tvacaḥ viṃśatipalaṃ, trikaṭu dvādaśapalaṃ samuditaṃ pratyekaṃ, śuṇṭhyādīnāṃ catuḥpalaṃ, triphalā ṣaṭpalā samuditā ca pratyekaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikā, varuṇaṃ palaikam, elā tvakpatrakam, ekaikaṃ karṣaṃ gugguluḥ sarvasamaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 95-10. || atha māṣādimodakaḥ puṣṭau - nistuṣaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ syāttathā godhūmasaṃbhavam | nistuṣaṃ yavacūrṇaṃ ca śālitaṇḍulajaṃ tathā || 101 || sūkṣmaṃ ca pippalīcūrṇaṃ palikānyupakalpayet | tata ekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ bharjayedgoghṛtena ca || 102 || ardhamātreṇa sarvebhyastataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samaṃ kṣipet | jalaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ dattvā pācayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 103 || tataḥ pakvaṃ samuddhṛtya vṛttānkurvīta modakān | bhuktvā sāyaṃ palaikaṃ ca pibetkṣīraṃ caturguṇam|| 104 || varjanīyau viśeṣeṇa kṣārāmlau dvau rasāvapi | kṛtvaivaṃ ramayennārīrbahvīrna kṣīyate naraḥ || 105 || iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe vaṭakakalpanā nāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || Dī. atha māṣādimodakamāha - nistuṣamityādi | māṣacūrṇaṃ nistuṣaṃ tuṣarahitaṃ grāhyaṃ, tatheti grahaṇādgodhūcūrṇamapi nistuṣamityarthaḥ | śālirdhānyaviśeṣaḥ sa ca ṣaṣṭiko grāhyaḥ tasya taṇḍulānkṛtvā tajjātaṃ cūrṇaṃ deyaṃ palikānīti bahuvacanena māṣacūrṇādipippalīcūrṇāntaṃ dravyaṃ pratyekaṃ palamātramāhuḥ kartavyavidhāvatra | tata ekīkṛtamityādi cūrṇādardhamātreṇa goghṛtena cūrṇaṃ manāgbharjayitvā tadanu sakalacūrṇasamānaṃ khaṇḍaṃ saṃgṛhya khaṇḍādviguṇitena jalena saha paktvā palapramitā modakāḥ kāryāḥ | sāyaṃ sandhyāsamaye | pibet kṣīraṃ caturguṇamiti palapramāṇaṃ dravyaṃ bhakṣayitvā palacatuṣṭayaṃ kṣīramanupeyamityarthaḥ | kṣārāmlau dvau rasau viśeṣeṇa varjanīyau yatastau śukracyutikarau bhavataḥ, na kṣīyate nara iti śukrahānirna bhavatīti tātparyārthaḥ || 101-105 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe guṭikākalpanādhyāyaḥ samāptaḥ || 7 || Gū. nistuṣaṃ tvagrahitaṃ māṣacūrṇaṃ, pippalīcūrṇam etāni palikāni palamānāni, sarvebhyo'rdhena goghṛtena bharjayet | tataḥ khaṇḍaṃ samaṃ dviguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā pācayet dviguṇaṃ khaṇḍāt tataḥ pakvamodakaṃ palamātraṃ khādet evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ bahvīrnārī ramayet kṣīyate na || || 101-105 || iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne guṭikādhikāraḥ || 7 || Editor's notes 1 cūrṇādhikāroktam | ↩ 8 ‘mūlakajāt’ pā. | ↩ 9 nāsti kha pustake | ↩ 10 kuṭṭanaṃ ca lakṣasaṃkhyākanirghātairavicchedaṃ kāryamiti sampradāyaḥ | yāvat sikthatulyamāyāti tāvadvā'ṣṭapraharamavicchedamiti kecit | ghṛtaṃ kuṭṭanasamaya eva vāraṃ-vāraṃ dātavyam | ↩ 11 ‘vyavāyaṃ’ pā. | ↩ 12 ‘kumudāhvayaḥ’ pā.| ↩

title: 8. atha avalehādhikārādhyāyaḥ
text: aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ | kvāthādīnāṃ punaḥ pākādghanatvaṃ sā rasakriyā | so'valehaśca lehaḥ syāttanmātrā syātpalonmitā ||1 || Dī. adhunāvalehānāṃ prathamatastatsvarūpaviṣayaṃ darśayannāha - kvāthādīnāmiti | kvāthādīnāmityādi grahaṇāt svarasaphāṇṭakalkādayo'bhidhīyante ghanatvamiti | sāndratvaṃ yāvadbhavati tāvatpākaḥ kartavya iti bhāvaḥ | pākastu kvāthādīnāṃ bhavati, yataḥ prathamataḥ kvāthavidhinā pākaṃ kṛtvā paścāt pākena lehaḥ syāditi | tanmātreti tasyā'valehabhakṣaṇārthaṃ mānaṃ palamitaṃ boddhavyaṃ, iti sāmānyamānaṃ bhakṣaṇe'bhihitam || 1 || sitā caturguṇā kāryā cūrṇācca dviguṇo guḍaḥ | dravaṃ caturguṇaṃ dadyāditi sarvatra niścaya || 2 || Dī. idānīmanukte sitādīnāṃ parimāṇamāha -- anuktamānāvalehe sitā caturguṇā deyā | caturguṇatā'tra sakaladravyādityarthaḥ | guḍastu dviguṇa iti cūrṇadravyāt | dravaṃ toyakṣīrādikaṃ caturguṇam | atrāpi cūrṇāditi bhāvaḥ | sarvatra niścaya iti svatantre paratantre vā || 2 || athāvalehasya siddhilakṣaṇamāha - supakve tantumattvaṃ syādavaleho'psu majjati | kharatvaṃ pīḍite mudrāgandhavarṇarasodbhavaḥ || 3 || Dī. supakva iti | samyak pakve'valehe etādṛśaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ bhavati, kīdṛśaṃ tadāha - tantumattvamityādi | darvyā sañcālanena tantusaṃyukta iva dṛśyate, tena mṛdyamāno'ṅguligrāhī bhavatītyarthaḥ | apsu majjatīti pānīyamadhye yadā kṣiptastadā nimagno bhavati | sthiratvamiti niścalatvam etena dravarahita ityarthaḥ | tathāhi - “toyapūrṇe yadā pātre kṣipto na plavate guḍaḥ | kṣiptastu niścalastiṣṭhet patitastu na śīryate || eṣa pāko guḍādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ parikīrtitaḥ” iti | pīḍite mudreti tasminnaṅgulyādipīḍite sati mudrādīnāmudbhavo bhavati, mudrā'tra nimnatā | yaduktaṃ “pīḍite tu yadāṅgulyā nimnatā tatra jāyate” iti | gandhavarṇarasodbhava iti sugandhopetaḥ surasopeta iti | yo'valeho bhavati sa supakva ityarthaḥ || 3 || Gū. kvāthādeḥ kaṣāyāderyatpunaḥ pakvāt sā rasakriyā ucyate avaleho lehaśca ucyate nāmataḥ tanmātrā palonmitā syāt | cūrṇāt sitā caturguṇā, guḍo dviguṇaḥ, evaṃ caturguṇamiti niścayaḥ | avalehe supakve tantumattvaṃ syāt, sparśena pīḍite svarasatve mudrā ca bhavati | gandhavarṇarasodbhavastadā siddhaṃ bhavet || 3 || idānīmanukteṣvanupānamāha - dugdhamikṣuraso yūṣaḥ pañcamūlīkaṣāyajam | vāsākātho yathāyogyamanupānaṃ praśasyate || 4 || Dī. dugdhamiti | dugdhamiti sāmānyagrahaṇena sarvāṇi kṣīrāṇi yathādoṣaṃ grāhyāṇi | ikṣurasagrahaṇena sarve ikṣuvikārā gṛhyante | pañcamūlī mahatī hrasvā vā yathā vyādhivihitā grāhyā | kaṣāyajamiti yūṣamityarthaḥ | tena pañcamūlasya kaṣāyeṇa kṛtvā yūṣaḥ so'nupānamiti bhāvaḥ | kaṣāyagrahaṇena svarasakvāthakalkādayo grāhyāḥ | vāsākvātha iti | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, yathāyogyamiti yad yasya doṣasya yogyaṃ tadyathāyogyam | etena doṣānurūpamiti vyādhyanusāraṃ kathitaḥ, tadyathā - vāte'mlamadhuralavaṇaprāyāḥ snigdhādayaḥ, pitte madhurakaṣāyatiktaprāyāḥ śītādayaḥ, kaphe tiktoṣaṇakaṣāyaprāyā rūkṣādayaḥ | mātrā yathā tathāhyuktam - “anupānaṃ prayoktavyaṃ kaphavyādhau palaṃ bhavet | paladvayaṃ tu pitte vānilaje ca palatrayam” iti | yadvā “gaṇḍūṣaṃ mātrayā deyaṃ mṛdau krūre tu pañca ca | anupānaṃ prayoktavyaṃ deśakālādyapekṣayā” iti | anupānamiti | anu paścātpānaṃ tat kutaḥ tadāha - “yathā jalagataṃ tailaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva sarpati | tathā bhaiṣajyamaṅgeṣu prasarpatyanupānataḥ” iti || 4 || Gū. avalehe dugdhādiryathāyogyamanupānam ||4|| atha kāsaśvāsādau kaṇṭakāryavalehaḥ - sa yathā - kaṇṭakārītulāṃ nīradroṇe paktvā kaṣāyakam | pādaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā ca tasmiṃścūrṇāni dāpayet || 5 || pṛthakpalani caitani guḍūcīcavyacitrakāḥ | mustaṃ karkaṭaśṛṅgī ca tryūṣaṇaṃ dhanvayāsakaḥ || 6 || bhārgī rāsnā śaṭhī caiva śarkarā palaviṃśatiḥ | pratyekaṃ ca palānyaṣṭau pradadyādghṛtatailayoḥ || 7 || paktvā lehatvamānīya śīte madhupalāṣṭakam | catuṣpalaṃ tvagākṣīryāḥ pippalīnāṃ catuṣpalam || 8 || kṣiptvā nidadhyātsudṛḍhe mṛṇmaye bhājane śubhe | leho'yaṃ hanti hikvārtiśvāsakāsānaśeṣataḥ || 9 || Dī. sa yatheti taṃ darśayannāha - kaṇṭakārīti | laghukaṇṭakārikā sā samūlaphalaśākhā grāhyā | nīradroṇa iti caturāḍhakaparimite pānīye tryūṣaṇaṃ pratyekaṃ palapramāṇamāhuḥ | dhanvayāsakaḥ durālabhā rāsnā, surabhī, śarkarā palaviṃśatiriti sugamam | ghṛtatailayoriti militvā ṣoḍaśapalāni | ghṛtamatra goghṛtam ājaṃ vā vyādhivihitatvāt tailaṃ kaṭutailamatra vadantyeke | yataḥ “kāse śvāse ca hikvāyāṃ kaṭutailaṃ prayojayet” iti | kvacidasya prayogo'pi dṛśyate “guḍaṃ kaṭukatailena miśrayitvā samaṃ lihet | trisaptāhaprayogeṇa śvāsaṃ nirmūlato jayet” iti | śīte madhupalāṣṭakamiti| madhukṣaudramaṣṭapalapramāṇaṃ śīte himasparśe vinikṣipedityarthaḥ | yataḥ ‘uṣṇārtamuṣṇairuṣṇe ca tannihanti yathāviṣam’ iti vacanāt | aparāṇi dravyāṇyāha - catuṣpalaṃ tvagākṣīryā ityādi | tvagākṣīrī vāṃśī | pippalī prasiddhā sudṛḍhe tvaticikkaṇe bhājane pātre śubhe abhagne maṅgalatvāt | ayaṃ lehaḥ kaṇṭakārī saṃjñaḥ | aśeṣata iti sampūrṇāriṣṭadarśanādapi āsaṃcayādityarthaḥ | etenāsya prāmāṇyaṃ darśitam || 5-9 || atha cyavanaprāśaḥ kṣayakṣīṇādau - pāṭalā'raṇikāśmaryabilvāralukagokṣurāḥ | parṇyau bṛhatyau pippalyaḥ śṛṅgī drākṣāmṛtābhayāḥ||10|| balā bhūmyāmalī vāsā ṛddhirjīvantikā śaṭhī | jīvakarṣabhakau mustaṃ pauṣkaraṃ kākanāsikā || 11 || mudgaparṇī māṣaparṇī vidārī ca punarnavā | kākolyau kamalaṃ bhede sūkṣmailāgarucandanam || 12|| ekaikaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ sthūlacūrṇitamauṣadham | ekīkṛtya mahatpātre pañcāmalaśatāni ca || 13 || paceddroṇajale kṣiptvā grāhyamaṣṭāvaśeṣitam | tatastu tānyāmalāni niṣkulīkṛtya vāsasā ||14|| dṛḍhahastena saṃpīḍya kṣiptvā tatra tato ghṛtam| palasaptamitaṃ tāni kiṃcidbhṛṣṭvālpavahninā || 15 || tatastatra kṣipetkvāthaṃ khaṇḍaṃ cārdhatulonmitam | lehavatsādhayitvā ca cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet ||16|| pippalī dvipalā deyā tugākṣīrī catuṣpalā | pratyekaṃ ca triśāṇaṃ syāttvagelāpatrakeśaram || 17 || tatastvekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣipetkṣaudraṃ ca ṣaṭpalam | ityetaccyavanaproktaṃ cyavanaprāśasaṃjñitam || 18 || lehaṃ vahnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā khādetkṣīṇo rasāyanam | bālavṛddhakṣatakṣīṇā nārīkṣīṇāśca śoṣiṇaḥ || 19 || hṛdrogiṇaḥ svarakṣīṇā ye narāsteṣu yujyate | kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ pipāsāṃ ca vātāsramuraso graham ||20|| vātapittaṃ śukradoṣaṃ mūtradoṣaṃ ca nāśayet | medhāṃ smṛtiṃ strīṣu harṣaṃ krāntiṃ varṇaprasannatām ||21|| asya prayogādāpnoti naro jīrṇavivarjitaḥ | Dī. adhunā cyavanaprāśāvalehamāha - pāṭaletyādi| pāṭalā prasiddhā, araṇiḥ agnimanthakaḥ, kāśyaryaḥ gāmbhārī, bilvaṃ prasiddham, aralukaḥ syonākaḥ, parṇyau dve tena śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhaparṇī ceti, tacca dvayaṃ ‘kavarādvayaśabdavācyaṃ, bṛhatyāviti dve bṛhatyau kaṇṭakārīdvayamitityarthaḥ | śṛṅgī karkaṭākhyā, bhūmyāmalī tāmalakī, ṛddhī iti dvivacanatvena ṛddhivṛddhī grāhye, jīvantī śākaviśeṣaḥ jīvakarṣabhakāviti dvau tena jīvaka ṛṣabhakaśceti, kākanā- sikā ‘kauvāḍoḍīti’ loke, vidārī kandaviśeṣaḥ, kākolyāviti dravyadvayaṃ tena kākolī kṣīrakākolī ceti, kama- lamutpalaṃ tadabhāve padmabījaṃ grāhyaṃ, mede dve medā mahāmedā ca, agaruḥ kṛṣṇāgaruḥ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, sthūlacūrṇamiti udūkhale musalādibhiḥ kuṭṭitamityartha: | na tu vastragālituṃ, pañcāmalaśatāni ceti | āmalakaphalānāṃ guṭikāni pañcaśatāni atra gaṇanāmānam | evaṃ sarvatra palādimānābhāve yathā vakṣyamāṇavarge agastyaharītakyavalehe “harītakīśataṃ bhadram” ityādi | evaṃ bhallātakaguḍe “bhallātakasahasre dve” iti | yatra palādimānamuktaṃ tatra tu palādimānenaiva vyavahāraḥ | yathā pūrvoktā bāhuśālaguḍe “catuṣpalaṃ syādbhallātam” iti | pacediti hastaparipāṭīvyavahārāt, tadyathā akhaṇḍitāmalakaphalaṃ karpaṭe poṭṭalīṃ badhvā kvāthanīyaṃ tena tāni sugrahāṇi syu: | aṣṭāvaśeṣitamityatra yadgrahaṇaṃ tadvṛndaṭippaṇakāramatamālokya kṛtam | vṛnde tu “jñātvā gatarasaṃ dravyaṃ rasaṃ gṛhṇīta gālitam” ityasya vyākhyāyāṃ aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣeṇa dravyāṇāṃ gatarasatvaṃ syāt iti | kecittu grāhyaṃ pādāvaśeṣitamiti paṭhanti tatra suśrute vāgbhaṭe ca pādaśeṣe rase ityevoktam | niṣkulīkṛtyeti | niṣkulamiti kṣaumādigharṣaṇāt peṣaṇādvā tena asthitvagādirahitamityarthaḥ | saptapalaparimitena sarpiṣā tadbharjanaṃ kāryaṃ cakradattoktaṃ - “sitā matsyaṇḍikābhāve dhātryāśca mṛdubharjanaṃ | caturbhāge jale prāyo dravyaṃ gatarasaṃ bhavet” iti | khaṇḍasya kvāthamiti śīrāśabdavācyaṃ, khaṇḍenāpi kecidvyavaharanti | kṣaudramatra śītībhūte dadyāt cyavanaproktamiti cyavano nāma munistena proktaṃ kathitam, prāśyata iti prāśaḥ cyavanasya prāśa iti bhāvaḥ | kṣīṇo dhātukṣayo rasāyanamiti jarāvyādhināśanaṃ, naro jīrṇavivarjita iti naro'sya sevī puruṣaḥ jīrṇavivarjitaḥ jarārahito bhavatītyarthaḥ | yadvā ajīrṇavivarjī bhavati, tadapi rogamūlameva yataḥ “prāyeṇāhāravaiṣamyādajīrṇaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | tanmūlo rogasaṃghātastadvināśādvinaśyati” iti ||10-21|| Gū. pāṭalādikamauṣadhaṃ pratyekam ekaikaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ sthūlacūrṇitamauṣadhaṃ mahatpātre bṛhatpātre ekīkṛtya pañcāmalakaśatāni droṇajalaṃ kṣiptvā pacet | aṣṭāvaśeṣitaṃ prāhyaṃ, tatastasmāttānyāmalakāni niṣkulīkṛtya nistvacāni vāsasā dṛḍhahastena saṃmardya saptapalamitaṃ ghṛtaṃ datvā tāni kiñcidbhṛṣṭāni ardhatulonmitaṃ khaṇḍaṃ ca datvā kvāthaṃ pacet | lehavatsādhayitvā punaḥ imāni cūrṇāni dāpayet | imāni pippalyādīni kṣaudraṃ ca ṣaṭpalaṃ kṣipet | pāṭalā pāṇḍurā, araṇi:, kāśmarī gambhārī, bilvaḥ śrīphalaḥ, araluḥ syonākaḥ, gokṣuraḥ trikaṇḍakaḥ, parṇyau śāliparṇī mudgaparṇī ca, bṛhatyau bṛhallaghukaṇṭhakārīdvayaṃ, pippalyaḥ, śṛṅgī karkaṭaśṛṅgī, drākṣā gostanī, amṛtā guḍūcī, abhayā harītakī, balā prasiddhā, bhūmyāmalakī prasiddhā, vāsā, ṛddhiḥ, jīvantī, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, jīvakarṣabhakau aṣṭavargoktau, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, puṣkaramūlaṃ kākanāsikā , viṣṇukrāntā, mudgaparṇī, māṣaparṇī, vidārīkandaḥ, punarnavā, kākolī, kamalaṃ, medā sūkṣmailā, agaru candanam etāni pratyekapalāni kvāthyadravyāṇi aṣṭavargavidhānāmabhāve jātimelanīyāni | spaṣṭamanyat | etaccyavanaṛṣiṇā proktaṃ cyavanaprāśasaṃjñaṃ bhavati || 10-21|| atha kūṣmāṇḍāvalehaḥ - niṣkulīkṛtya kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍātpalaśataṃ pacet ||22|| nikṣipya dviguṇaṃ nīramardhaśiṣṭaṃ ca gṛhyate | tāni kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāni pīḍayeddṛḍhavāsasā || 23 || ātape śoṣayetkiṃcicchūlāgrairbahuśo vyadhet | kṣiptvā tāmrakaṭāhe ca dadyādaṣṭapalaṃ ghṛtam || 24 || tena kiṃcidbharjayitvā pūrvoktaṃ tajjalaṃ kṣipet | khaṇḍātpalaśataṃ dattvā sarvamekatra pācayet || 25 || supakve pippalī śuṇṭhī jīrakaṃ dvipalaṃ pṛthak | pṛthakpalārdhaṃ dhānyākaṃ patrailā maricaṃ tvacam || 26|| cūrṇīkṛtya kṣipettatra ghṛtārdhaṃ kṣaudramāvapet | khādedagnibalaṃ dṛṣṭvā raktapittī kṣayī jvarī ||27 || śoṣatṛṣṇāvamicchardiśvāsakāsakṣatāturaḥ | kūṣmāṇḍakāvaleho'yaṃ bālavṛddheṣu yujyate || 28 || uraḥsandhānakṛdvṛṣyo bṛṃhaṇo balakṛnmataḥ | Dī. atha kūṣmāṇḍāvalehavivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - niṣkulīti | niṣkulīkṛtyeti tvaṅmajjādirahitāni kūṣmā- ṇḍaśakalāni saṃgṛhyetyarthaḥ | dviguṇaṃ nīramiti kūṣmāṇḍaparimāṇāt tena kūṣmāṇḍaśakalāni tulāparimitāni dvitulāmitaṃ nīramiti ardhāvaśiṣṭaṃ kvātharūpaṃ jalam | śūlāgrairiti kāṣṭhamayaśaṅkumukhaiḥ | bahuśo vyadhediti bahucchidrā- ṇi kūṣmāṇḍaśakalāni kārayediti bhāvaḥ | uktaṃ ca - hastapāṭyāṃ pūrvaṃ niṣkulīkṛtaṃ tadanu kṛtacchidraṃ paścāt saṃsvedya kṣaumeṇa veṣṭayitvā pīḍayet, ātape manāk saṃśoṣya piṣṭvā palaśataṃ gṛhītvā paktavyaṃ, tena kiñcidbharjayitveti kiṃcidatra yathāpākaṃ bharjayet | tathāhi “muktasarpiṣi kūṣmāṇḍe pāko gandhena mudrayet” iti | tajjalamityardhāvaśeṣitaṃ pūvāktaṃ kvātham | khaṇḍāt palaśatamiti śarkarāpalaśatam | ghṛtārdhaṃ kṣaudramāvapediti ghṛtamānādardhaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu kṣipediti bhāvaḥ | āvapediti grahaṇena śītībhūte tasmin paścāt melayedityarthaḥ | āturaśabda: śoṣādibhiḥ pratyekamabhisaṃbadhyate | bālavṛddheṣu yojayediti saumyatvāt dhātupoṣakatvācca vṛṣyaḥ śukravṛddhikaraḥ bṛṃhaṇo dhātuvṛddhikaraḥ balakṛdojaso vṛddhikara iti || || 22-28 || Gū. palaśataṃ niṣkulīkṛtakūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāt dvitulānīre nikṣipya pacet ardhaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhyate tāni kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍāni dṛḍhavāsasā pīḍayet | punaḥ kiñcidātape śoṣayet | punarbahuśūlāgrairvedhayet | punaḥ kaṭāhe kṣiptvā aṣṭapalaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadyāt | tena ghṛtena kiñcit bharjayet pūrvoktaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet khaṇḍātpalaśataṃ datvā sarvamekatra kārayet | supakve pippalī-śuṇṭhī jīraṃ jīrakam eṣāṃ pṛthak dvipalaṃ, dhānyākaṃ, patraja, elā, maricaṃ, tvak taja eṣāṃ pṛthak palārdhaṃ ghṛtārdha catuḥpalaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu | spaṣṭamanyat || 22-28 || atha khaṇḍasūraṇāvalehaḥ arśoroge - yuktyā kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍasya sūraṇaṃ vipacetsudhīḥ ||29|| arśasāṃ mūḍhavātānāṃ mandāgnīnāṃ ca yujyate | Dī. idānīṃ khaṇḍasūraṇāvalehamāha - yuktyeti | kūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍasya yuktyā kartavyavidhinā ayamapi sūraṇā'valehaḥ kartavyaḥ | sudhīriti grahaṇena pūrvoktakūṣmāṇḍakhaṇḍe yaddravyaṃ yanmānaṃ yā kartavyatā tat sakalaṃ vicārya tenaiva prakāreṇa sūraṇāvalehaḥ sādhyaḥ | viśeṣeṇa mūḍhavātānāṃ mandāgnīnāṃ ca yujyate || 29 || Gū. sugamam || 29 || atha agastyaharītakyavalehaḥ - harītakīśataṃ bhadraṃ yavānāmāḍhakaṃ tathā || 30|| palāni daśamūlasya viṃśatiṃ ca niyojayet | citrakaḥ pippalīmūlamapāmārgaḥ śaṭhī tathā || 31 || kapikacchuḥ śaṅkhapuṣpī bhārṅgī ca gajapippalī | balā puṣkaramūlaṃ ca pṛthagdvipalamātrayā || 32 || pacetpañcāḍhake nīre yavaiḥ svinnai: śṛtaṃ nayet | taccābhayāśataṃ dadyātkvāthe tasminvicakṣaṇaḥ || 36 || sarpistailāṣṭapalakaṃ kṣipedguḍatulāṃ tathā | paktvā lehatvamānīya siddhe śīte pṛthakpṛthak ||34|| kṣaudraṃ ca pippalīcūrṇaṃ dadyātkuḍavamātrayā | harītakīdvayaṃ khādettena lehena nityaśaḥ || 35 || ayaṃ kāsaṃ jvaraṃ śvāsaṃ hikvārśo'rucipīnasān | grahaṇīṃ nāśayedeṣa valīpalitanāśanaḥ || 36 || balavarṇakaraḥ puṃsāmavaleho rasāyanam | vihito'gastyamuninā sarvarogapraṇāśanaḥ || 37 || Dī. athāgastyaharītakyavalehaṃ darśayannāha - harītakīśatamityādi | harītakīśataṃ harītakīguṭikāśataṃ na tu harītakīpalaśataṃ ‘saṃkhyā phalānāṃ śataśaḥ palānām’ iti vacanāt | bhadramiti śreṣṭhaṃ harītakīphalaśataṃ tena navādiguṇasahitamityarthaḥ | tathāhyuktam - ‘navā snigdhā ghanā vṛttā gurvī kṣiptā tathā'mbhasi | nimajjedyā praśa- statvādguṇakṛt sā prakīrtitā’ iti | yavānāmāḍhakamiti | yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ tasya catuḥṣaṣṭipalāni | kecittu ‘harītakīśataṃ bhadrayavānām āḍhakaṃ tathā’ iti paṭhanti, tatra bhadrayavā indrayavā iti vyākhyānayanti, etanna pracarati sarveṣāṃ saṃpradāyavirodhāt | tasmāddharītakīśataṃ bhadramiti pāṭhaḥ sādhuḥ | daśamūlasya viṃśatipalāni pratyekaṃ dvipalamityarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ prasiddhaṃ | yavaiḥ svinnairiti upalakṣaṇe tṛtīyā | yavasvinnatā ca caturbhāgāvaśeṣe jale eva bhavati tena caturbhāgāvaśiṣṭameva grāhyaṃ | tantrāntare'pyuktaṃ - ‘yavāḍhakaiḥ pañcabhiraṅghriśeṣaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet’ ityādi | paktvāvalehatvamānīyeti vyavahārāt | harītakīśatasya karpaṭe poṭṭalaṃ baddhvā kvathanaṃ paścādutsvinnaharītakīśatasya ghṛtatailayorbharjanaṃ taddṛḍhārthaṃ | yathā tantrāntare sarvārthasiddhaharītakyāṃ harītakībharjanamuktaṃ | tadanu kvāthe guḍatulāṃ loḍayitvā pākaḥ karyavyaḥ, avataraṇasamaye pippalīcūrṇaprakṣepaḥ | śītībhūte cāpare'hni madhudānamiti vṛddhānāṃ mataṃ; sugandhārthaṃ manāk cāturjāmiti kecit | taduktaṃ - ‘pippalīcūrṇakuḍavaṃ cāturjātāvacūrṇitam’ iti | sarpistailāṣṭakapalamiti yaduktaṃ tanmilitvā grāhyaṃ | ‘harītakīdvayaṃ khādet tena lehena nityaśa’ iti | yadyapi guḍasya bhakṣaṇamānaṃ noktaṃ tathāpi harītakīdvirūpagrahaṇena lehasya palamānaṃ bhavatyeva yathā tantrāntare bhārgīguḍe ‘bhakṣayedabhayādekāṃ lehasyārdhapalaṃ lihet’ iti | tenā'tra harītakībhakṣaṇavidhānādguḍapalaṃ bhakṣyamiti | anye tu gulmocchede harītikīnyāyādguḍaṃ dvipalamāhuḥ, etat sarvameva vyādherbalābalatvāt pracarati | agastyamunivihitatvenāsya siddhaphalatvamucyate || 30-37 || Gū. harītakīśataṃ bhadram uttamaṃ śataṃ gaṇanayā, yavānāmāḍhakaṃ yavo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, daśamūlasya viṃśatipalāni pratyekaṃ dvipalaṃ śāliparṇyādikaṃ daśauṣadhaṃ citrakādīni ca pṛthaṅmātrayā dvipalaṃ, apāmārgaḥ, śaṭhī karcūrakapikacchurvānarī tasyā bījaṃ, śaṅkhapuṣpakaṃ śvetapuṣpī, bhārgī, gajapippalī cavyaphalaṃ, tadabhāve cavyaṃ vā, balā prasiddhā, puṣkaramūlaṃ etāni pañcāḍhake nīre pacet | khinnaiḥ pakvairyavaiḥ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet | tasminkvāthe abhayāśataṃ dadyāt pakvaṃ śuṣkaṃ punaḥ pacet yadvā paścādabhayāpākaḥ paktvā lehatvam ānīya sarpirghṛtam aṣṭapalikaṃ tilajaṃ kṣaudraṃ madhu guḍaṃ catuḥpalaṃ pippalīcūrṇaṃ ca kuḍavaṃ | tena lehena siddhena harītakīdvayaṃ khādet balāpekṣayā ekaṃ vā ādau, kṣayādikaṃ haret | ayaṃ agastyamuninā'bhihita agastyāvalehaḥ || 30-37 || arśādau kuṭajāvalehaḥ | kuṭajatvaktulāṃ droṇe jalasya vipacetsudhīḥ | kaṣāyaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ ca gṛhṇīyādvastragālitam || 38 || triṃśatpalaṃ guḍasyātra dattvā ca vipacetpunaḥ| sāndratvamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā cūrṇānīmāni dāpayet|| 39 || rasāñjanaṃ mocarataṃ trikaṭu triphalāṃ tathā | lajjāluṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhāṃ bilvamindrayavaṃ tvacām ||40|| bhallātakaṃ prativiṣāṃ viḍaṅgāni ca vālakam | pratyekaṃ palasaṃmānaṃ ghṛtasya kuḍavaṃ tathā || 41 | siddhaśīte tato dadyānmadhunaḥ kuḍavaṃ tathā | jayedeṣo'valehastu sarvāṇyarśāṃsi vegata: || 42 || durnāmaprabhavānrogānatīsāramarocakam | grahaṇīṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ ca raktapittaṃ ca kāmalām ||43|| amlapittaṃ tathā śothaṃ kārśyaṃ caiva pravāhikām | anupāne prayoktavyamājaṃ takraṃ payo dadhi || 44 | ghṛtaṃ jalaṃ vā jīrṇe ca pathyabhojī bhavennaraḥ | Dī. idānīṃ kuṭajāvalehamāha - kuṭajatvagiti | kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya tvak challī sā palaśataparimitā grāhyā | pādaśeṣamiti caturthāṃśaṃ kaṣāyaṃ vastrapūtaṃ kṛtvā grāhyaṃ | kutracidetanna pracarati kintu pādaśeṣamiti pādasya caturthāṃśasya yaccheṣaṃ caturbhāgaṃ tadgrāhyam, etenāṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ kathitam; tathāca tantrāntare - ‘kuṭajatvakpalaśataṃ jaladroṇe vipācayet | aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu kaṣāyamavatārayet | vastrapūtaṃ tataḥ kvāthaṃ pacellehatvamāgatam’ iti | triṃśatpalaṃ guḍasyātreti atra kvāthe guḍasya purātanasya triṃśatpalaṃ datvā punarvipacediti yāvat sāndratvaṃ bhavati | cūrṇārthamaparāṇi dravyāṇyāha - rasāñjanamiti rasāñjanaṃ pratītaṃ tacca dārvīkvāthasamudbhavamiti prasiddhiḥ, mocarasaṃ śālmalīveṣṭakam, indrayavaṃ tvacamiti indrayavaṃ kuṭajabījaṃ, tvak guḍatvak | durnāmaprabhavān rogāniti gulmodaraprabhṛtīn, anupāne prayoktavyamiti ājaṃ takraṃ, ājaṃ payaḥ, ājaṃ dadhi, ājaṃ ghṛtaṃ ceti | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ, takrādīnāmabhāvāt etatsakalamanupānaṃ yathāsātmyaṃ niṣevedityarthaḥ | jīrṇe ceti dravye parimite sati pathyabhojī bhavennara iti bhāvaḥ | yataḥ - ‘auṣadhaśeṣe bhukta’mityādivākyānurodhāt || 38-44 || Gū. kuṭajaḥ vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya tvak tulāṃ palaśataṃ jalasya droṇe vipacet | sāndratvaṃ ghanatvamāgataṃ dṛṣṭvā imāni rasāñjanādīni pratyekaṃ palamānāni kṣipet | rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ, prativiṣā ativiṣā, bālakam udīcyaṃ, lajjāluḥ lajjāvatī, spaṣṭamanyat || 38 -44 || atīsārādau kuṭajāṣṭakāvalehamāha - kuṭajatvaktulāmārdrāṃ droṇanīre vipācayet || 45 || pādaśeṣa śṛtaṃ nītvā cūrṇānyetāni dāpayet | lajjālurdhātakī bilvaṃ pāṭhā mocarasastathā || 46 || mustaṃ prativiṣā caiva pratyekaṃ syātpalaṃ palam | tatastu vipacedbhūyo yāvaddarvīpralepanam || 47 || jalena chāgadugdhena pīto maṇḍena vā jayet | sarvātisārānghorāṃstu nānāvarṇānsavedanān || 48 || asṛgdaraṃ samastaṃ ca sarvārśāṃsi pravāhikām | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śrīśārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe'valehakalpanā nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || Dī. kuṭajeti | ayaṃ kuṭajāṣṭakāvaleho vyākhyāyāṃ sugama evāvagantavyaḥ | kartavyavidhistu pūrvavadroddhavyaḥ | darvīpralepanam ityavalehasya saṃsiddhilakṣaṇaṃ sūcitaṃ pūrvoktāvalehavidhau jñātavyam || 45-48 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śūrṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyama- khaṇḍe'valehakalpanādhyāyo'ṣṭamaḥ || 8 || Gū. atha kuṭajāṣṭakamatīsārādau - ārdrā kuṭajatvak tulāṃ droṇanīre vipācayet, pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nītvā imāni cūrṇāni dāpayet | lajjālurlajjāvatī, dhātakī vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya puṣpāṇi, bilvaṃ, pāṭhā, mocarasaḥ, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, ativiṣā etāni pratyekaṃ palaṃ tato bhūyo vipacet yāvaddarvyāḥ pralepalepanaṃ bhavati liptvā tiṣṭhati darvī lohanirmitā| tato jalādibhiḥ pibet | spaṣṭamanyat ||45-48 || iti śrīkāśīrāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāmavalehādhikāraḥ ||8 ||

title: 9. atha tailādhikārādhyāyaḥ
text: navamo'dhyāyaḥ | atha snehaparibhāṣā | kalkāccaturguṇīkṛtya ghṛtaṃ vā tailameva vā | caturguṇe drave sādhyaṃ tasya mātrā palonmitā ||1|| nikṣipya kvāthayettoyaṃ kvāthyadravyāccaturguṇam | pādaśiṣṭaṃ gṛhītvā ca snehaṃ tenaiva sādhayet ||2|| Dī. idānīṃ snehakalpanāṃ darśayannāha - kalkāditi | anukte kalkātkalkayogadravyāt ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā caturguṇaṃ grāhyaṃ, na tu dṛṣadi peṣitātkalkāt| dravamapi caturguṇaṃ snehaparimāṇāt dravaṃ toyādi | tasya mātrā palonmiteti | tasya saṃsiddhasnehasya pānārthaṃ palonmitā palapramāṇā mātrā jñeyā ityanukteṣu mānamidaṃ sāmānyaṃ | paribhāṣāyāmayamapi sāmānyasnehapākavidhau boddhavyaḥ, tathāhi - ‘kalkāccaturguṇaḥ snehaḥ snehātkvāthaścaturguṇaḥ | kvāthāccaturguṇaṃ vāri kvāthaḥ kvāthyasamo mataḥ’ iti | viśeṣo'pi kvacidvartate yathā tantrāntare vāsāghṛte balādye ghṛte vā tadyathā -“atrāpyaṣṭaguṇaistoyaiḥ kvathitaṃ kvāthadugdhayoḥ | pratyekaṃ dviguṇo bhāgo bhiṣak sarpiṣi nikṣipet” iti || 1 || 2|| Gū. atha sneheti | tatra tāvat prathamataḥ paribhāṣāmasya vyācaṣṭe | atha ghṛtādhikāraḥ | tatrādau ghṛtatailādisādhanamāha - tatkalketyādi | kalkāt dravyāt ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ caturguṇe dravye dugdhādau sādhyam agnidvārā kaṭāhādau paktvā siddhaṃ bhavati | tasya mātrā vātādirogaviṣaye mānamātrā palonmitā palapramāṇā | idānīṃ snehasādhane kvāthavidhānamāha - nikṣipyetyādi | kvāthadravyāccaturguṇaṃ toyaṃ jalaṃ nikṣipya kvāthayet| punaḥ pādaśiṣṭaṃ ca caturthāṃśāvaśeṣaṃ gṛhītvā'nena kvāthena snehaṃ ghṛtaṃ tailaṃ vā sādhayet | kvāthaṃ kvāthayogyaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ yaddravyaṃ daśamūlādi tasmādisyarthaḥ || 1 || 2 || mṛdudravyādau kvathane jalapramāṇamāha - caturguṇaṃ mṛdudravye kaṭhine'ṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam | tathāca madhyame dravye dadyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ || 3 || atyantakaṭhine dravye nīraṃ ṣoḍaśikaṃ matam | Dī. idānīṃ dravyaviśeṣe kvāthanimittaṃ jalamānamāha - caturguṇamiti | atra caturguṇaprabhṛtikaṃ dravyaparimāṇāddhoddhavyam | yāvatparimāṇaṃ kvāthyaṃ dravyaṃ bhavati tāvatparimāṇāccaturguṇitaṃ jalaṃ grāhyamityarthaḥ | mṛdu kaṭhinaṃ kaṭhinataraṃ ca dravyaṃ tatraivānumānato'vagantavyam | tathāca madhyame dravye dadyādaṣṭaguṇaṃ paya iti | madhyame mṛdvādisaṃbhāre payaḥ pānīyaṃ yatra mṛdukaṭhinataradravyamekatra militvā kvāthyaṃ tatrāṣṭaguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyamiti sarvatra | tathāhi - ‘mṛdvādikvāthyasaṃghāte mānānukte cikitsakāḥ | madhyasyobhayabhāgitvādicchantyaṣṭaguṇaṃ jalam’ iti || 3 || Gū. mṛdudravye guḍūcyādau caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ, kaṭhine daśamūlādau aṣṭaguṇaṃ, tathāca madhyamadravye āragvadhādau aṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ | payo'tra jalaṃ | atyantakaṭhine padmakādau ṣoḍaśikaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ mataṃ kathitaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ gṛhyate || 3 || atha matāntare parimāṇaviśeṣamāha - karṣāditaḥ palaṃ yāvatkṣipetṣoḍaśikaṃ jalam || 4 || tadūrdhvaṃ kuḍavaṃ yāvadbhavedaṣṭaguṇaṃ payaḥ | prasthāditaḥ kṣipennīraṃ khārī yāvaccaturguṇam || 5 || ambukvātharasairyatra pṛthaksnehasya sādhanam | kalkasyāṃśaṃ tatra dadyāccaturthaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṣṭamam || 6 || dugdhe dadhni rase nakre kalko deyo'ṣṭamāṃśakaḥ | kalkasya samyakpākārthaṃ toyamatra caturguṇam || 7 || Dī. karṣādita iti | karṣādita ityādiparimāṇaṃ sāmānyadravyaviṣaye vartate anyathā svatantravirodhaḥ, yāva- tkvāthyadravyaṃ karṣādiparimāṇātpalaṃ bhavati tāvattatra ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ jalaṃ datvā kvāthaṃ pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyaṃ | ṣoḍaśikamatra kvāthyadravyaparimāṇāt, tatastu palādupari yāvatkuḍavaṃ kvāthyadravyaparimāṇaṃ bhavati tāvadatra toyaṃ pānīyamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet, kvāthyadravyādityarthaḥ | atra kvāthaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ grāhyamiti sarvatra | prasthādita iti | prasthādiparimāṇāt yāvat khārī bhavati tāvadatra caturguṇaṃ nīraṃ pānīyaṃ prakṣipya saṃkvāthya ca pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyamiti tātparyārthaḥ | ādiśabdāt āḍhakadroṇaśūrpadroṇīprabhṛtayo grāhyāḥ | yadvā prasthasyādiḥ prasthādistasmāt tena śarāvamapi gṛhyate, śarāvādita ityarthaḥ || 4 || 5 ||aparamapyanuktamāha - ambukvātheti | yatra snehapāke pānīyāditrayāṇāṃ dravyāṇāṃ madhye yadā ekena pākaḥ syāt tadā kalkasya kalkadravyasya caturthāṃśaṃ ṣaṣṭhāṃśam aṣṭamāṃśaṃ yathā'nukrameṇa deyam | anukramo yathā - yadi ambunā kevalena pākastarhi kalkadravyasya caturthāśaṃ deyam, snehaparimāṇādityarthaḥ | yadā kevalena kvāthenaiva pākastadā kalkadravyasya ṣaṣṭhāṃśaṃ deyam, atrāpi snehaparimāṇādityarthaḥ | yatra tu kevalasvarasenaiva sādhyate srehaḥ tatra kalkadravyasyāṣṭamāṃśaṃ deyam | snehamānādityatrāpi sambandhaḥ ityanukramaḥ | aparamapi - dugdhe ityatrāpi ekadravyasādhyatā sūcyate tadā kalkadravyaṃ snehaparimāṇādaṣṭamāṃśaṃ deyamiti bhāvaḥ | kalkasyeti | yatra tu anyadravaiḥ kevalakalkenaiva sādhyate snehastadā caturguṇaṃ kalkadravyaṃ caturguṇaṃ toyaṃ nikṣipediti sarvatra | samyak pākārthaṃ boddhavyam | etena kimuktaṃ yadā kṣīrādibhiḥ pratyekena svakalkena pākastadā caturguṇaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ pānīyaṃ deyam | pānīyaṃ vinā pāko nāstīti sarvamatam || 6 || 7 || Gū. karṣādārabhya khārīparyantaṃ kvāthyadravye jalamānamāha - karṣāditaḥ yāvatpalaṃ pramāṇaṃ tāvat ṣoḍaśikaṃ ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet| tadūrdhvaṃ palādūrdhvaṃ yāvatkuḍavaṃ kuḍavapramāṇaṃ tāvadaṣṭaguṇaṃ payo jalaṃ bhavet | prasthāditaḥ yāvat khārīpramāṇaṃ tāvaccaturguṇaṃ jalaṃ kṣipet | pūrvaṃ caturguṇādijalaṃ yallikhitaṃ tanmṛdudravyādiviṣayaṃ jñeyaṃ | karṣādita idaṃ tu mānaviṣayam ataḥ kecinmṛdvādito gṛhṇanti kecinmānato gṛhṇanti || 4 || 5|| ambvādibhiryatra snehamānaṃ tatra kalkapramāṇamāha - ‘tatrāmbupiṣṭamuktaṃ syājjalaṃ cātra caturguṇam’, yatra bhinnaṃ sādhanaṃ bhavati, tatra kalkasyāṃśaṃ caturguṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ kramāt ambupāke caturthāṃśaṃ raso māṃsarasastatpāke aṣṭamāṃśam | ukto'pyambvādau pāke dugdhādau aṣṭamāṃśa eva kalkapāka ityāha - kalkasya samyagiti | dugdhe tathā dadhni tathā takre pākānantaraṃ kalkaḥ aṣṭamāṃśakādayaḥ raso māṃsarasaḥ | yadvā raso dhattūrarasaḥ māṃsarasasya pūrvoktatvāt kalkasya samyak pākārthaṃ caturguṇaṃ snehādityarthaḥ || 6 || 7 || dravāṇi yatra sneheṣu pañcādīni bhavanti hi | tatra snehasamānyāhuryathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇam || 8 || Dī. idānīmanuktadravāṇāṃ mānamāha - davāṇīti | yatra snehapakvadravāṇi kṣīratakrarasamūtrakvāthāni anyānyapi pañcādīni pañcaprabhṛtīni bhavanti anuktamānānīti viṣayaḥ | tatra tāni dravāṇi snehasamāni pratyekamāhurācāryāḥ | yathā vakṣyamāṇatriphalāghṛte arvāk dravaṃ catvārastrayo vā tarhi snehaparimāṇāccaturguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ pratyekamityarthaḥ | eke yathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇamiti paṭhanti tatrāpi sa evārthaḥ | kutracit dravyāṇīti pāṭho dṛśyate so'saṅgata eva || 8 || Gū. dravyāṇīti | yatra pañcādhikāni dravyāṇi tatra sneheṣu kiyatparimitaṃ dravyaṃ deyaṃ tadāha - sneheṣu ghṛtatailādiṣu dravāṇi dugdhādīni yatra pañcaprabhṛtīni bhavanti tatra snehasamānaṃ bhavati na caturguṇānīti yāvat | yathāpūrvaṃ caturguṇamityetasyāyamartha: | eko dravastatra pākena cāturguṇyaṃ, dvau dravau yatra tatra dvābhyāṃ cāturguṇyaṃ yaduktaṃ jaijjaṭe ‘ekadvitridravairdravyaiḥ kuryāt snehāccaturguṇaṃ | kṣīraṃ snehasamaṃ dadyāt caturbhiśca caturguṇam, iti | asyāyamarthaḥ yatraiko dravastatraikena cāturguṇyaṃ, evaṃ dvābhyāṃ, tribhirmilitvā cāturguṇyamityarthaḥ | yatra pañcādhikāni bhavanti tatra snehasamānīti pūrvārthaḥ| ‘tailasyārdhapramāṇena dadyādikṣurasaṃ budhaḥ | tathā māṃsarasaṃ cārdhaṃ datvā snehaṃ vipācayet’ snehasamānyāhurityasya truṭimāhurityarthaḥ ityanye | tadyathā - sakṛnmāṃsauṣadhirasaṃ mūtrasauvīrakādikaṃ | snehatulyaṃ dadhi kṣīraṃ jalaṃ caiva caturguṇam || granthajñānārthamedvyavākhyāprasaṅgenoktam ||8|| kevalakvāthapāke vidhānamāha - dravyeṇa kevalenaiva snehapāko bhavedyadi | tatrāmbupiṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ syājjalaṃ cātra caturguṇam || 9|| kvāthena kevalenaiva pāko yatreritaḥ kvacit | kvāthyadravyasya kalko'pi tatra snehe prayujyate ||10|| Dī. atha kevaladravyasya snehapākārthaṃ mānamāha - dravyeṇeti | atra dravyaṃ snehāccaturthāṃśaṃ kalkārthaṃ vāri tāvaddeyaṃ yāvat kalkaḥ syāt | yataḥ peṣaṇe jalasya parimāṇaṃ na syāt | jalaṃ cātra caturguṇamiti | atra kalke jalaṃ pānīyam | caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ snehamānādityarthaḥ | eke dravyamānāccaturguṇaṃ jalamiti vyākhyānayanti tanna manoharaṃ kalkadravyālpatvāt | aparamapyāha - kvātheneti | yatra snehe kvaciditi anukte kevalena kvāthena kṛtvā pākaḥ kathitaḥ tatra snehe kvāthyadravyasya kalka: kāryaḥ, kalkārthaṃ cātra caturguṇaṃ jalamiti tena yenaiva dravyeṇa kvāthaḥ kriyate tainaiva tatparimitena ca dravyeṇāyamapi kṛtvā'tra caturguṇena ca jalena saha sādhyaḥ | pūrvaṃ kvāthena sādhyaḥ paścātkalkenetyarthaḥ ||9||10|| Gū. kevalena kvāthena yadi snehapāko bhavet tatrāmbupiṣṭaḥ kalko jalaṃ caturguṇakvātheneti | idaṃ padyaṃ pūrvaślokasyaikārthatvāt prakṣiptaṃ jñeyaṃ || 9 || 10 || kalkahīnastu yaḥ srehaḥ sa sādhyaḥ kevale drave | Dī. kalkahīna iti | yaḥ sneho ghṛtaṃ tailādikaḥ kalkahīnaḥ kalkarahito bhavet saḥ kevale drave sādhyaḥ| dravamatra caturguṇaṃ snehaparimāṇāt || Gū. atha kevaladravasādhanamāha - kalkahīne snehe sādhanamāha - yaḥ kalkahīnaḥ snehaḥ sa kevale drave sādhyaḥ| puṣpakalkastu yaḥ snehastatra toyaṃ caturguṇam || 11 || snehe snehāṣṭamāṃśaśca puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyate | Dī. idānīṃ puṣpakalkasya parimāṇamāha puṣpakalka iti | yaḥ puṣpakalkasaṃjñaḥ snehaḥ tatra snehe toyaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ caturguṇatā ca snehāt snehaparimāṇādityarthaḥ | saḥ puṣpakalkaḥ snehāṣṭamāṃśo yojyata ityarthaḥ | snehasyāṣṭamāṃśaṃ tena sāmyo yojya ityarthaḥ | puṣpāṇi yathā nāgakeśarakuṅkumalavaṅgadamanakasurapuṣpacampakotpalapuṇḍarīkaketakījātī-kusumbhaprabhṛtīni | eke puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyata ityasya sthāne'tra kalkaṃ prayujyate iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti tat patrakalkaṃ prakṣepamāhuḥ, tathāhi - ‘gandhaniryāsapuṣpāṇāṃ siddhaśīte'vatārite | prakṣepo gandhavṛddhyarthaṃ patrakalkaṃ tu tadviduḥ’ || 11 || Gū. puṣpakalkai: snehasādhanamāha - puṣpeti | yasminsnehe puṣpakalko dīyate sa puṣpakalkaḥ snehaḥ, tatra toyaṃ jalaṃ caturguṇaṃ snehātpuṣpakalkaḥ kiyatparimito dīyate ityatrāha - snehāṣṭamāṃśaśca puṣpakalkaḥ prayujyate iti || 11 || vartivatsnehakalkaḥ syādyadāṅgulyā vimarditaḥ ||12|| śabdahīno'gninikṣiptaḥ snehaḥ siddho bhavettadā| yadā phenodgamastaile phenaśāntiśca sarpiṣi ||13|| gandhavarṇarasotpattiḥ snehasiddhistadā bhavet | snehapākastridhā prokto mṛdurmadhyaḥ kharastathā ||14|| īṣatsarasakalkastu snehapāko mṛdurbhavet | madhyapākasya siddhiśca kalke nīrasakomalaḥ ||15|| īṣatkaṭhinakalkaśca snehapāko bhavetkharaḥ | tadūrdhvaṃ dagdhapākaḥ syāddāhakṛnniṣprayojanaḥ || 16 || Dī. idānīṃ snehānāṃ saṃsiddhilakṣaṇānyāha - vartivaditi | yadā snehe paripācitaḥ kalkaḥ aṅgulyā vimardito vartisadṛśo bhavati tadā siddho jñeyaḥ | athavā sa eva kalkaḥ yadā'gnau nikṣiptaḥ śabdarahito bhavati tadā siddho jñātavyaḥ iti sāmānyam | aparamapi viśeṣamāha - yadā snehasya pākānte taile phenodgamo bhavati sarpiṣi ca phenaśāntirbhavati tadā siddhalakṣaṇaṃ boddhavyaṃ | varṇagandharasotpattirapi snehasiddhiḥ syāt varṇādikamapi taile sarpiṣi ca jñātavyam | adhunā trividhasnehapākasya lakṣaṇamāha - īṣatsarasakalka iti | yadā kalke sāndratā kiñcidbhavati agnau nikṣipte sati caṭacaṭāśabdo bhavati tadā mṛdupāko jñeyaḥ, yadā nīraso kalko bhavati komalaśca nātikaṭhino nātimṛduriti tadā madhyapākaḥ, yadā kiñcit kaṭhinakalko jātaḥ nīrasaśca bhavati tadā kharapāka iti | eteṣāṃ parīkṣaṇamanumānato'vagantavyaṃ gurusakāśadarśanādvā | tadūrdhvaṃ kharapākādūrdhvaṃ yadā snehakalkaḥ kaṭhinataro bhavati tadā dagdho jñeyaḥ, sa ca sarvakarmasu niṣphalaḥ syāt dāhakaraśca bhavati ||12-16|| Gū. idānīṃ snehasiddhalakṣaṇamāha - yadā snehakalkaḥ aṅgulyā vartitaḥ vartīkṛtaḥ vartivadbhavet agninikṣiptaḥ śabdahīnaśca bhavet tadā siddhaṃ vadet | yadā varṇagandharasotpattistadāpi snehasiddhirbhavet| iti ca lakṣaṇaṃ varṇastailapakvavarṇo raktādiḥ, gandhaḥ sugandhatvaṃ, rasotpattirmadhurādirasotpattiḥ, tadā svedanāllakṣyate | snehapākasya trividhatvamāha - eko mṛdu:, eko madhyaḥ, ekaḥ kharaḥ; evaṃ tridhā snehapākaḥ | teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamāha - īṣatsarasakalkaḥ īṣajjalakalkaḥ mṛdusnehapākaḥ nīrasakomale kalke siddhaḥ pāko madhyapākaḥ nīrasakomale jalasahite ārdre īṣatkaṭhinakalkaḥ snehapākaḥ kharaḥ tadūrdhvaṃ dagdhapāko dāhakṛnniṣprayojanaḥ, na kāryakārī ||12||16|| āmapākaśca nirvīryo vahnimāndyakaro guru: | nasyārthaṃ stanmṛdu: pāko madhyamaḥ sarvakarmasu ||17|| abhyaṅgārthaṃ kharaḥ prokto yuñjyādevaṃ yathohitam | ghṛtatailaguḍādīṃśca sādhayennaikavāsare ||18|| prakurvantyuṣitā hyete viśeṣādguṇasaṃcayam | Dī. idrānīṃ tasya caturvidhapākasya guṇamāha - āmapākaśceti | āmapāko'paripākakalka: sneho nirvīryo bhavati, niḥśeṣeṇa vīryarahita ityarthaḥ | vahnimāndyakṛdbhakṣaṇayoge ca bhavati | nasyaviṣaye mṛdupākaḥ snehaḥ | madhyapākastu sarvakarmasu yujyate sarvakarma nasyābhyaṅgapānādikaṃ | kharapākasnehaḥ kevalābhyaṅge vihitaḥ nānyakarmasu | yathocitamiti yathāyogyaṃ yuṃjyādityarthaḥ | eke nasyābhyaṅge kharaḥ prokta iti paṭhanti, tanna sarvasaṃmatam, nasye tu saumyamāhuḥ | snehastu kimekāhenaiva sādhyaḥ uta dīrghadavasaiḥ tadviṣayamāha - ghṛteti | ghṛtataile prasiddhe guḍo'valehaḥ | ādigrahaṇāt īdṛśasambhārā ye cā'nye prayogāḥ te sarve ekasminneva vāsare na sādhyā: na pācanīyā ityarthaḥ | kutastadāha - prakurvanti ityādi | te snehādayastu yadā uṣitāḥ santi tadā guṇasañcayaṃ prakurvanti | ata eva bahudivasaiḥ kṛtvā sādhanīyā iti bhāvaḥ | tantrāntareṣu etadbahudravyasambhāraviṣayam, asmatsampradāye'pi svalpamapi snehaṃ kiñci- dvipācyāpare'hni siddho'vatāryaḥ guḍādikamapi cāpare'hni madhudānādikamuktaṃ kuryāt naivaṃ sarvamatavirodhaḥ || || 17 || 18 || Gū. āmapākastrividhapākāddhīnaḥ sajala evetyarthaḥ, sa vahnimāndyakaraḥ, tathā guruḥ | yeṣu mṛdvādayaḥ prayujyante, tānāha - nasyārthamiti | nasyārthaṃ mṛdupākaḥ sarvakarmasu, bhakṣaṇāvasthāyāṃ madhyamaḥ, abhyaṅgārthaṃ kharaḥ evaṃ yathocitaṃ yuñjyāt prayojayet, ghṛtatailādīn ekasminneva dine na sādhayet, kutaḥ ? uṣitā rātrau vāsitā viśeṣādguṇasañcayaṃ kurvanti || śārṅgadharānuktamapi tailasādhanam ātreyādāha - “sneho vārisamaṃ nītvā pācayet mṛduvahninā | pañcapallavakalkena dvātriṃśāṃśena saṃyutam || kiṃcitsarasagarbheṇa vastrapūtaṃ prakalpayet | itye- tadduṣṭagandhādidoṣastailādvimucyate || nirdoṣakaraṇādetatkṛtvā tailaṃ vipācayet” iti | granthāntare evaṃ śodhanaṃ - “tailaṃ kṛtvā kaṭāhe dṛḍhataravimale mandamandāgninā ca pakvaṃ niṣphenabhāvaṃ gatamiha hi yadā śaityabhāvaṃ tadaiva | muñjiṣṭhārātrilodhrairjaladharanalikaiḥ sāmalai: sākṣapathyaiḥ sūcīpuṣpāvarohairnayati satataṃ gandhayogaṃ jahāti” || mañjiṣṭhādyairmilitaiḥ agninīraiḥ pādāṃśakaiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pacet, rātrirharidrā, jaladharo mustakaḥ, nalikā gandhanalikā uttaradeśe prasiddhā tadabhāve tvak; sāmalai: sāmalakaiḥ, akṣaṃ bibhītakaṃ, pathyā harītakī, sūcīpuṣpaṃ ketakī, avarohaḥ vaṭāvarohaḥ, cakārāt granthāntare caiva “tailasyendukalāṃśakena vikacā grāhyā tu mūrcchāvidhau ye cānye triphalādayastu rajanīhrīberalodhrānvitāḥ | sūcīpuṣpavaṭāvarohanalikādravyāstu pādāṃśikāḥ procyāstailajagandhadoṣaharaṇe kalkīkṛtāstadvidaiḥ? | vikacā mañjiṣṭhā, indukalāṃśena tailāt ṣoḍaśāṃśena grāhyāḥ, mūrcchāvidhau tailamūrcchāvidhau, ye cānye triphalādayaste militvā kalkīkṛtāḥ | payodo mustā, rajanī haridrā, hrībera udīcyaṃ, lodhraḥ prasiddhaḥ, sūcī- puṣpaṃ ketakī, vaṭāvarohaḥ, nalikā gandhanalikā, tathāca - ‘madhye sāravihīnā ca sarasā kīṭavarjitā | nalikā sā bhavedbhadrā viparītā tu ninditā’ | kecinnalikāṃ tvacamāhuḥ | iti ghṛtatailasādhanaprakāraḥ || || 17 || 18 || atha ghṛtakalpanā sa yathā- pippalīpippalīmūlacavyacitrakanāgaraiḥ || 19 || sasaindhavaiśca palikairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet | kṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ dattvā tadghṛtaṃ plīhanāśanam || 20|| viṣamajvaramandāgniharaṃ rucikaraṃ param | Dī. sa yathetyanena taṃ snehapākasamūhaṃ darśayati granthakāraḥ | tatrādau pūrvaṃ tāvadvṛtakalpanāṃ darśayannāha yatastailādviśiṣṭo ghṛtakalpaḥ pūrvācāryairdarśitaḥ tathaivātrāpi likhitaḥ | prathamataḥ kṣīraṣaṭpalakaghṛtavyākhyānamāha - pippalīti | atra pippalyādikaṃ pañcadravyaṃ pañcakolasaṃjñaṃ boddhavyam, yatastantrāntare pañcakolaghṛtamasya nāma prasiddham, atra cavyamiti viṭapaviśeṣaḥ, yasya phalaṃ gajapippalīti śrutiḥ, palikairiti palapramāṇatā pratyekamāhuḥ | ata eva kṣīraṣaṭpalakaghṛtamidam, caturguṇakṣīreṇa saha ṣaṭpalapramāṇaṣaḍdravyaiśca sādhitamityarthaḥ | atra caturguṇaṃ nīramapi deyam, samyakpākā- rthamityasmatsampradāyābhiprāyaḥ | ghṛtaprasthamiti | ṣoḍaśapalamitam ‘kṣīrasya caturguṇatātra ghṛtaparimāṇāt tatsiddhamiti siddhatā'sya paribhāṣoktavidhānāt ||19||20|| Gū. atha kṣīraṣaṭpalaghṛtam – tatrādau ghṛtādhikāraḥ pippalyādyaiḥ ṣaṭpalaiḥ kalkitairghṛtāccaturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ datvā pacet tad ghṛtaṃ ṣaṭpalaṃ bhavati pippalyādīnāṃ ṣaṭpalatvāt | plīhā dakṣiṇāṅge rogaviśeṣaḥ hṛdayādadhaḥ, viṣamajvaraharaṃ tathā rucikaraṃ, viṣamajvarāḥ saṃtatādayaḥ pañca || 19 || 20 || atha cāṃgerīghṛtaṃ atīsāragrahaṇyoḥ - pippalī pippalīmūlaṃ citrako hastipippalī ||21|| śvadaṃṣṭrā nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ pāṭhā bilvaṃ yavānikā | dravyaiśca palikairetaiścatuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ ghṛtam || 22 || ghṛtāccaturguṇaṃ deyaṃ cāṅgairīsvarasaṃ budhaiḥ | tathā caturguṇaṃ dattvā dadhi sarpirvipācayet ||23|| śanaiḥ śanairvipaktavyaṃ cāṅgerīghṛtamuttamam | tadghṛtaṃ kaphavātaghnaṃ grahaṇyarśovikāranut || 24 || hantyānāhaṃ gudabhraṃśaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pravāhikām | Dī. atha cāṅgerīghṛtamāha - pippalīti | atra hastipippalī gajapippalī, śvadaṃṣṭrā gokṣurakaḥ, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, bilvamatra bilvaśalāṭu, palikairiti palapramāṇaṃ pratyekaṃ, cāṅgerīsvarasamiti cāṅgerī prasiddhā, sācāmlarasā āmacāṅgerīti loke prasiddhā, tasyāḥ svarasamiti sadyorasaṃ, budhairiti grahaṇena sadyorasābhāve kvāthamapi deyam dadhi caturguṇaṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt | śanaiḥ śanaiḥ paktavyamiti mandapācanapācitamiti bhāvo dagdhabhayāt || 21-24 || Gū. hastipippalī gajapippalī, cāṃgerī tatsvarasaḥ dadhi godadhi || 21-24 || atha masūraghṛtam atīsārādau - masūrāṇāṃ palaśataṃ nīradroṇe vipācayet ||25|| pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā datvā bilvapalāṣṭakam | ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacettena sarvātīsāranāśanam ||26|| grahaṇīṃ bhinnaviṭkaṃ ca nāśayecca pravāhikām | Dī. atha masūrādyaṃ ghṛtamapyāha - masūrāṇāmiti | masūro'nnaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, nīradroṇe jaladroṇe catuḥṣaṣṭikuḍavaparimitaṃ bhavati | bilvaṃ palāṣṭakamitaṃ bhavati bilvaṃ bilvamajjā tacca kalkīkṛtaṃ jalena saha deyam, kartavyavidhāvapi masūrāḥ karpaṭabaddhāḥ kvāthyāḥ, mṛdvagninā ca sādhanaṃ kāryam ||25||26|| Gū. sugamam ||25||26|| atha kāmadevaghṛtaṃ raktapittādau - aśvagandhā palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ smṛtam | śatāvarī vidārī ca śālaparṇī balāmṛtā || 27 || aśvatthasya ca śuṅgāni padmabījaṃ punarnavā | kāśmaryāśca phalaṃ caiva māṣabījaṃ tathaiva ca || 28 || pṛthagdaśapalānbhāgān caturdroṇe'mbhasi pacet | droṇe śeṣe rase tasmin paceccaiva ghṛtāḍhakam ||29|| mṛdvīkā padmakaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ pippalī raktacandanam | patrakaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ ca ātmaguptāphalaṃ tathā || 30|| nīlotpalaṃ sārive dve jīvanīyo gaṇastathā | pṛthakvarṣasamānbhāgān śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam || 31|| rasasya pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmāḍhakaikaṃ samāharet | caturguṇena payasā ghṛtāḍhakaṃ vipācayet || 32 || ghṛtametannihantyāśu raktapittamuraḥkṣatam | halīmakaṃ pāṇḍurogaṃ varṇabhedaṃ svarakṣayam || 33 || mūtrakṛcchramurodāhaṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca nāśayet | etatsarpiḥ prayoktavyaṃ bahvanta: puravāsinām || 34 || strīṇāṃ caivāprajātānāṃ durbalānāṃ ca dehinām | śreṣṭhaṃ balakaraṃ varṇyaṃ hṛdyaṃ puṣṭirasāyanam ||35|| ojastejaskaraṃ hṛdyamāyuṣyaṃ prāṇavardhanam| saṃvardhayati śukraṃ hi puruṣaṃ durbalendriyam || 36 || sarvarogavinirmuktau payaḥsikto yathā drumaḥ | kāmadeva iti khyātaṃ sarpiruktaṃ mahāguṇam || 37 || Dī. idānīṃ kāmadevaghṛtavivaraṇaṃ darśayannāha - aśvagandheti | aśvagandhāmūlaṃ palaśataṃ grāhyam tadardho gokṣura iti pañcāśatpalaṃ; gokṣuro'tra pañcāṅgo grāhyaḥ, aparāṇi daśadravyāṇi daśapalamiti pratyekamāhuḥ, tāni kānītyatrāha -śatāvarītyādi sugamam | tatra tu aśvatthasya ca śuṅgānīti pippalaśuṅgāni siddhāni, kāśmarī gambhārī tasyāḥ phalāni, padmabījaṃ prasiddhaṃ ‘kamalagaṭā’ śabdavācyam, māṣabījamiti maṣāḥ pratītaḥ, etat sakalaṃ pānīyadroṇacatuṣṭaye saṃkvāthya pādaśeṣaṃ vastragālitaṃ grāhyam | aparāṇyapi kalkayogyāni dravyāṇyāha - mṛdvīketyādi | mṛdvīkā drākṣā, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ tattu campakavadvṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, ātmaguptā kapikacchuḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalavācyam, tadabhāve kamalabījaṃ grāhyam | sārive dve iti kṛṣṇasārivā śuklasārive | te ‘aphoī’ śabdavācye; kṛṣṇasārivā kalahaṃsavatpatrā sugandhā, śuklasārivā jambūvatpatrā vratatiḥ, jīvanīyo gaṇa iti jīvanīyo jīvantīśākaviśeṣaḥ, tadādisaṃjñako jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ, tathāhi - ‘jīvantī sūryaparṇīyukvākolyau jīvakarṣabhau | mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyo gaṇo mataḥ’ iti | tasyā'prasiddhatvāt tatsāmyaguṇadravyāṇi yojyāni iti vṛddhavaidyānāṃ sammatam, etāni mṛdvīkādīni dravyāṇi pṛthak karṣapramāṇāni grāhyāṇi, śarkarāyāḥ paladvayamiti | kecit siddhe'smin śarkarāyāḥ prakṣepamāhuḥ | rasasya pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmiti | pauṇḍrako vikhyātaḥ ikṣuviśeṣaḥ, ikṣuḥ sāmānyaḥ sa ca lohitekṣu prabhṛtiko yathālābhaṃ grāhyaḥ, nanu ikṣugrahaṇenaiva pauṇḍrakagrahaṇaprāptiḥ tatkathaṃ bhinnagrahaṇam ? ucyate - pauṇḍrakagrahaṇaṃ guṇaprābalyāt kṛtaṃ yataḥ ‘pauṇḍrakaḥ śītalaḥ snigdho bṛṃhaṇo kaphakṛt saraḥ’ iti | tasmāt pauṇḍrako viśeṣeṇātra pācanīyaḥ | asya rasasyāḍhakaṃ pratyekaṃ dvirāḍhakagrahaṇāt ghṛtāḍhakamekam, godugdhaṃ caturāḍhakamiti ||27-37 || Gū. amṛtā guḍūcī, kāśmarī, gambhārī, padyabījaṃ kamalabījaṃ, māṣabījamannaṃ, jīvantīyagaṇaścūrṇoktaḥ, nāgapuṣpaṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, sārive dve śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, dve bale balā nāgabalā, śarkarā sitā; pauṇḍra kekṣūṇāṃ rasaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat ||27-37 || apasmārādau pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ - triphalā dve niśe kauntī sārive dve priyaṅgukā | śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī devadārvyelavālukam || 38 || nataṃ viśālā dantī ca dāḍimaṃ nāgakeśaram | nīlotpalailā mañjiṣṭhā viḍaṅgaṃ kuṣṭhapadmakam || 39 || jātipuṣpaṃ candanaṃ ca tālīsaṃ bṛhatī tathā | etaiḥ karṣasamaiḥ kalkairjalaṃ dattvā caturguṇam || 40 || ghṛtaprasthaṃ paceddhīmānapasmāre jvare kṣaye | unmāde vātarakte ca kāse mandānale tathā || 41 || pratiśyāye kaṭīśūle tṛtīyakacaturthake | mūtrakṛcchre visarpe ca kaṇḍūpāṇḍvāmaye tathā || 42 || viṣadvaye prameheṣu sarvathaivopayujyate | vandhyānāṃ putradaṃ bhūtayakṣarakṣoharaṃ smṛtam || 43 || Dī. atha pānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtam āha - triphaleti | triphalātra harītakīprabhṛtiphalatrayam, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, kauntī reṇukā, sārive dve kṛṣṇaśuklabhedena, priyaṅgurlatāviśeṣaḥ tasyāḥ phalāni, śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī ceti
