kavarādvayaśabdavācyam, elavālukaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ tacca kuṣṭhagandhi ṣaṭphalasadṛśam; nataṃ tagarapādikā, viśālā indravāruṇī, dantī prasiddhā, dāḍimaṃ dāḍimaphalaṃ bījāni ca, nīlotpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, tadabhāve padmabījaṃ dravyaṃ grāhyaṃ, elā bṛhatphalā, jātī mālatī tasyāḥ kusumāni, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, tālīsaṃ svanāmaprasiddham, bṛhatī bṛhatkaṇṭakārikā etāni karṣapramāṇāni pratyekaṃ | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt | ghṛtaprasthamiti kuḍavacatuṣṭayapramitaṃ gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ bhavati kevalapānīyaparipācanāt pānīyakalyāṇakamasya saṃjñārūḍhiḥ ||38-43|| Gū. kauntī reṇukā, elavālukaṃ prasiddhaṃ, viśālā indravāruṇī, dāḍimaṃ prasiddhaṃ tasya bījāni, padmakaṃ jātipuṣpaṃ, mālatīpuṣpāṇi, kalkadravyāt caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ pacet | tatpānīyakalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtaṃ nāmataḥ ||38-43|| amṛtāghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhādau - amṛtākvāthakalkābhyāṃ sakṣīraṃ vipacedghṛtam | vātaraktaṃ jayatyāśu kuṣṭhaṃ jayati dustaram || 44 || Dī. amṛtādyaghṛtavivaraṇamapyāha - amṛteti | amṛtā guḍūcī tasyāḥ kvāthakalkābhyāṃ kṛtvā sakṣīraṃ ghṛtaṃ vipācya vātaraktādike deyam, tena kvāthaścaturguṇajalena siddhaḥ sa ca ghṛtāccaturguṇa iti paribhāṣāyāṃ pratītaḥ | kalkaṃ dṛṣadi peṣitaṃ tacca ghṛtāṃśaṃ tena kalkadravyaṃ ghṛtāccaturthāṃśaṃ deyamityarthaḥ | sakṣīramiti caturguṇaṃ kṣīraṃ ghṛtaparimāṇāt| kecittu snehasamaṃ proktamiti paṭhanti etadapi saṅgataṃ na viruddhaṃ dravāntaratvāt | kalke'pi caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ datvā pācanīyamiti vyavahāraḥ | asya pānamāhurabhyaṅgaṃ ca || 44 || Gū. amṛtā guḍūcī, tasyāḥ kvāthaḥ kalkaśca, kṣīraṃ dugdhaṃ ghṛtāccaturguṇaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat || 44 || atha mahātiktakaghṛtaṃ vātaraktakuṣṭhādau - saptacchadaḥ prativiṣā śyāmākaḥ kaṭurohiṇī | pāṭhā mustamuśīraṃ ca triphalā parpaṭastathā || 45 || paṭolanimbamañjiṣṭhāḥ pippalī padmakaṃ śaṭhī | candanaṃ dhanvayāsaśca viśāle dve niśe tathā || 46 || guḍūcī sārive dve ca mūrvā vāsā śatāvarī | trāyantīndrayavāyaṣṭībhūnimbaścākṣabhāgikāḥ || 47 || ghṛtaṃ caturguṇaṃ dadyādghṛtādāmalakīrasaḥ | dviguṇaḥ sarpiṣaścātra jalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet || 48 || tatsiddhaṃ pāyayetsarpirvātarakteṣu sarvathā | kuṣṭhāni raktapittaṃ ca raktārśāṃsi ca pāṇḍutām ||49|| hṛdrogagulmavīsarpapradaraṃ gaṇḍamālikām | kṣudrarogān jvarāṃścaiva mahātiktamidaṃ jayet ||50|| Dī. idānīṃ mahātiktakaghṛtamāha - saptacchada iti | saptacchadaḥ saptaparṇaśabdavācyaḥ sa ca śālmalīpatrasadṛśo yugmapatraḥ; prativiṣā ativiṣā śyāmāko rājavṛkṣastasya phalaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, viśāle dve itīndravāruṇīdvayaṃ, dve niśe iti haridrādvayaṃ, sārive dve iti śuklakṛṣṇabhedena, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, trāyantī trāyamāṇā, śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ prasiddham, akṣabhāgikāḥ karṣapramāṇāḥ, pratyekaṃ ghṛtaṃ caturguṇamiti pūrvadravyasambhārāt āmalakaphalasvaraso dviguṇo ghṛtaparimāṇāt svarasābhāve kvātho'pi deyaḥ na doṣaḥ, jalaṃ pānīyaṃ cāṣṭaguṇaṃ deyaṃ samyakpākārthaṃ sarpiṣo ghṛtaparimāṇāt, etatsiddhaṃ mahātiktakaṃ nāma ghṛtaṃ vātaraktādiṣu praśastam || 47-50 || Gū. saptacchadaḥ saptapuṭā, prativiṣā ativiṣā, śyāmāka āragvadhaḥ, kaṭurohiṇī kaṭukī, pāṭhā, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikā, parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ. paṭolaṃ phalaśākastasya patrāṇi, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, śaṭhī karcūra:, candanaṃ raktacandanaṃ; dhanvayāsako yavāsakaḥ, viśālā indravāruṇī, dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā ca, dve sārive śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, mūrvā moraṭā, trāyantī trāyamāṇā, indrayavaḥ, yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī, bhūnimbaḥ tiktakam | akṣabhāgikā: pratyekaṃ karṣabhāgāḥ | ghṛtaṃ caturguṇaṃ sarvadravyebhyaścaturguṇaṃ | ghṛtāt dviguṇa āmalakīrasaḥ sarpiṣo ghṛtāt jalamaṣṭaguṇaṃ sarvaṃ paktvā siddhaṃ kārayet | spaṣṭamanyat | mahātiktakaṃ siddhatvāt ||45-50|| atha kāsīsādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ kuṣṭhe dadrūpāmāśira:sphoṭādau - kāsīsaṃ dve niśe mustaṃ haritālaṃ manaḥśilām | kampillakaṃ gandhakaṃ ca viḍaṅgaṃ gugguluṃ tathā || 51 || sikthakaṃ maricaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ tutthakaṃ gaurasarṣapān | rasāñjanaṃ ca sindūraṃ śrīvāsaṃ raktacandanam || 52 || irimedaṃ nimbapatraṃ karañjaṃ sārivāṃ vacām | mañjiṣṭhāṃ madhukaṃ māṃsīṃ śirīṣaṃ lodhrapadmakam ||53|| harītakīṃ prapunnāṭaṃ cūrṇayetkārṣikānpṛthak | tatastaccūrṇamāloḍya triṃśatpalamite ghṛte || 54 || sthāpayettāmrapātre ca gharme sapta dināvadhi | asyābhyaṅgena kuṣṭhāni dadrūpāmāvicarcikāḥ || 55 || śūkadoṣā visarpāśca visphoṭā vātaraktajāḥ | śira:sphoṭopadaṃśāśca nāḍīduṣṭavraṇāni ca || 56 || śotho bhagandaraścaiva lūtāḥ śāmyanti dehinām | śodhanaṃ ropaṇaṃ caiva savarṇakaraṇaṃ ghṛtam || 57 || Dī. adhunā kāsīsādyaghṛtavivaraṇamāha - kāsīsamiti | kāsīsaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ bhasmavadalpabhṛt asya bhedaḥ puṣpakāsīsaṃ, tacca kiñcit pītam, dve niśe dve haridre, kampillako rorīśabdavācyo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, kampilletyapare, sikthakaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ, sindūraṃ prasiddhaṃ śrīvāsaṃ niryāsadravyaṃ rālaśabdavācyaṃ, irimedo viṭkhadira ojaśabdavācyaḥ karañjo bṛhatkarañjo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ loke colā iti prasiddhaḥ | sārivā āsphotā ‘āphoī’ loke; māṃsī gandhamāṃsī jaṭāvadviṭapaḥ, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, prapunnāṭaṃ cakramardabījāni, etāni pṛthak karṣapramitāni cūrṇīkṛtya triṃśatpalaparimite ghṛte āloḍya tāmrapātre | nidhāya gharme dhārayet yāvat sapta dināni bhavanti | etaccādravāgnisiddhaṃ sūryapākasaṃjñamiti boddhavyam | asmatsaṃpradāye tu kalkārhaṃ dravyaṃ kalkībhūtaṃ kṛtvā caturguṇena pānīyena saha ghṛtaṃ vipācya paścāt prakṣepayogyaṃ dravyaṃ cūrṇīkṛtya tatra prakṣipyāloḍya gharme saptadinaṃ yāvaddhārayet evaṃ siddho bhavati | kalkārthaṃ dravyaṃ yathā - haridrāmustaraktacandanerimedanimbapatrakarañjasārivāvacāmañjiṣṭhā- madhumāṃsīśirīṣalodhrapadmakaharītakīprabhṛtikaṃ śeṣaṃ prakṣepārthaṃ jñeyam || 51-57 || Gū. kāsīsaṃ prasiddhaṃ, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, rasāñjanaṃ dārvīkvāthodbhavaṃ prasiddhaṃ, śirīṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, prapunnāṭaṃ cakramardastasya bījāni, etān pṛthak karṣamitān triṃśatpalamite ghṛte tāmrapātre gharme saptadinaṃ sthāpayet || 51-57 || atha vraṇe jātyādighṛtaṃ- jatinimbapaṭolaṃ ca dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī | mañjiṣṭhā madhukaṃ sikthaṃ karañjośīrasārivāḥ || 58 || tutthaṃ va vipacetsamyakvalkairebhirghṛtaṃ budhaḥ | asya lepādvirohanti sūkṣmanāḍīvraṇā api || 59 || marmāśritāḥ kledinaśca gambhīrāḥ sarujo vraṇāḥ | Dī. idānīṃ jātyādikaṃ ghṛtamāha - jātītyādi | jātīnimbapaṭolamityatra trayāṇāṃ patrāṇi grāhyāṇi tantrāntaradarśanāt | tathāca - ‘jātīnimbapaṭolānāṃ naktamālasya pallavā’ ityādi | dve niśe dve haridre, tena haridrā dāruharidrā, kaṭurohiṇī kaṭukī śabdavācyam, madhukaṃ yaṣṭhīmadhu, sikthakaṃ madanakaṃ, karañjo bṛhatkarañjaḥ tasya patrāṇi phalāni vā, uśīraṃ sugandhadravyam | sārivā āsphotā, tutthaṃ haritapāṣāṇavat kṛtrimaṃ dravyaviśeṣaṃ, etat sāmyamānaṃ sakaladravyād ghṛtaṃ caturguṇā sādhyam | atra kalkapācanārthaṃ caturguṇitaṃ jalaṃ deyam | eke sikthatutthayoḥ siddhe prakṣepamāhuḥ | tathāca - ‘prakṣepaṃ kārayeddhīmān siddhe sikthakatutthayoḥ’ ityādi | jātīkādyaṃ gaurādyaṃ ca tailamapi pacyate| tathāca cakraḥ - ‘gaurādyaṃ jātīkādyaṃ ca tailamevaṃ prasādhyate | tailaṃ sūkṣmānane duṣṭe vraṇe gambhīra eva ca’ iti || 58 || 59 || Gū. jātī mālatī tasyāḥ patrāṇi, nimbapatrāṇi, dve niśe haridrā dāruharidrā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu,sikthaṃ karañjamūlaṃ, uśīraṃ sugandhakaṃ, sārivā anantā, tutthaṃ prasiddhaṃ, ebhiḥ kalkairghṛtaṃ pacet kalkadravyāt ghṛtaṃ caturguṇam | asya lepāt sūkṣmā nāḍīvraṇā rohanti || 58 || 59 || atha bindughṛtaṃ jalodaravirecanādau- citrakaṃ śaṅkinī pathyā kampillastrivṛtāyugam ||60|| vṛddhadāruśca śamyāko dantī dantīphalaṃ tathā | kośātakī devadālī nīlinī girikarṇikā ||61|| sātalā pippalīmūlaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ kaṭukī tathā | hemakṣīrī ca vipacetkalkairebhiḥ picūnmitaiḥ ||62|| ghṛtaprasthaṃ snuhīkṣīraṃ ṣaṭpale tu paladvayam | arkakṣīrasya matimāṃstatsiddhaṃ gulmakuṣṭhahṛt ||63|| hanti śūlamudāvartaṃ śothādhmānaṃ bhagandaram | śamayatyudarāṇyaṣṭau nipītaṃ bindusaṃkhyayā || 64 || godugdhenoṣṭradugdhena kaulatthena śṛtena vā | uṣṇodakena vā pītvā binduvegairviricyate || 65 || etadbindughṛtaṃ nāma nābhilepādviricyate | Dī. adhunā bindughṛtamāha - citrakamiti | atra citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ, śaṅkhinī yavatiktā, śaṅkhapuṣpīśabdavācyā, kaṃpillaḥ kaṃvīlā vikhyātā ‘rorī’ śabdavācyamiti kecit | trivṛtāyugamiti śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, ‘niśotha’ dvayaṃ, vṛddhadāru mahāśyāmo dīrghapatraḥ sa ca tridhārāśabdavācyaḥ, śamyākaḥ kṛtamālakaḥ, dantī loke ‘dantivanī’ti vācyā, tasyāḥ phalaṃ jayapālaśabdavācyaṃ, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, kośātakī ghoṣārī, devadālī vallīviśeṣaḥ | girikarṇikā ‘śophandaīśaphanda’ iti prasiddhaḥ | sātalā sehuṇḍabhedaḥ, ‘ghaṭaghava’ iti loke | hemakṣīrī kaṅkuṣṭhaṃ keciccokaśabdavācyamiti vadanti | picūnmitairiti karṣapramāṇaiḥ pratyekamatra kalkārthaṃ toyaṃ caturguṇaṃ deyaṃ vyavahārāt | tathāca - ‘snuhyarkapayasoratra pākārthamupapattitaḥ | caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyam’ ityādi | snuhīkṣīraṃ sehuṇḍasya kṣīraṃ ṣaṭpalapramitaṃ deyam, arkakṣīraṃ tu paladvayamiti vadanti kecit | asmatsaṃpradāye tu aṣṭapalaparimitaṃ snuhīkṣīraṃ etatparimāṇaṃ tu arkakṣīramiti | nipītaṃ bindusaṃkhyayā iti ‘binduḥ syāttarjanīparvadvayamagrārdhato mitaḥ’ iti vyavahārāt | ṣaḍaṣṭamāṣakā deyā binduvegairiti yāvatsaṃkhyān bindūn pibet tāvanmātreṇa viricyata ityarthaḥ | ‘nābhilepādviricyate’ ityanenāsya prabhāvotkṛṣṭatvaṃ darśitam || 60-65 || Gū. śaṅkhinī śaṅkhapuṣpī, pathyā harītakī, kampillaḥ, trivṛtāyugmaṃ niḥsṛtādvayaṃ śvetakṛṣṇabhedena, vṛddhadāruḥ prasiddhaḥ, śamyākaḥ kṛtamālaḥ, dantī jayapālamūlaṃ, dantīphalaṃ jayapālaṃ, kośātakī kaṭurgrāhyā, devadālī vaṃdālī, nīlinī nīlapuṣpī, girikarṇikā aparājitā, śvetapuṣpī parājitā, sātalā sehuṇḍaḥ, hemakṣīrī prasiddhā | picūnmitaiḥ prasthaṃ ghṛtaṃ snuhīkṣīre sehuṇḍadugdhe ṣaṭpale pacet, paladvaye arkakṣīrasya vipacet tatsiddhaṃ bindughṛtaṃ bhavati | binduprayogāt bindughṛtaṃ nāmnā prasiddham || || 60-65 || atha triphalāghṛtaṃ netraroge timirādau - triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ prasthaṃ vāsārasodbhavam || 66 || bhṛṅgarājarasaprasthaṃ prasthamātraṃ payaḥ smṛtam | dattvā tatra ghṛtaprasthaṃ kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pṛthak || 67 || triphalā pippalī drākṣā candanaṃ saindhavaṃ balā | kākolī kṣīrakākolī bhedā maricanāgaram ||68|| śarkarā puṇḍarīkaṃ ca kamalaṃ ca punarnavā | niśāyugmaṃ ca madhukaṃ sarvairebhirvipācayet || 69 || naktāndhyaṃ nakulāndhyaṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ pillaṃ tathaiva ca | netrasrāvaṃ ca paṭalaṃ timiraṃ kācakaṃ jayet || 70|| anye'pi praśamaṃ yānti netrarogāḥ sudāruṇāḥ | traiphalaṃ ghṛtametaddhi pāne nasyādiṣūcitam || 71 || Dī. idānīṃ triphalāghṛtavyākhyānamāha - triphaleti | triphalāyā rasaprasthamiti | svarasābhāve kvāthaḥ kalkaṃ vā pracarati | vāsārasodbhavaṃ prasthamiti vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, bhṛṅgarājo mārkavaḥ loke ghamarāśabdavācyaḥ, ājaṃ payaśchāgīdugdham, eke ‘prasthamājaṃ payaḥ smṛta’mityasyāgre ‘guḍūcyāśca rasaprastham āmalātvagrasaṃ tathā | prasthaṃ prasthaṃ samāhṛtya sarvairebhirghṛtaṃ pacet’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kalkairiti vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ tadyathā - triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ kamalasāmānyatvena raktaṃ nīlaṃ vā; niśāyugmamiti haridrādvayaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, etat siddhaṃ bhojanāgre bhojanamadhye bhojanānte ca vihitam | tathāca tantrāntare - ‘ūrdhvapānamadhaḥpānaṃ madhyapānaṃ ca śasyate’ iti | śarkarāyāḥ siddhe prakṣepamāhureke | naktāndhyādayo netramṛge vikhyātāḥ || 66-71 || Gū. triphalārasaprasthamityatra harītakīsvarasaprasthaḥ, āmalakarasaprasthaḥ, pratyekaṃ triphalāprastho jalaṃ natu ṣaḍāḍhakamitaṃ, kaiśoraguggulvādau nirṇītatvāt | tīsaṭe spaṣṭameva likhitaṃ, - ‘pathyākṣāmalakījale payasi ca cchāge'tha vāsārase bhṛṅgasya svarase vipācitamiti proktaiśca kalkauṣadhaiḥ | kākolītriphalāmṛtotpalakaṇā hyuṣṇā- sitāṣaṣṭikāvyāghrībhiḥ saha netraruk praśamate sarpirmahātraiphalam’ iti || harītakyādīnāṃ svarasastu agnisaṃyogaṃ vinā kartavyaḥ | yadvā svarasaṃ prāpyāgnisaṃyogakaraṇādagnisaṃyogaḥ | svarasaḥ kvāthastatra prasthaṃ harītakī, caturguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā kvāthaḥ, dviguṇaṃ jalaṃ datvā svarasaḥ prasthamātraṃ gṛhyate evamanyeṣām | nanu samuditasya triphalāyāḥ svarasaḥ prasthaḥ, uktāyāṃ ca triphalāyāṃ āmalakīrasasya bhinnagrahaṇāt, tathāca vṛndavaṅgasenādayaḥ ‘triphalāyā rasaprasthaṃ prasthaṃ bhṛṅgarasasya ca | vṛṣasya ca rasaḥ prasthaṃ śatāvaryāśca tatsamam | ajākṣīraṃ guḍūcyāśca āmalakyā rasaṃ tathā | prasthaṃ prasthaṃ samāhṛtya sarvairebhirghṛtaṃ pacet | atra guḍūcīsvarasata āmalakīsvaraso'dhikaḥ, śārṅgadhare tu nāsti tatkathaṃ na virodhaḥ | ucyate, śārṅgadhareṇa tu tīsaṭamataṃ gṛhītamiti tasya na doṣaḥ || 66-71 || atha gaurādyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vraṇe - dve haridre sthirā mūrvā sārivā candanadvayam | madhuparṇī ca madhukaṃ paḍmakeśarapadmakam || 72 || utpalośīramedābhistriphalāpañcavalkalaiḥ | kalkaiḥ karṣamitairetairghṛtaprasthaṃ vipācayet || 73 || visarpalūtāvisphoṭaviṣakīṭavraṇāpaham | gaurādyamiti vikhyātaṃ sarpirviṣaharaṃ param || 74 || Dī. adhunā gaurādyaṃ ghṛtamāha - dve haridre iti | haridrā dāruharidrā, sthirā śāliparṇī, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ, sārivā āsphotā, candanadvayamiti śvetaraktabhedena, madhuparṇī yaṣṭīmadhubhedaḥ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī | kecittu madhuyaṣṭyā eva bhāgadvayaṃ grāhyaṃ dviḥpāṭhāt | padmakaḥ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaḥ, pañcavalkalairityasyāgre ‘jātīnimbapaṭolaṃ ca karañjaṃ tiktasikthakam’ iti paṭhanti tadvahupustakeṣu na dṛśyate| atrāpi kalkapākārthaṃ pānīyaṃ caturguṇamitaṃ deyam | paribhāṣāmatānusārataḥ gaurādikameti | gaurā haridrā || || 72-74 || Gū. dve haridre haridrā dāruharidrā ca, śāliparṇī, mūrvā moraṭā, sārivā anantā, candanadvayaiḥ raktacandanaḥ śvetacandanaḥ, madhuparṇī māṣaparṇī, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, padmakeśaraṃ, padmakaṃ padmakakāṣṭham, utpalaṃ raktakamalaṃ, uśīraṃ medā aṣṭavargoktā pañcavalkalaiḥ vaṭa-udumbara-śirīṣa-parkaṭī-vetasa eṣāṃ valkalaiḥ etaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pratyekaṃ jalapiṣṭaiḥ pacet | gaurā haridrā tadādyatvāt idaṃ gaurādighṛtaṃ spaṣṭamanyat || 72-74 || atha mayūraghṛtaṃ śirorogādau - balāmadhukarāsnābhirdaśamūlaphalatrikaiḥ | pṛthagdvipalikairebhirdroṇanīreṇa pācayet || 75 || mayūraṃ pakṣapittāntrayakṛtpādāsyavarjitam | pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā kṣīraṃ dattvā ca tatsamam ||76|| ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetsamyagjīvanīyaiḥ picūnmitaiḥ | tatsiddhaṃ śirasaḥ pīḍāṃ manyāpṛṣṭhagrahaṃ tathā || 77 || arditaṃ karṇanāsākṣijihvāgalarujo jayet | pāne nasye tathābhyaṅge karṇapūreṣu yujyate || 78 || hemantakālaśiśiravasanteṣu ca śasyate | Dī. atha mayūrādyaṃ ghṛtamāha - balā iti | balā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, rāsnā surabhiḥ, daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | phalatrikaṃ harītakyādi pṛthak dvipalikairebhirityasya sthāne kecit triphalikairiti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | pakṣapittāntrayakṛtpādāsyavarjitaṃ mayūramekaṃ droṇanīreṇeti caturāḍhakamitena pānīyena pācayet, kintu vyavahārataḥ adhikaṃ jalaṃ deyam | yataḥ mayūreṇa saha dravyāṇāṃ kvāthavidhānaṃ bhavati | tathāca cakraḥ ‘daśamūladibhistulyo mayūra iha gṛhyate’ iti | evaṃ militvā yāvatkvāthaṃ bhavati tāvajjalaṃ deyam, tatra ‘kvāthyāccaturguṇaṃ vāri’ ityādi paribhāṣayā jalavyavastheti pūrvavyākhyāpracāraḥ | kṣīraṃ dattvā ca tatsamamiti kvāthasamamityarthaḥ, eke ghṛtasamaṃ kṣīramiti manyante, tadapi saṅgataṃ dravāntaratvāt, jīvanīyaiḥ picūnmitairiti jīvanīyo madhuragaṇaḥ sa yathālābhaṃ grāhyaḥ | picūnmitaiḥ karṣapramāṇaiḥ pratyekaṃ jīvanīyastu kalparūpa ityāhuḥ | etad ghṛtaṃ pānābhyaṅganasyādiṣu yojyam | hemantakālaśiśiravasanteṣu iti | anyathā doṣakṛt syāt | tathāhyuktam ‘hemantakāle śiśire ca sevyaṃ vasantakāle ca mayūrasarpiḥ | uṣṇādvidāhī viṣabhakṣaṇācca varṣāśaradgrīṣmamukheṣvapathyam| āhārajātaṃ hi vihaṃgamasya kīṭāśca sarpāśca sarīsṛpāśca | pipīlikā matkuṇamakṣikāśca tenoṣṇakāleṣvahito mayūra: | tathaiva kāle jaladābhirāme visṛjya śukraṃ caṃ balaṃ ca barhī | kṛśatvamāyātyatidīnabhāvāt śaranmukhe tena vivarjanīyam’ iti || 75-78 || Gū. balā, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, rāsnā, daśamūlaṃ, triphalā etaiḥ ṣoḍaśadravyai: dvipalikaiḥ droṇanīreṇa mayūraṃ kṣiptvā pācayet| pādaśeṣaṃ nayet tatsamaṃ rasasamaṃ kṣīraṃ datvā pacet | ghṛtaprasthaṃ picūnmitaiḥ jīvanīyadravyagaṇaiḥ jīvanīyacūrṇoktaiḥ | kiṃbhūtaṃ mayūraṃ pakṣapitta-aṃtrayakṛtpādaṃ āsyaṃ mukhaṃ tadrahitaṃ | spaṣṭamanyat || 75-78 || atha phalaghṛtaṃ vandhyādoṣe - triphalā madhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī || 79 || viḍaṅgaṃ pippalī mustaṃ viśālā kaṭphalaṃ vacā | dve mede dve ca kākolyau sārive dve priyaṅgukā ||80|| śatapuṣpā hiṅgu rāsnā candanaṃ raktacandanam| jātīpuṣpaṃ tugākṣīrī kamalaṃ śarkarā tathā || 81 || ajamodā ca dantī ca kalkairetaiśca kārṣikaiḥ | jīvadvatsaikavarṇāyā ghṛtaprasthaṃ ca goḥ kṣipet || 82 || caturguṇena payasā pacedāraṇyagomayaiḥ | sutithau puṣyanakṣatre mṛdbhāṇḍe tāmraje tathā || 83 || tataḥ pibecchubhadine nārī vā puruṣo'thavā | etatsarpirnaraḥ pītvā strīṣu nityaṃ vṛṣāyate || 84 || putrānutpādayeddhīmānvandhyāpi labhate sutam | anāyuṣaṃ vā janayedyā ca sūtā punaḥ sthitā ||85|| putraṃ prāpnoti sā nārī buddhimantaṃ śatāyuṣam | etatphalaghṛtaṃ nāma bhāradvājena bhāṣitam || 86 || anuktaṃ lakṣmaṇāmūlaṃ kṣipettatra cikitsakaḥ | Dī. idānīṃ bṛhatphalaghṛtamāha - triphaleti | viśālendravāruṇī, dve mede iti medā mahāmedā, dvau ca kākolyāviti kākolī kṣīrakākolī, sārive dve iti sārivā kṛṣṇasārivā ‘sāva’ iti loke, priyaṅgurlatāviśeṣaḥ, rāsnā surabhī, jātī sumanā tasyāḥ puṣpaṃ, kamalamutpalaṃ śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ subodham | eteṣāṃ pratyekaṃ karṣapramitānāṃ kalkamāhuḥ | jīvadvatsā ekavarṇā vā gaustasyā ghṛtamiti jīvadvatsāprahaṇamiti maṅgalatvāt| caturguṇena payaseti ghṛtaparimāṇāt| āraṇyagomayairiti mandapāvakapācanatvāt, anuktaṃ lakṣmaṇāmūlamiti kvacit paṭhyate | lakṣmaṇā śvetakaṇṭakārikā anye alpaviṭapamāhuḥ, tathāhi - ‘putrakā'kāraraktālpabindubhirlāñchitā sadā | lakṣmaṇā putrajananī bastagandhākṛtirbhavet | śaratkāle bhavati sā phalapuṣpā'nvitā sadā | gṛhṇīyāt puṣyamūlārke hastārke cābhimaṃtrya ca’ ityādi || 79-86 || Gū. madhukaṃ yaṣṭī|, viśālā indravāruṇī, jātīpuṣpaṃ mālatīpuṣpaṃ, tugākṣīrī vaṃśarocanaṃ, śarkarā sitopalā, daṃtī jayapālamūlaṃ, payasā dugdhena | spaṣṭamanyat || 79-86 || atha laghuphalaghṛtaṃ yoniroge - triphalāṃ dve sahacare guḍūcīṃ sapunarnavām | śukanāsāṃ haridre dve rāsnāṃ medāṃ śatāvarīm ||87|| kalkīkṛtya ghṛtaprasthaṃ pacetkṣīre caturguṇe | tatsiddhaṃ pāyayennārīṃ yoniśūlanipīḍitām|| 88 || pīḍitā calitā yā ca niḥsṛtā vivṛtā ca yā | pittayoniśca vibhrāntā ṣaṇḍhayoniśca yā smṛtā ||89|| prapadyante hi tāḥ sthānaṃ garbhaṃ gṛhṇanti cāsakṛt | etatphalaghṛtaṃ nāma yonidoṣaharaṃ param || 90 || Dī. atha laghuphalaghṛtamāha - triphalamiti | sahacare dve pītaraktabhedena (śukanāsā syonākaḥ, rāsnā surabhiḥ) śeṣaṃ dravyaṃ sugamam | etat sakalaṃ ghṛtacaturthāśaṃ grāhyaṃ, kalkaṃ kṛtvā kṣīracaturguṇena saha ghṛtaṃ sādhyam, atra kalkārthaṃ caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ deyam | caturguṇāt snehaparimāṇāt | etad ghṛtaṃ yonidoṣeṣu prāyaśaḥ pracarati palitācalitetyādayo yonigadaviśeṣāḥ kathitāḥ | te tu tatraiva boddhavyā: || 87-90 || Gū. śukanāsā, haridre dve haridrā dāruharidrā, medā aṣṭhavargoktā tadabhāve | (dadhyaṃ) deyaṃ, kalkadravyāṇi ghṛtāt caturthāṃśaghṛtātkṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ pīḍitāyā yoniryonivyāpatsūktā || 87-90|| atha pañcatiktakaṃ ghṛtaṃ viṣamajvarādau - vṛṣanimbāmṛtāvyāghrīpaṭolānāṃ śṛtena ca ||91|| kalkena pakvaṃ sarpistu nihanyādviṣamajvarān | pāṇḍuṃ kuṣṭhaṃ visarpaṃ ca kṛmīnarśāṃsi nāśayet ||92|| Dī. atha pañcatiktakaghṛtamāha - vṛṣeti | āṭarūṣaka:, nimbaḥ prasiddhaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī, vyāghrī kaṇṭakārikā, paṭolaḥ prasiddhaḥ, eteṣāṃ śṛtena kvāthena kvāthārthaṃ dravyaṃ snehadviguṇam | pānīyamatra caturguṇaṃ kvāthaścaturthāvaśeṣo grāhyaḥ | kalkeneti vṛṣādīnāmapi kalkena pākamāhu: | kalkārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ dravyakadambamāhuḥ - pānīyamapyatra caturguṇaṃ śobhanapākārtham | asya pānābhyaṅgamāhuḥ | iti ghṛtaṃ samāptam || 91 || 92 || Gū. vṛṣa āṭarūṣakaḥ eṣāṃ pañcānāṃ śṛtena kvāthena kalkena ca, pakvakalkaṃ ghṛtaṃ pañcatiktakaṃ bhavati || 91 || 92 || iti śrīkāśirāmamiśrakṛtāyāṃ gūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne ghṛtādhikāraḥ || lākṣāḍhakaṃ kvāthayitvā jalasya caturāḍhakaiḥ | caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ nītvā tailaprasthe vinikṣipet || 93 || mastvāḍhakaṃ ca godadhnastatraiva viniyojayet | śatapuṣpāmaśvagandhāṃ haridrāṃ devadāru ca || 94 || kaṭukīṃ reṇukāṃ mūrvāṃ kuṣṭhaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭikām | candanaṃ mustakaṃ rāsnāṃ pṛthakvarṣapramāṇataḥ || 95 || cūrṇayettatra nikṣipya sādhayenmṛduvahninā | asyābhyaṅgātpraśāmyanti sarve'pi viṣamajvarāḥ||96|| kāsaśvāsapratiśyāyatrikapṛṣṭhagrahāstathā | vātaṃ pittamapasmāramunmādaṃ yakṣarākṣasān || 97 || kaṇḍūṃ śūlaṃ ca daurgandhyaṃ gātrāṇāṃ sphuraṇaṃ jayet | puṣṭagarbhā bhavedasya garbhiṇyamyaṅgato bhṛśam || 98 || Dī. idānīṃ tailakalpanāyāṃ prathamato lākṣāditailamāha - lākṣāḍhakamiti | atra lākṣārasaṃ tailāccaturguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ lākṣāyā āḍhakamapi niryāsatvādbahutaraṃ mastvāḍhakamapi tailāccaturguṇaṃ jñeyamityarthaḥ | godadhna iti godadhisaṃbhavaṃ mastu na tu dadhyāḍhakamapi taile pacanīyaṃ yatastantrāntare'pi ‘lākṣārasaṃ samādāya tailaprasthāccaturguṇam | mastunaścāḍhakaṃ dadyāddravyairebhiśca kārṣikaiḥ’ ityādi | dadhigrahaṇamatra dadhisaṃbhavamastuprāptinimittaṃ kṛtaṃ, yataḥ mastu saptavidhaṃ bhavati ‘svādvamlamatyamlakamandajātaṃ tathā mṛtakṣīrabhavaṃ saraśca| asāramevaṃvidhasaptamastuvarge smṛtaṃ mastuguṇāstathaiva’ iti | dravyāṇyatra prasiddhāni, kecittu ‘kuṣṭhaṃ ca madhuyaṣṭhikām’ ityasyāgre mañjiṣṭhāpadmakośīramāṃsīlohitacandanam’ iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | kalkāttailaṃ caturguṇaṃ iti paribhāṣayā yaddravyagrahaṇaṃ tadanuktakalkaparimāṇārthaṃ manoharam, cūrṇayedityatra cūrṇopalakṣitatvāt prathamaṃ cūrṇībhūtaṃ kṛtvā paścāddṛṣadi peṣitaṃ kuryāditi bhāvaḥ | trikapṛṣṭhagrahā iti tṛtīyakajvarabhedaḥ kathitaḥ, yataḥ ‘kaphapittāt trikagrāhī pṛṣṭhādvātakaphātmakaḥ’ iti vacanāt | yadyapi pūrvaṃ viṣamajvaragrahaṇenaiva tṛtīyakajvaraprāptistathāpi viśeṣeṇa tṛtīyakajvaranāśane'sya prabhāva ityadoṣaḥ | asya tailasyābhyaṅgāt garbhiṇī strī puṣṭagarbhā bhavet iti pānādvāsyeti kecit || 93-98 || Gū. atha tailāni | lāśāḍhakaṃ caturāḍhake jale kvāthayitvā caturthāṃśaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nītvā tailaprasthe vinikṣipet āḍhakaṃ godadhnaḥ mastu dadhijalaṃ tatraiva nikṣipet, śatapuṣpādīni pṛthak karṣapramāṇataḥ kalkaṃ kṛtvā tatra nikṣipya mṛduvahninā tailaṃ sādhayet, tailaṃ tilatailaṃ, śatapuṣpā prasiddhā, haridrā śuddhā grāhyā, ṭaṅkaṇādibhiḥ yadvāri nikṣipyate tailaṃ pītaṃ syāt | candanaṃ taile anuktānyapi sugandhadravyāṇi deyāni, saurabhārthaṃ yathā- karpūraśvetacandanakeśaralavaṅgajātipatrījātiphalaṃ sihlakamañjiṣṭhānalikā-kuṣṭha-pataṃgabharjitanakhāni karṣamātrāṇi saugandhīni prayojayet; anuktānyapi lākṣādau saurabhārthaṃ mahībhṛtaṃ | nanu granthāntare tailātsamo lākṣārasaḥ atra caturguṇaḥ, tathāca - ‘mūrvāvṛṃdārukarakāmadhukāsragandhārāsnāhareṇumisicandanarugniśābhiḥ | lākṣārasena ca samena samastasiddhaṃ tailaṃ jvarāpaharametadatiprasiddham’ iti tatkatham ? ucyate - aśvinīkumāramate tailāccaturguṇaṃ lākṣārasaḥ iti ato na doṣaḥ, tathāca ‘lākṣārasāḍhake prasthaṃ tailasya vipacedbhiṣak | mastvāḍhakasamāyuktaṃ piṣṭvā cātra samācaret’ ityādi | atra lākṣākvāthe svarjikāpalaṃ lodhraṃ palaṃ cūrṇitaṃ adhikaraktavarṇārthaṃ kṣipet asyābhyaṃgāt jvarādayaḥ saṃyānti || 93-98 || (aṅgāratailam )- mūrvā lākṣā haridre dve mañjiṣṭhā sendravāruṇī | bṛhatī saindhavaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ rāsnā māṃsī śatāvarī ||99 || āranālāḍhake tatra tailaprasthaṃ vipācayet | tailamaṅgārakaṃ nāma sarvajvaravimokṣaṇam ||10.|| atha vātarogādau nārāyaṇatailam - aśvagandhāṃ balāṃ bilvaṃ pāṭalāṃ bṛhatīdvayam | adaṃṣṭrātibalā nimbaṃ syonākaṃ ca punarnavā || 101|| prasāriṇīmagnimanthaṃ kuryāddaśapalaṃ bhiṣak | caturdroṇe jale paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet ||102|| tailāḍhakena saṃyojya śatāvaryā rasāḍhakam | kṣipettatra ca gokṣīraṃ tailāttasyāccaturguṇam ||103|| śanairvipācayedebhiḥ kalkairdvipalikaiḥ pṛthak | kuṣṭhailācandanabalāmāṃsīśaileyasaindhavaiḥ || 104 || aśvagandhāvacārāsnāśatapuṣpendradārubhiḥ | parṇīcatuṣṭayenaiva tagareṇa ca sādhayet || 105 || tattailaṃ nāvane'bhyaṅge pāne bastau ca yojayet | pakṣāghātaṃ hanustambhaṃ manyāstambhaṃ galagraham ||106|| khallatvaṃ badhiratvaṃ ca gatibhaṅgaṃ kaṭigraham | gātraśoṣendriyadhvaṃsāvasṛkśukrajvarakṣayān ||107|| annavṛddhiṃ kuraṇḍaṃ ca dantarogaṃ śirograham | pārśvaśūlaṃ ca pāṅgulyaṃ buddhihāniṃ ca gṛdhrasīm ||109|| anyāṃśca viṣamānvātāñjayetsarvāṅgasaṃśrayān | asya prabhāvādvandhyāpi nārī putraṃ prasūyate || 109 || martyo gajo vā turagastailādasmātsukhī bhavet | yathā nārāyaṇo devo duṣṭadaityavināśanaḥ || 110|| tathaiva vātarogāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ tailamuttamam | Dī. atha nārāyaṇatailavyākhyānamāha - aśvagandhāmiti | atrāśvagandhādīni prasiddhāni, eteṣāṃ mūlaṃ grāhyam | kecittu “śvadaṃṣṭrātibalābhadram” iti paṭhanti | tatra bhadraḥ pāribhadro raktakusumaḥ kaṇṭako vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ svanāmnā prasiddhaḥ, phalahadāmūlamityanye tadabhāve devadāru grāhyam | daśapalamiti pratyekam | pādaśeṣamiti droṇamekaṃ, śatāvarī prasiddhā, tasyāḥ sadyoraso yantrapīḍanādinā grāhyaḥ tadabhāve kvathitaraso vā | tatra gokṣīraṃ kṣipediti | tatra taile cakārādājaṃ vā grāhyam, granthāntaradarśanācca | tathāhi - “ājaṃ vā yadi gavyaṃ ca” ityādi | kutracidgavyājapayasoryadyapi guṇasāmyaṃ tathāpi chāgīkṣīreṇa pakvamanabhiṣyandi tridoṣaharaṃ ca bhavati | kalkairiti kalkārdradravyaiḥ pṛthag dvipalikairityarthaḥ | tadyathā kuṣṭhailetyādi | atra candanaṃ śvetaṃ śaileyaṃ śilāpuṣpaṃ balā atibalā indradāru devadāru parṇīcatuṣṭayeneti tena śāliparṇī, pṛṣṭhiparṇī, māṣaparṇī, mudgaparṇī ceti parṇīcatuṣṭayaṃ kathitam, tagaraṃ tagarapādikā tadabhāve granthiparṇamiti sarvatra | etatsiddhaṃ tailaṃ nāvanādiṣu yojyam, khallatvaṃ mandavacanam, indriyadhvaṃsa itīndriyaviṣayanāśaḥ| gajaturagāvapi vātavikārapīḍitau| kecittu sugandhārthamavataraṇasamaye sugandhadravyāṇyanuktānyapi prakṣipanti | tadyathā - ‘samaṅgānakhakaṅkolanalikājātikoṣakam | tvak kunduruṣkakarpūraturuṣkaśrīnivāsakaṃ || spṛkvākuṅkumakastūrī dadyādatrāvatārite ’ iti | evamanyatrāpi boddhavyam | asya granthāntare patrakalkasaṃjñā yataḥ ‘gandhaniryāsapuṣpāṇāṃ siddhe śīte'vatārite | prakṣepo gandhavṛddhyarthaṃ patrakalkaṃ tu tadviduḥ’ iti | nārāyaṇasaṃjñā viṣṇukṛtatvāt śatāvarī sādhanādvā jñeyā | yataḥ nārāyaṇīti śatāvaryāḥ paryāyo'sti | yadvā'traivoktatvāt ‘yathā nārāyaṇo devo duṣṭadaityavināśanaḥ | tathedaṃ vātarogāṇāṃ nāśanaṃ tailamuttamam’ iti | ata eva nārāyaṇasaṃjñā | śatāvarīsādhanāt śatāvarī nārāyaṇatailasaṃjñā iti prasiddhiḥ || ||101-110|| Gū. atha nārāyaṇaṃ tailaṃ vātavyādhau - aśvagandhā hṛyagandhā, balā prasiddhā, bilvaṃ bilvamūlaṃ, pāṭalā, bṛhatīdvayaṃ laghubṛhatkaṇṭakārī, śvadaṃṣṭrā gokṣuraḥ, atibalā gāṅgerukī, nimbatvak, syonākaḥ araluḥ, punarnavā, prasāriṇī pūrvadeśe prasiddhā, agnimanthaḥ araṇiḥ, balādikaṃ daśapalaṃ caturdroṇe jale paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet tailāḍhakena saṃyojya pacet śatāvaryā rasaṃ ca āḍhakaṃ pacet tailāt caturguṇaṃ gokṣīraṃ pacet ādau tailam atīva taptaṃ kṛtvā pañcapalaṃ datvā saṃśodhya dugdhe pacet tataḥ śatāvarīrase pacet tataḥ kvāthe pacet tataḥ kalkadravye pacet kalkadravyāṇi kuṣṭhādīni elā candanaṃ bālakam udīcyaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, śaileyaḥ saindhavam, indradāru devadāru, parṇīcatuṣṭayena śāliparṇī māṣaparṇī mudgaparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇīti | ebhiḥ kalkadravyairjalapiṣṭaiḥ pacet| sagandhā ādikā candanamalayāgarū ādīni paścāddīyante'nuktānyapi || 101-110|| (vāruṇītailaṃ kamparoge) vāruṇyā auttaraṃ mūlaṃ kuṭṭitaṃ tu palatrayam | paladvādaśakaṃ tailaṃ kṣaṇaṃ vahnau vipācitam || 111 || niṣkatrayaṃ bhaktayuktaṃ sevetāsmādvinaśyati | hastakampa: śiraḥkampaḥ kampo manyāśirābhavaḥ||112|| atha balādyaṃ tailaṃ vātavyādhau - balāmūlakaṣāyeṇa daśamūlaśṛtena ca || 113 || kulatthayavakolānāṃ kvāthena payasā tathā | aṣṭāṣṭabhāgayuktena bhāgamekaṃ ca tailataḥ ||114 || gaṇena jīvanīyena śatāvaryendradāruṇā | mañjiṣṭhākuṣṭhaśaileyatagarāgarusaindhavaiḥ ||115|| vacāpunarnavāmāṃsīsārivādvayapatrakaiḥ | śatapuṣpāśvagandhābhyāmelayā ca vipācayet||116|| garbhārthinīnāṃ nārīṇāṃ narāṇāṃ kṣīṇaretasām | vyāyāmakṣīṇagātrāṇāṃ sūtikānāṃ ca yujyate ||117|| rājayogyamidaṃ tailaṃ sukhināṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | balātailamiti khyātaṃ sarvavātāmayāpaham || 118 || Dī. idānīṃ balātailamāha - balāmūleti | balāmūlakaṣāyeṇeti kaṣāyo'tra kvātharūpaḥ kalkasvarūpo veti kecit | daśamūlaṃ prasiddham | tacchṛtena kvāthenetyarthaḥ | kulatthayavakolānāṃ militvā kvāthyaḥ | payo'tra gavyamājaṃ vā | aṣṭāṣṭabhāgayukteneti tena balakvāthasyāṣṭau bhāgāḥ | tailabhāgāpekṣayā daśamūlakvāthasyāpyaṣṭau saṃmilitayavādīnāṃ kvāthasyāpyaṣṭau payasaścāṣṭau bhāgāḥ tailasyaiko bhāgaḥ | jīvanīyagaṇo madhuravargaḥ, tadyathā - ‘jīvaṃtī sūryaparṇīyuk kākolyau jīvakarṣabhau | mede yaṣṭīti madhuro jīvanīyagaṇo mataḥ’ iti | śeṣaṃ subodham, tantrāntare'sya daśapākabalātailamiti saṃjñā tatraiva yathoktamānena daśavāraṃ yāvat paktavyam | vīryotkarṣārthaṃ bahupākena snehakṣayo'pyatra nāsti kṣīragatasnehapūraṇāt | etadabhiprāyeṇaiva kecidityatra manyante tadyathā - balāmūlakaṣāyeṇaikaḥ pākaḥ, daśamūlaśṛtena dvitīyaḥ, kulatthādīnāṃ pṛthak trayaḥ pākāḥ, tatra kulatthādīnāṃ pṛthak tailādaṣṭaguṇo jñeyaḥ, payasā ṣaṣṭhaḥ pākaḥ, jīvanīyaśṛtena saptamaḥ, śatāvarīrasenāṣṭamaḥ, devadāruśṛtena kevalena navamaḥ, devadāruparimāṇaṃ kvāthavat | yataḥ jīvanīyagaṇaśatāvarīdevadārūṇāṃ trayaḥ pākāstṛtīyāntapadatvena vyākhyātāḥ, vakṣyamāṇaṃ mañjiṣṭhādikalkena daśama iti | tasmāddaśapākabalā iti saṃjñāmasya vadanti kecit | asmatsaṃpradāye pūrvapakṣaḥ pracarati | kecittu sakaloci- tadravyairdaśavāraṃ yāvat pākasya punarāvṛttirbhavatīti manyante tadavyavahārādasaṅgatam || 113-118 || Gū. balā prasiddhā, tanmūlakaṣāyeṇa tathā daśamūlaśṛtena tathā kulatthādīnāṃ trayāṇāṃ kvāthena; - kolaṃ badaraṃ, payasā dugdhena, balādīnāmaṣṭau bhāgāḥ, tailasyaikaḥ evaṃ pacet | paścāt jīvanīyādibhiḥ kalkīkṛtaiḥ pācayet | jīvanīyo gaṇaḥ cūrṇoktaḥ, śaileyaḥ prasiddhaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 113-118 || vātakaphāmayādau prasāriṇītailamāha - prasāriṇīpalaśataṃ jaladroṇena pācayet | pādaśiṣṭaḥ śṛto grāhyastailaṃ dadhi ca tatsamam|| 119|| kāñjikaṃ ca samaṃ tailātkṣīraṃ tailāccaturguṇam | tailāttathāṣṭamāṃśena sarvakalkāni yojayet || 120|| madhukaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ citrakaḥ saindhavaṃ vacā | prasāriṇī devadāru rāsnā ca gajapippalī || 121|| bhallātaḥ śatapuṣpā ca māṃsīcaibhirvipācayet | etattailavaraṃ pakvaṃ vātaśleṣmāmayāñjayet || 122 || kaubjaṃ paṅgutvakhañjatve gṛdhrasīmarditaṃ tathā | hanupṛṣṭhaśirogrīvākaṭīstambhaṃ ca nāśayet || 123 || anyāṃśca viṣamānvātānsarvānāśu vyapohati | Dī. prasāriṇīti | prasāriṇī prasiddhā tanmūlaṃ kuṭṭayitvā palaśataṃ saṃgṛhya droṇaparimitena jalena saṃkvāthya pādāvaśeṣo grāhyaḥ, tena samaṃ tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavaṃ grāhyam, droṇastu caturāḍhaka iti | āḍhakaścatuḥṣaṣṭipalamityarthaḥ | dadhi ca tailasamaṃ kāñjikamapi tailasamaṃ kṣīraṃ caturguṇaṃ tailaparimāṇāt | tailasyāṣṭamāṃśena kṛtvā vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ bhāgaḥ | tatra madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu, bhallāto bhallātakaphalaṃ, māṃsī jaṭākhyā | etacca tantrāntareṣu kubjaprasāriṇītailamiti saṃjñitaṃ kaubje'tyarthaṃ vihitatvāt | hanupṛṣṭhaśirogrīvākaṭīstambhamiti tena stambhaśabdo hanvādibhi: pratyekamabhisambadhyate||119-123|| Gū. athaprasāriṇītailaṃ | prasāriṇī gandhamādālipūrvadeśe; palaśate droṇajale pācayet, pādaśeṣam āḍhakaṃ gṛhyate, tailaṃ tatsamam | āḍhakamiti | dadhi tailasamaṃ kāñjikaṃ ca tailātsamaṃ tailādaṣṭamāṃśena kalkāni dravyāṇi tāni madhukādīni madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu spaṣṭamanyat || 119-123 || atha māṣāditailaṃ vātavikārādau - māṣo yavātasī kṣudrā sarkaṭī ca kuraṇṭakaḥ || 124 || gokaṇṭaṣṭuṇṭukaścaiṣāṃ kuryātsaptapalaṃ pṛthak | caturguṇāmbunā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet ||125|| kārpāsāsthīni badaraṃ śaṇabījaṃ kulatthakam | pṛthakcaturdaśapalaṃ caturguṇajale pacet || 126 || caturthāṃśāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca gṛhṇīyātkvāthamuttamam | prasthaikaṃ chāgamāṃsasya catuḥṣaṣṭipale jale ||127|| nikṣipya pācayeddhīmānpādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet | tailaprasthe tata: sarvānkvāthānetānvinikṣipet ||128|| kalkairebhiśca vipacedamṛtākuṣṭhanāgaraiḥ | rāsnāpunarnavairaṇḍaiḥ pippalyā śatapuṣpayā ||129 || balāprasāriṇībhyāṃ ca māṃsyā kaṭukayā tathā | pṛthagardhapalairetaiḥ sādhayenmṛduvahninā || 130|| hanyāttailamidaṃ śīghraṃ grīvāstambhāpabāhukau | ardhāṅgaśoṣamākṣepamūrustambhāpatānakau ||121|| śākhākampaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ viśvācīmarditaṃ tathā | māṣādikamidaṃ tailaṃ sarvavātavikāranut || 132 || Dī. samprati māṣāditailamāha - māṣa iti | māṣādiṭuṇṭukāntaṃ dravyaṃ pṛthaksaptapalamitaṃ militvā ṣaṭpañcāśatpalāni bhavanti | tatra atasī umābījaṃ, kṣudrā kaṇṭakārikā, markaṭī kapikacchuḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, gokaṇṭaḥ gokṣurakaḥ, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ, kārpāsāsthiprabhṛti kulatthāntaṃ pṛthakcaturdaśapalaṃ, tena militvā ṣaṭpañcāśatpalāni bhavanti | atra badaraṃ badarīphalāni | chāgamāṃsasyehāpyuktaparimāṇasya kvāthaḥ tailasya prasthaṃ | kvāthānetāniti pūrvoktān ebhistribhirdravairmilitvā cāturguṇyaṃ dravatvāt tailabhāgādityarthaḥ | kalkārthadravyāṇyapi pṛthagardhapalamitāni bhavanti | tatrāmṛtā guḍūcī, nāgaraṃ śuṇṭhī, eraṇḍaḥ eraṇḍamūlaṃ, śatapuṣpā misī, māṃsī jaṭākhyā, kaṭukā rohiṇī | etat tailaṃ prāyeṇa nāsyārthamāhuḥ | ‘sarvavātavikāranut’ ityanena vātanāśanāyātra pracurataramasya māhātmyaṃ darśitam ||124-132 || Gū. māṣo'nnaviśeṣaḥ, yavaḥ, atasī, kṣudrā kaṇṭakārī, markaṭī kapikacchuḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ pītavāsā, gokaṇṭakaḥ gokṣuru:, ṭuṇṭukaḥ syonākaḥ eṣāṃ pṛthak samapalaṃ caturguṇāmbunā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ kvāthaṃ nayet| kārpāsakāsthi, badarī badaraṃ, śaṇabījaṃ, kulatthaṃ, pṛthakcaturdaśapalaṃ badarādikaṃ caturguṇe jale pacet | caturthāṃśāvaśiṣṭam uttamaṃ kvāthaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, chāgamāṃsasya prasthaikaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalairvinikṣipya pācayet | pādaśeṣe rasaṃ nayet tailaprasthe etān kvāthānnikṣipya pacet | punaḥ amṛtādyaiḥ kalkaiḥ pacet pṛthagardhapalairamṛtādyaiḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī, rāsnā, prasāriṇī gandhamādāli, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, kaṭukī spaṣṭamanyat ||124-132 || atha śatāvarītailaṃ vātādau - śatāvarī balāyugmaṃ parṇyau gandharvahastakaḥ | aśvagandhā śvadaṃṣṭraśca bilvaḥ kāśaḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ ||133|| etān sārdhapalānbhāgānkalkayecca vipācayet | caturguṇena nīreṇa pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet || 194 || niyojya tailaprasthe ca kṣīraprasthaṃ vinikṣipet | śatāvarīrasaprasthaṃ jalaprasthaṃ ca yojayet || 135 || śatāvarīdevadārumāṃsītagaracandanam | śatapuṣpā balā kuṣṭhamelā śaileyamutpalam ||136|| ṛddhirmedā ca madhukaṃ kākolī jīvakastathā | eṣā karṣasamaiḥ kalkaistailaṃ gomayavahninā ||137 || pacettanmūrdhatailena naraḥ strīṣu vṛṣāyate | nārī ca labhate putraṃ yoniśūlaṃ ca naśyati ||138|| aṅgaśūlaṃ śiraḥśūlaṃ kāmalāṃ pāṇḍutāṃ garam | gṛdhrasīplīhaśoṣāṃśca mehāndaṇḍāpatānakam ||139|| sadāhaṃ vātaraktaṃ ca vātapittagadārditam | asṛgdaraṃ tathādhmānaṃ raktapittaṃ ca naśyati ||140|| śatāvarītailamidaṃ kṛṣṇātreyeṇa bhāṣitam | oum nārāyaṇyai svāhā || uttarābhimukho bhūtvā khanetkhadiraśaṅkunā ||141 || oum sarvavyādhināśinyai svāhā | ityutpāṭanamantraḥ | oum kumārījīvanyai svāhā | iti pānamantraḥ | Dī. atha śatāvarītailamapyāha - śatāvarīti | śatāvarī divyauṣadhiḥ balāyugmamiti balā atibalā nāgabalā, parṇyau dve te śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī ceti, gandharvahastakaḥ eraṇḍaḥ, śvadaṃṣṭro gokṣurakaḥ, bilva ityatra bilvamūlaṃ, kāśaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya mūlaṃ, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, asyāpi mūlameva | etān sārdhapalān bhāgāniti | etān pūrvoktān bhāgāniti, pṛthagbhūtān sārdhapalāniti, ardhapalena saha palaṃ tena ṣaṭkarṣamitaṃ pratyekamāhuḥ | militvā prasthamekam | jalaprasthaṃ ca yojayediti | jalaṃ pānīyaṃ taccātra kalkapākārthamabhihitam | tat kalkadravyamāha śatāvarītyādi | tatra māṃsī gandhākhyā, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, candanaṃ śvetaṃ, śaileyaṃ śilāpuṣpam, utpalaṃ kamalaṃ, tadabhāve padmabījam | ṛddhyādi jīvakāntadravyasyālābhāt tatsāmyaguṇadravyaṃ prayojyamiti sarvatra | gomayavahnineti grahaṇaṃ mṛdvagnisādhanārthaṃ | mūrdhataileneti śreṣṭhatailena tathā mūrdhni pūritena tailenetyarthaḥ | naraḥ puruṣaḥ asya pānādabhyaṅgato vā strīṣu vṛṣāyate harṣaṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ | kṛṣṇātreyeṇeti kṛṣṇātreyaḥ punarvasuriti tena kathitamityarthaḥ | atra kvāthasvarasakalkārthaṃ yat śatāvarīmūlaṃ proktaṃ tadanenaiva mantreṇotpāṭyam, kutaḥ ? vandhyāpatyādikaraṇārthaṃ; tadyathā - vakṣyamāṇenoṅkārapūrvakāṣṭākṣaramantreṇa kṛtvottarābhimukho bhūtvā khadiraśaṅkunā khadirakāṣṭhakīlakena khanet | paścāt oumṅkārasahitenaikādaśākṣaramantreṇotpāṭanaṃ kuryāt | mantrastvasyāgre kathitaḥ | atha pānamantramāha oumkārayutena daśākṣareṇa mantreṇa snehapānamiti | ete mantrāḥ mūle prasiddhāḥ te tata eva jñātavyāḥ śatāvarī divyauṣadhirityanena yāḥ sarvāḥ śatāvarīsadṛśā oṣadhyastāḥ sarvā evameva grāhyā ityarthaḥ || 133-141 || Gū. balāyugmaṃ gāṃgerukī, parṇyau śāliparṇī pṛṣṭhiparṇī, gandharvahastakaḥ eraṇḍaḥ, śvadaṃṣṭraḥ gokṣuraḥ, kāśaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ, pītavāsā eṣāmardhapalān pṛthageva | śaileyaḥ prasiddhaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 133-141 || kāsīsaṃ lāṅgalī kuṣṭhaṃ śuṇṭhī kṛṣṇā ca saindhavam | manaḥśilāśvamāraśca viḍaṅgaṃ citrako drumaḥ ||142|| dantī kośātakībījaṃ hemāhvā haritālakam | kalkaiḥ karṣamitairetaistailaprasthaṃ vipācayet ||143|| snuhyarkapayasī dadyātpṛthagdvipalasaṃmite | caturguṇaṃ gavāṃ mūtraṃ datvā samyakprasādhayet ||144|| kathitaṃ kharanādena tailamarśovināśanam | kṣāravatpātayatyetadarśāṃsyabhyaṅgato bhṛśam ||145|| valīrna dūṣayatyetatkṣārakarmakaraṃ smṛtam || Dī. idānīm aparāṇi kṣudratailānyāha - tatrādau arśādau kāsīsādyaṃ tailaṃ darśayannāha - kāsīsamiti | kāsīsaṃ dravyaviśeṣaḥ, bhasmavadalpamṛt tadbhedaḥ puṣpakāsīsaṃ kiṃcitpītam, lāṅgalī kalihārikā, kṛṣṇapippalī, aśvamāraḥ karavīrakaḥ drumaḥ, kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, kośātakī jālinī tasyā bīja- miti, hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī sattā tu raktakṣīrasehuṇḍabhedaviśeṣā yasyā mūlaṃ coka iti prasiddham | tailaprasthamiti catuṣkuḍavam | snuhyarkapayasī iti snuhī sehuṇḍaḥ, arkaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tayoḥ payasā pṛthak dvipalamitena sādhitamityarthaḥ | gomūtraṃ caturguṇamatra tailaparimāṇāt | kharanādācāryeṇa kathitamidaṃ durnāmanikṛntanārtham, etacca kṣārakarmakaratvena na gudadūṣakamityarthaḥ || 142-145 || Gū. atha kāsīsādyaṃ tailaṃ arśoroge | kāsīsaṃ, lāṅgalau kalihārī, manaḥśilā, snuhī arkaḥ, - anayordugdhaṃ pṛthak dvipalaṃ kāsīsādyaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ ebhistailaprasthaṃ pacet || 142-145 || atha piṇḍatailaṃ vātarakte - mañjiṣṭhāsārivāsarjayaṣṭīsikthaiḥ palonmitaiḥ || 146|| piṇḍākhyaṃ sādhayettailamabhyaṅgādvātaraktanut | Dī. atha piṇḍatailamāha - mañjiṣṭheti | atra sārivā āsphotā sā ca dvividhā śuklā kṛṣṇā ca yā jambūvatpatravratatiḥ sā śuklā yā kalahaṃsavatpatrā sugandhā sā kṛṣṇeti, sarjo dhūpanaḥ loke rāla iti prasiddhaḥ | yaṣṭī madhuyaṣṭī siktho madhūcchiṣṭaḥ ‘mayana’ śabdavācya:, etaddravyaṃ tailāṃśaṃ kalpyam aṃśaścaturthāṃśaḥ | granthāntare payonvitairiti pāṭhaḥ tatra payaḥ kṣīraṃ tacca dravatvāccaturguṇaṃ tailaparimāṇāt naitanmanoharam, yataḥ piṇḍākhyatvena sakalaṃ dravyaṃ kṣīreṇa piṇḍaphalasadṛśaṃ kalkībhūtaṃ kṛtvā sādhayediti saṃpradāyo bahūnāṃ dṛśyate ata eva piṇḍākhyamiti piṇḍībhūtattvāt piṇḍanāmakaṃ tailaṃ piṇḍatailamityarthaḥ | piṇḍarūpatvāt kalko'sya na gholanīya ityāhuḥ | tailamatrairaṇḍajamapi gṛhṇanti anyato darśanāt tathāhi - ‘sārivā sarjayaṣṭyāhvā madhūcchiṣṭaiḥ payonvitaiḥ| siddhamairaṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ vātaraktarujāpaham’ iti | payo'tra sāmānyatvādgavyam ||146 || Gū. mañjiṣṭhā, sārivā anantā, sarjaḥ, madhukaṃ, siktham etaiḥ palonmitaiḥ kalkadravyāccaturguṇaṃ tailaṃ datvā pacet ||146|| kuṣṭharogādau arkatailam -- arkapatrarase pakvaṃ haridrākalkasaṃyutam || 147 || nāśayetsārṣape tailaṃ pāmāṃ kacchūṃ vicarcikām | Dī. athārkatailamāha - arketi | arkapatrasvaraso'tra caturguṇastailaparimāṇāditi vyavahāraḥ dravyatvāt | haridrā caturthāṃśā tailamānāt asyāḥ kalkārthaṃ jalamāhuḥ | tasya mānaṃ yāvat kalkaṃ syāt sārṣapagrahaṇaṃ vyādhivihitatvāt | pāmādayo rogāḥ kuṣṭharoge paṭhitāḥ || 147 || atha maricāditailaṃ kuṣṭhavraṇādau -- maricaṃ haritālaṃ ca trivṛtaṃ raktacandanam || 148 || mustaṃ manaḥśilā māṃsī dve niśe devadāru ca | viśālā karavīraṃ ca kuṣṭhamarkapayastathā || 149 || tathaiva gomayarasaṃ kuryātkarṣamitānpṛthak | viṣaṃ cārdhapalaṃ deyaṃ prasthaṃ ca kaṭutailakam || 150 || gomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ dadyājjalaṃ ca dviguṇaṃ bhavet | maricādyamidaṃ tailaṃ siddhaṃ kuṣṭhavraṇāpaham || 151 || jayetkuṣṭāni sarvāṇi puṇḍarīkaṃ vicarcikām | pāmāṃ śvitrāṇi raktaṃ ca kaṇḍūṃ kacchūṃ praṇāśayet || 152|| Dī. maricādyaṃ tailamāha - maricamiti | atra trivṛnniśo dve niśetha: haridre dve tena haridrā dāruharidrā viśālendravāruṇī, karavīra aśvaghnaḥ, arkapayaḥ, gomaya: rasaśca kiṃcidadhiko deyaḥ dravadravyatvāt | prasthamiti caturbhiḥ kuḍavaiḥ pramitaṃ kuḍavo catuṣpala iti gomūtraṃ dviguṇamiti | atra yadgomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ kathitaṃ taddviguṇitajalagrahaṇāt, anyacca caturguṇaṃ gomūtramiti tatra jalaṃ nāsti jalamatra samyak pākārthamuktaṃ keciditi manyante | atra kalkāloḍanārthaṃ jalamuktaṃ na tu kevalajalapākārtham etadapi saṃgataṃ na virodhaḥ | kuṣṭhavraṇāpahamiti kuṣṭhāntaṃ vraṇāni tānapahantīti | śvitrapuṇḍarīkādayo bhedāḥ kuṣṭhasyaivāvagantavyāḥ || 148-152 || Gū. trivṛt niḥsṛtā, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, dve niśe, haridrā dāruharidrā, viśālā indravāruṇī, karavīram aśvamāraḥ, kuṣṭham, arkapayaḥ, gomayaḥ tadrasaṃ, maricādīni pṛthak karṣamitāni viṣam ardhapalaṃ kaṭutailaṃ prasthaṃ gomūtraṃ dviguṇaṃ tailāni deyaṃ pācanaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati pāmā dadruviśeṣaḥ, kacchūḥ vṛṣaṇasandhigatamalajo rogaḥ || 148 -152|| arūṃṣikāyāṃ triphalāditailam - triphalāriṣṭabhūnimbaṃ dve niśe raktacandanam | etaiḥ siddhamarūṃṣīṇāṃ tailamabhyañjane hitam ||153|| Dī. atha triphalādyaṃ tailamāha - triphalāriṣṭeti | atra triphalā harītakīprabhṛtikam, ariṣṭo nimbaḥ, bhūnimbaḥ kirātatiktaḥ, dve niśe haridre dve | etairiti dravyaiḥ kalkaṃ kṛtvā tailaṃ sādhyam; tatra tailāccaturguṇaṃ jalaṃ deyaṃ samyak pākārthaṃ dravānuktatvāt tailāṃśaṃ kalkadravyamiti etadapi tailaṃ kuṣṭhoktaṃ savarṇakaramāhuḥ || 153 || Gū. ariṣṭo nimbaḥ, bhūnimba: kirātatiktaḥ, dvai niśe haridrādvayam etaiḥ kalkaistailaṃ pācitam, arūṃṣikāyāṃ ‘kaphāsṛkkṛmikopena nṛṇāṃ vidyādarūṣikā’ iti ||153|| atha nimbabījatailaṃ palite - bhāvayennimbabījāni bhṛṅgarājarasena hi | tathāsanasya toyena tattailaṃ hanti nasyataḥ ||154|| akālapalitaṃ sadyaḥ puṃsāṃ dugdhānnabhojinām | Dī. idānīṃ keśarañjanārthaṃ nimbabījatailamāha - bhāvayediti | etena nimbabījāni nistuṣāṇi gṛhītvā bhṛṅgarājarasena asakṛdbhāvya tadanu bījasārakvāthenāpi bahuśo bhāvayitvā punastāni saṃśoṣya yantre saṃpīḍya tailaṃ grāhyam | asya nāvanamakālapalitaghnaṃ bhavati | pathyamatra dugdhaudanaṃ bhavati ||154 || Gū. bhṛṅgarājarasena nimbabījāni bhāvayet, athāsanasya bījakasya toyena bhāvayet | tattailaṃ pīḍanājjātam akālapalitaṃ nasyataḥ hanti ||154|| atha yaṣṭīmadhukatailaṃ palite - yaṣṭīmadhukakṣārabhyāṃ navadhātrīphalaiḥ śṛtam ||155|| tailaṃ nasyakṛtaṃ kuryātkeśāñśmaśrūṇi saṅghaśaḥ | Dī. atha yaṣṭīmadhukatailamāha - yaṣṭīmadhuketi | atra yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ ‘mulahaṭī’ śabdavācyaṃ, kṣāraḥ yavakṣāraḥ, etaddvayaṃ samaṃ tailāccaturthāṃśaṃ bhavati | navadhātrīphalairiti nūtanāmalakīphalāni | etenābhinavadhātrīsvarasena tailāccaturguṇena kṛtvā tailaṃ pācyaṃ paścānmadhuyaṣṭīyavakṣārakalkena sādhyamityarthaḥ | asya nāvanāt keśān śiroruhān śmaśrūṇi mukhalomāni saṅghaśa iti sughanān kuryādityarthaḥ ||155|| Gū. yaṣṭīmadhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, kṣīraṃ gokṣīraṃ, tābhyāṃ tathā navadhātrīphalaiḥ śṛtaiḥ nasyena janayati keśān śmaśrūṇi cāpyatha || 155 || atha karañjatailam indralupte - karañjaścitrako jātī karavīraśca pācitam || 156|| tailamebhirdrutaṃ hanyādabhyaṅgādindraluptakam | Dī. idānīṃ karañjādyaṃ tailamāha - karañja iti | karañjo bṛhatkarañjo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ tasya phalāni pallavāni vā, citrakaḥ prasiddhaḥ tasya mūlaṃ patrāṇi vā, jātī sumanā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, karavīro aśvaghnaḥ tasyā'pi patrāṇi, etadyathoktaparimitena kalkena pācitaṃ tailamindraluptāpahaṃ vātapittajaḥ bhavati indraluptaṃ keśapracyāvakaḥ śirorogaḥ asyābhyaṅgamāhuḥ ||156|| Gū. keśanāśaḥ | spaṣṭamanyat || 156 || atha nīlikādyaṃ tailaṃ keśakalpādau - nīlikā ketakīkandaṃ bhṛṅgarājaḥ kuraṇṭakaḥ ||157|| tathārjunasya puṣpāṇi bījakātkusumānyapi | kṛṣṇāstilāśca tagaraṃ samūlaṃ kamalaṃ tathā ||158|| ayorajaḥ priyaṅguśca dāḍimatvagguḍūcikā | triphalā padmapaṅkaśca kalkairebhiḥ pṛthak pṛthak ||159|| karṣamātraiḥ pacettailaṃ triphalākvāthasaṃyutam | bhṛṅgarājarasenaiva siddhaṃ keśasthirīkṛtam ||160|| akālapalitaṃ hanti dāruṇaṃ copajihvikām | Dī. adhunā nīlikādyaṃ tailamāha - nīliketi | nīlikā nīlinī prasiddhā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, ketakī vikhyātā tasyāḥ kandaṃ mūlaviśeṣa:, bhṛṅgarājakuraṇṭakayoḥ patrāṇi, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, arjuno vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya kusumāni, bījako'sanastasya sāro grāhyaḥ, sumanā jātī tasyāḥ patrāṇi, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, samūlakamalamiti, sakandakamalamityarthaḥ, ayorajo lohacūrṇaṃ, priyaṅgurlatāviśeṣastasyāḥ phalāni | dāḍimatvak dāḍimaphalatvak, triphalā harītakyāditrikam, padmapaṅkaṃ kamalamūlasthitamṛttikā tadabhāve'nyataḍāgodbhavā kṛṣṇamṛttikā grāhyā | etāni pṛthakkarṣapramāṇāni gṛhītvā kalkaḥ kāryaḥ | tailamatra tilatailaṃ, tatra sakaladravyāccaturguṇaṃ, triphalākvātho'tra caturguṇastailaparimāṇācca bhṛṅgarājaraso'pi triphalākvāthasamaḥ, etattailaṃ keśakṛṣṇīkaraṇayogyamityāhuḥ satatābhyaṅgatvāt, dāruṇastu kaphamārutajakopajaḥ śirorogaḥ ||157-160|| Gū. nīlikā nīlaṃ, ketakīkandaṃ kelākandaṃ, bhṛṅgarājaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ pītavāsā, arjunavṛkṣasya puṣpāṇi kṛṣṇatilā yamalaṃ kamalakandaḥ, ayorajaḥ lohacūrṇaṃ, priyaṅguḥ, dāḍimatvak, guḍūcī, triphalā, kamalapaṅkaḥ etaiḥ karṣamātraiḥ pṛthak kalkadravyāccaturguṇaṃ tailaṃ tailātriphalākvāthaścaturguṇaṃ tathā bhṛṅgarājarasaḥ ebhiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ nīlikādyaṃ nāma ||157-160 || akālapalitādau bhṛṅgarājatailam -- bhṛṅgarājarasenaiva lohakiṭṭaṃ phalatrikam ||161|| sārivāṃ ca pacetkalkaistailaṃ dāruṇanāśanam | akālapalitaṃ kaṇḍūmindraluptaṃ ca nāśayet ||162|| Dī. atha bhṛṅgarājatailamāha - bhṛṅgarājeti | bhṛṅgarājaraso'tra caturguṇaḥ snehāt lohakiṭṭādikaṃ sarvaṃ tailāccaturthāṃśaṃ kuryāt kalkatvāt; kecittu bhṛṅgarājapatrāṇi kalkamilitānyāhuḥ | tathāhi ‘bhṛṅgarājatriphalotpalaśāri lohapurīṣasamanvitakāri | tailamidaṃ paca dāruṇahāri kuñcitakeśaghanasthirakāri’ iti | etacca kasyacitsampradāye kartavyavidhānam ||161||162|| Gū. atha bhṛṅgarājatailam akālapalitādau | bhṛṅgarājarasaṃ tailāccaturguṇaṃ, lohakiṭṭaṃ, phalatrikaṃ, sārivā anantā eṣāṃ kalkaiḥ pacet | dāruṇaṃ keśamūlanāśakaṃ rogaṃ nāśayet || 161 || 162 || irimedādyaṃ tailaṃ mukhadantarogādau - irimedatvacaṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ pacecchatapalonmitām | jaladroṇe tataḥ kvāthaṃ gṛhṇīyātpādaśeṣitam|| 163|| tailasyārdhāḍhakaṃ dattvā kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pacet | irimedalavaṅgābhyāṃ gairikāgarupadmakaiḥ ||164|| mañjiṣṭhālodhramadhukairlākṣānyagrodhamustakaiḥ | tvagjātīphalakarpūrakaṅkolakhadiraistathā ||165|| pataṅgadhātakīpuṣpasūkṣmailānāgakeśaram | kaṭphalena ca saṃsiddhaṃ tailaṃ mukharujaṃ jayet ||166|| praduṣṭamāṃsaṃ palitaṃ śīrṇadantaṃ ca sauṣiram | śyāvadantaṃ praharṣaṃ ca vidradhiṃ kṛmidantakam || 167 || dantasphuraṇadaurgandhyaṃ jihvātālvoṣṭhajāṃ rujam | Dī. atha irimedādyaṃ tailamāha - irimedeti | irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ ‘reuja’ śabdavācyaḥ tasya tvak challī palaśatonmitā tulaikamānā grāhyā tāṃ ca saṃkuṭya jaladroṇe niṣkvāthya pādaśeṣaṃ grāhyaṃ tailamānādviguṇitamityarthaḥ | tailasyārdhāḍhakamiti tailaṃ tilasaṃbhavamardhāḍhakaṃ dvātriṃśatpalamitam | kalkairiti kalkārthadravyaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pratyekaṃ | tatra irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ; atredaṃ yat punargrahaṇaṃ kalkārthaṃ grāhyam | aguruḥ kṛṣṇāguruḥ, padmakaṃ kāṣṭhaviśeṣaṃ, madhukaṃ yaṣṭīmadhu; lākṣā'tra lākṣārasaḥ kiñcidadhiko deyaḥ dravatvāt | nyagrodho vaṭavṛkṣastasya patrāṇi tvagvā, tvak varāṅgaṃ, khadiraḥ khadirasāraḥ, pataṅgaṃ kucandanaṃ, kaṭphalaṃ prasiddham, karpūramatra prakṣepe sādhu bhavati | tailamidaṃ mukharoge prāyaśo gaṇḍūṣatvena pracarati praduṣṭamāṃsādidantasphuraṇāntaṃ sarvaṃ dantaroge jñātavyam | daurgandhyaṃ mukhekuharasya jihvātālvoṣṭhajāṃ rujamiti tena jihvārujaṃ tālurujam oṣṭharujaṃ vā || 163-167 || Gū. irimedo durgandhakhadiraḥ tasya tvacaṃ kṣuṇṇāṃ kuṭṭitāṃ śatapalonmitajaladroṇe pacet pādaśeṣitaṃ kvāthaṃ gṛhītvā tailasyārdhāḍhakaṃ pacet | irimedādyaiḥ kārṣikaiḥ kalkadravyaiḥ punaḥ pacet | agaru, gairikaṃ, padmakakāṣṭhaṃ, madhukaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, nyagrodho vaṭaḥ, tvak tajaḥ, karpūraḥ, kaṅkolaḥ, khadiraḥ, pataṅgaḥ, dhātrīpuṣpāṇi, sūkṣmailā, nāgakeśaraṃ etaiḥ kalkadravyaiḥ pacet | spaṣṭamanyat || 163-167 || jātyāditailam | (jātī nimbapaṭolānāṃ naktamālasya pallavāḥ ||168|| sikthaṃ samadhukaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ dve niśe kaṭurohiṇī | mañjiṣṭhā padmakaṃ lodhramabhayā nīlamutpalam ||169|| tutthakaṃ sārivā bījaṃ naktamālasya dāpayet | etāni samabhāgāni piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||170|| nāḍīvraṇe samutpanne sphoṭake kacchurogiṣu | sadyaḥ śastraprahāreṣu dagdhaviddheṣu caiva hi ||171|| nakhadantakṣate dehe vraṇe duṣṭe praśasyate |) atha hiṃgvādyaṃ tailaṃ karṇaśūle - hiṅgutumburuśuṇṭhībhiḥ kaṭutailaṃ vipācayet ||172|| tasya pūraṇamātreṇa karṇaśūlaṃ praṇaśyati | Dī. idānīṃ hiṃgvādyaṃ tailamāha - hiṃgviti | hiṃgvādīnāṃ dravyāṇāmatra samabhāgena kalkamāhuḥ | vipācayediti grahaṇāt | kalkārthaṃ toyamāhuranuktatvāt | asmatsampradāye'pi chāgamūtreṇa kalkaṃ kṛtvā tenaiva mūtreṇāloḍya hiṃgvādi pacet | kaṭutailaṃ sārṣapamatra tīkṣṇatvāt | pūraṇamatra karṇapūraṇaṃ tacca granthāntarādavagantavyaṃ tadyathā - ‘dhārayet pūraṇaṃ karṇe karṇaśūlavimardanāt | rujaḥ syānmārdavaṃ yāvanmātrā śatamavedanaḥ’ iti | mātrālakṣaṇamapi prasaṅgato likhyate ‘yāvat paryeti hastāgraṃ dakṣiṇo jānumaṇḍale | nimeṣonmeṣakālaṃ vā sā mātrā parikīrtitā’ | tumburu svanāmaprasiddham ||168-172|| Gū. kalkadravyāt hiṃgvādeścaturguṇaṃ tailam || atha bilvādyaṃ tailaṃ bādhirye - bālabilvāni gomūtre piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet ||173|| sājakṣīraṃ ca nīraṃ ca bādhiryaṃ hanti pūraṇāt | Dī. atha bālabilvatailaṃ yathā bāleti | bālabilvāni bilvaśalāṭūni, tāni gomūtreṇa kalkīkṛtāni gomūtreṇaivāvaloḍya taile pācyāni | tailamatra sārṣapaṃ pūrvayogānuvartanāt ājaṃ kṣīraṃ nīraṃ ca tailāccaturguṇaṃ pratyekamāhuḥ, kutracijjalapāko na dṛśyate kevalaṃ kṣīrapāko bilvakalkapākaśceti sampradāyo vṛddhānāṃ, tantrāntare'pi ‘phalaṃ bilvasya mūtreṇa piṣṭvā tailaṃ vipācayet | sakṣīraṃ tacca vipacedbādhirye karṇapūraṇam’ iti | atra yannīramuktaṃ tatsamyak pākārthaṃ pānīyaṃ vinā snehapāko na sugama iti kecit || 173 || Gū. bālabilvāni laghubilvāni, gomūtre piṣṭvā tailaṃ pacet sājakṣīram ajādugdhaṃ caturguṇatailānnīraṃ jalaṃ ca datvā pacet || 173 || atha kṣāratailaṃ karṇarogeṣu - bālamūlakaśuṅgānāṃ kṣāraḥ kṣārayugaṃ tathā || 174 || lavaṇāni ca pañcaiva hiṅgu śigru mahauṣadham | devadāru vacā kuṣṭhaṃ śatapuṣpā rasāñjanam || 175 || granthikaṃ bhadramustaṃ ca kalkaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ pṛthak | tailaprasthaṃ ca vipacetkadalībījapūrayoḥ || 176 || rasābhyāṃ madhuśuktena cāturguṇyamitena ca | pūyasrāvaṃ karṇanādaṃ śūlaṃ badhiratāṃ kṛmīn || 177 || anyāṃśca karṇajānrogānmukharogāṃśca nāśayet | Dī. atha kṣāratailamāha - bālamūlaketi | bālamūlakaṃ laghumūlakaṃ tasya śuṅgā nālaviśeṣāstajjātaṃ kṣāramiti | kṣārayugamiti kṣāradvandvaṃ tena svarjikākṣāro yavakṣāraśceti | pañjalavaṇāni prasiddhāni, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ asya mūlasvaraso grāhyaḥ, mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī, rasāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ nijanāmnā, tadabhāve dāruharidrā grāhyā tanmūlatvāt, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, bhadramustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, tailaṃ sarṣapamatrāpyāhuḥ, prasthaṃ ṣoḍaśapalāni kadalīkandasvarasaṃ bījapūraphalarasaṃ ca pratyekaṃ tailāccaturguṇamāhuḥ dravatvāt | madhuśuktamapi caturguṇam | pūyasrāvaṃ karṇasyeti śūlamapi karṇasambandhikṛmayastvatra karṇasaṃbhavāśca | etadapi tailaṃ mukharoge praśastaṃ gaṇḍūṣakaraṇatvāt || 174-177 || Gū. bālamūlakaśuṇṭhīnāṃ kṣāraḥ bālamūlakaṃ teṣāṃ śuṃḍāni gaṃḍikāḥ śuṣkāsteṣāṃ dagdhvā kṣāraḥ kāryaḥ, tathā kṣārayugaṃ svarjī yavakṣāraḥ, śobhāñjanaṃ, mahauṣadhaṃ śuṇṭhī, rasāñjanaṃ, granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ, bhadramustaṃ nāgaramustaṃ, etaiḥ karṣamitaiḥ tailaprasthaṃ pacet | kadalīsvarase bījapūraphalarase ca caturguṇālābhe tulyenāpi pacet madhuśuktena ca tailāccāturguṇyena pacet || 174-177 || kecittu madhuśuktalakṣaṇametasyāgre paṭhanti tadyathā - madhuśuktam | jambīrāṇāṃ phalarasaḥ prasthaikaḥ kuḍavonmitam ||178|| mākṣikaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ palaikā pippalī smṛtā | etadekīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mṛdbhāṇḍe ca nidhāpayet ||179|| vacāmbho madhusaṃyuktaṃ śṛṅgaveraguḍānvitam | dhānyarāśau trirātristhaṃ madhuśuktamudāhṛtam ||180|| Dī. tantrāntare tu - ‘yavāṃbho madhuyuktaṃ ca śṛṃgaveraguḍānvitam | dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ madhuśuktamudāhṛtam’ iti | athavā ‘yanmastvaśucau bhāṇḍe sakṣaudraguḍakāñjikam | dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ śuktaṃ cukraṃ taducyate’ iti | eteṣāṃ yathālābhaṃ deyamiti na doṣaḥ || || 178-180 || atha pāṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ pīnase - pāṭhā dve ca niśe mūrvā pippalī jātipallavaiḥ||181|| dantyā ca tailaṃ saṃsiddhaṃ nasyaṃ syāhuṣṭapīnase | Dī. saṃprati pāṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ darśayannāha - pāṭheti | pāṭhā prasiddhā, dve niśe iti haridrādvayaṃ, mūrvā corasnāyuḥ jātipallavairiti jātī sumanā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, dantī prasiddhā, pāṭhādidravyāṇāṃ samānamilitānāṃ kalkaṃ tailāṃśamāhuḥ || 181 || Gū. pāṭhā, dve niśe haridrādvayaṃ, mūrvā moraṭā; pippalī jātī mālatīpatrāṇi, dantī jayapālamūlam ebhiḥ saṃsiddhaṃ kalkīkṛtaṃ kalkāttailaṃ caturguṇam ||181|| atha vyāghrītailaṃ pīnase - vyāghrīdantīvacāśigrutulasīvyoṣasaindhavaiḥ ||182|| kaphasya pācanaṃ tailaṃ pūtināsodakāpaham | Dī. atha vyāghrītailamāha - vyāghrīti | vyāghrīkaṇṭakārikā, dantī prasiddhā, śigruḥ śobhāñjanakaḥ, tulasī pratītā tasyāḥ patrāṇi, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, tena śuṇṭhīmaricapippalya iti | eteṣāṃ kalkaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ kaphasya pācanamuktam pānatvāt | pūtināsodakāpahamiti ca pūtināso nāsādurgandhaḥ | nāsodakaṃ nāsāsrāvaḥ etaddvayaṃ hanti nasyābhyāsāt ||182|| Gū. vyāghrī, kaṇṭakārī, dantī, śigruḥ śobhāñjanaṃ, tulasī, vyoṣaṃ, trikaṭu, pūtināsāgadaṃ pīnasam||182|| atha kuṣṭhādyaṃ tailaṃ chikvāyāṃ - kuṣṭhaṃ bilvakaṇāśuṇṭhīdrākṣākalkakaṣāyavat || 183|| sādhitaṃ tailamājyaṃ vā nasyātkṣavathunāśanam | Dī. idānīṃ kuṣṭhatailamāha - kuṣṭhamiti | bilvamatra bilvaphalaṃ mūlaṃ vā tadabhāve kaṇā pippalī kalkakaṣāyavaditi kalkarūpastena sādhitamityarthaḥ | pañcakaṣāyāḥ kathitāḥ | yadvā kuṣṭhādīnāṃ kalkena kaṣāyeṇa ca tailaṃ sādhyam | kaṣāyaśabdaḥ kvāthe prāyaśaḥ pracarati tatra kvāthārthametaddravyaṃ snehasamaṃ grāhyaṃ, caturguṇena nīreṇa saṃkvāthya pādaśeṣeṇa sādhyaṃ, kalkārthaṃ ca tailāṃśena sāmyamityarthaḥ | evamājyaṃ ghṛtamapi sādhyam | kṣavathuśchikkā ||183|| Gū. kuptādīnāṃ kalkaḥ kaṣāyavatkāryastena tailam ājyaṃ ghṛtaṃ vā sādhitaṃ na syāt kṣavathunāśanaḥ kṣavathuśchikkā ||183|| gṛhadhūmatailaṃ nāsārśasi - gṛhadhūmakaṇādārukṣāranaktāhvasaindhavaiḥ || 184 || siddhaṃ śikharibījaiśca tailaṃ nāsārśasāṃ hitam | Dī. atha gṛhadhūmatailamāha - gṛhadhūmeti | gṛhadhūmaḥ vikhyātaḥ, kaṇā pippalī, dāru devadāru, kṣāraṃ yavakṣāraṃ, naktāhvaṃ karañjaphalaṃ | śikharibījaiśceti | śikharī apāmārgaḥ tasya bījai: phalaiḥ | eke siddhaṃ śirīṣabījaiśceti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | eteṣāṃ kalkaṃ tailāṃśamāhuḥ | siddhamidaṃ nāvane'bhyaṅge vā praśastam ||184|| Gū. gṛhadhūmaḥ ‘aṅgāradhūmaḥ’, kaṇā pippalī, dāru devadāru, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ naktāhva karañjaḥ, saindhavaṃ, śikharibījaṃ tugābījam ebhiḥ kalkitaiḥ siddhaṃ tailaṃ nāsārśasāṃ haraṃ bhavati || 184 || atha vajrītailaṃ kuṣṭhādau - vajrīkṣīraṃ ravikṣīraṃ dravaṃ dhattūracitrajam || 185 || mahiṣīviḍbhavaṃ drāvaṃ sarvāṃśaṃ tilatailakam | pacettailāvaśeṣaṃ ca gomūtre'tha caturguṇe || 186 || tailāvaśeṣaṃ paktvā ca tattailaṃ prasthamātrakam | gandhakāgniśilātālaṃ viḍaṅgātiviṣāviṣam ||187|| tiktakośātakīkuṣṭhavacāmāṃsīkaṭutrayam | pītadāru ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ svarjikākṣārajīrakam ||188|| devadāru ca karṣāṃśaṃ cūrṇaṃ taile vinikṣipet | vajratailamidaṃ khyātamabhyaṅgātsarvakuṣṭhanut || 189 || Dī. adhunā vajrītailamāha - vajrīti | vajrī sehuṇḍastasya kṣīraṃ dugdhaṃ ravikṣīramityarkadugdhaṃ dhattūrakacitrakapatrayordravaṃ svarasamityarthaḥ | mahiṣīviḍbhavaṃ drāvaṃ mahiṣīśakṛtsvarasam | sarvāṃśaṃ tilatailakamiti sarvaṃ vajrīkṣīrādi pañcadravaṃ tasyāṃśaṃ caturthāṃśaṃ bhāgaṃ tatsamamiti tailamityarthaḥ | eke sarvāṃśaṃ tailamityanena sarvapañcadravyasāmyaṃ tailamiti vadanti etanna pracarati yataḥ pañcadravatvena pratyekaṃ tailasamamāhuḥ | tathācoktamatraiva paribhāṣāyām ‘dravāṇi yatra sneheṣu pañcādīni’ ityādivākyam | punarapi tadgomūtracaturguṇena paktvā tailāvaśeṣaṃ prasthamātraṃ gṛhītvā vakṣyamāṇadravyāṇāṃ pratyekaṃ karṣapramitānāṃ cūrṇaṃ tattaile miśrayitvā svanuguptaṃ dhārayet| gomūtraṃ pṛthaguktatvāccaturguṇam| cūrṇadravyāṇyāha -tatrāgnirbhallātakaḥ, citrakajaṭā vā, śilā manaḥśilā, tālaṃ haritālaṃ, viṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tiktakośātakī kaṭukośātakīphalamiti, māṃsī jaṭākhyā kaṭutrayaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, pītadāru dāruharidrā, yaṣṭyāhvaṃ madhuyaṣṭī, sva- rjikākṣāraṃ prasiddhaṃ tatteṣāṃ cūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇāmapi kalkamāhureke sarvakuṣṭhanuditi | sarvakuṣṭham aṣṭādaśaprakāram|| ||185-189 || Gū. vajrīkṣīraṃ, ravirarkastasya kṣīraṃ, dravaṃ tajjalaṃ, dhattūrapatrasvarasaḥ, citrakasvarasaśca, mahiṣīviḍdravaṃ, tilatailakaṃ sarvāṃśaṃ sarvasamaṃ, gomūtraṃ caturguṇaṃ tailāt | tatsiddhaṃ tailaṃ prasthamātrakaṃ tasmingandhakādīn kṣipet agniścitrakaḥ, śilā manaḥśilā, tālaṃ haritālaṃ, viṣā ativiṣā, viṣaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tiktakośātakī jālinī, pītadāruḥ, haridrā, kṣāro yavakṣāraḥ, karṣāṃśaṃ cūrṇitaṃ kṣipet | sarvakuṣṭhahṛt dadruvicarcikādikakuṣṭhaharam ||185-189 || karavīrāditailam | karavīraśikhādantītrivṛtkośātakīphakṣam | rambhākṣārodake tailaṃ praśastaṃ lomaśātanam ||190|| Dī. atha karavīrāditailamāha - karavīreti | sugamam ||190|| candanāditailam - (candanāmbunakhairyābhyaṃ yaṣṭīśaileyapadmakam | mañjiṣṭhā saralaṃ dāru sevyailaṃ pūtikesaram ||191|| patrakailaṃ murā māṃsī kaṅkolaṃ vanitāmbudam | haridrā sārivā tiktā lavaṅgāgarukuṅkumam || 192|| tvagreṇunalikā ceti tailaṃ mastu caturguṇam | lākṣārasasamaṃ siddhaṃ grahaghnaṃ balavardhanam || 193 || apasmārajvaronmādakṛtyālakṣmīvināśanam | āyuḥpuṣṭikaraṃ caiva vaśīkaraṇamuttamam || 194 || viśeṣātkṣayarogaghnaṃ raktapittaharaṃ param|) Dī. ambu mustakaṃ, nakhaṃ sugandhauṣadhiḥ, yāmyaṃ candanaṃ, saralaṃ dhūpavṛkṣaḥ, sevyam uśīraṃ, pūtikesaraṃ gandhamārjārī, murā gandhadravyaṃ, vanitā priyaṅguḥ, ambudaṃ mustaṃ, tiktā latākastūrī, nalikā indīvarā || 191-194 || vacātailam - (vacāṃ śaṭhīṃ haridre dve devadāruhamahauṣadhī ||195|| harītakīmativiṣāmustamaindrayavānsamān | etāndaśapalānbhāgāṃścaturdroṇe'mbhasaḥpacet||196|| cakramardarasaistailaṃ kaṭukaṃ mṛdunā'gninā | pādaśeṣe vinikṣipya sindūramavatārayet ||197|| etattailaṃ nihantyāśu gaṇḍamālāṃ sudāruṇām|) mahauṣadha: śuṇṭhī, kaṭukaṃ tailaṃ sārṣapam ||195-197|| lāṅgalītailam | (nirguṇḍīsvarase tailaṃ lāṅgalī mūlakalkitam ||198|| tailaṃ nasyānnihantyāśu gaṇḍamālāṃ sudāruṇām |) dhattūratailam - ‘dhattūrarasamādāya hayamārāntikārasam | bhṛṅgarājarasaścaiva sāriṇī nimbapatrakam || 199 || śobhāñjanaścitrakaśca aśvagandhāprasāriṇī | śirīṣaḥ kuṭajo'nantā śālmalī naktapatrakam||20.|| ravipriyo mahānimbo ḍiṇḍighoṣā maheraṇā | balā jyotiṣmatī caiva śyāmākaścakramardakaḥ||20 1|| etaistu rasamādāya tailatulyaṃ ca dīyate | devadāru haridre dve māṃsī kuṣṭhaṃ sacandanam ||202|| maricaṃ trivṛtā dantī haritālaṃ manaḥśilā | kampillako gandhakaśca khadiraḥ pippalī vacā ||203|| rasāñjanaṃ ca sindūraṃ śrīvāso raktacandanam | irimedastathā tumbī mañjiṣṭhā sinduvārakaḥ ||204|| karavīrajaṭā rāsnā viśvā śreṣṭhā ca pauṣkaram | śaṭhī tālīsapatraṃ ca priyaṅgū reṇukā tathā ||205|| cāturjātakamañjīraṃ kaṅkolaṃ jātipatrikā | jyotiṣmatī ca palikā viṣasya dvipalaṃ bhavet ||206|| āḍhakaṃ kaṭutailasya gomūtraṃ ca caturguṇam | mṛtpātre lohapātre ca śanairmṛdvagninā pacet ||207|| majjāśritaṃ tvaggataṃ ca vātaṃ cāsthigataṃ tathā | ūrugrahaṃ cāḍhyavātaṃ kṛcchraṃ daṇḍāpatānakam ||208|| kubjatvaṃ cātha śothaṃ ca pakṣāghātaṃ tathārditam | hanustambhaṃ śiraḥkampaṃ mūrcchitaṃ dṛṣṭivibhramam ||209|| apasmāraṃ tathonmādaṃ tathācaivā'patantrakam | ākṣepakaṃ cāsthibhagnaṃ sandhibhagnaṃ ca nāśayet||210|| ityapyadhikaḥ pāṭho dṛśyate | iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ ghṛtatailakalpanā nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ | Dī. hayamāro karavīraḥ, naktapatrakaṃ kañjapatrakaṃ, ravipriyo raktakamalaṃ, ḍiṇḍīghoṣā raktairaṇḍaḥ, maheraṇā sallakīvṛkṣaḥ, śrīvāsaḥ saralaniryāsaḥ, sinduvārakaḥ nirguṇḍī, śreṣṭhā sthalapadminī || 199-210 || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe snehakalpanā'dhyāyo navamaḥ ||9|| iti kāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śrīśārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ tailādhikāraḥ || Editor's notes 1 ‘khaṭṭīmīṭhī’ hi.bhā.| ↩ 2 ‘aśvagandhā palaśataṃ tadardhaṃ gokṣuraṃ matam | punarnavāśvatthaśuṇṭhīkāśmaryāstu phalānyapi || padmabījaṃ māṣabījaṃ daṣāddaśapalaṃ pṛthak | caturdroṇāmbhasā paktvā pādaśeṣaṃ śṛtaṃ nayet || jīvanīyagaṇaḥ kuṣṭhaṃ padmakaṃ raktacandanam | patrakaṃ pippalī drākṣā kapikacchuphalaṃ tathā || nīlotpalaṃ nāgapuṣpaṃ sārive dve bale tathā | pṛthakvarṣasamā bhāgāḥ śarkarāyāḥ paladvayam || rasaśca pauṇḍrakekṣūṇāmāḍhakaikaṃ samāharet | ghṛtasya cāḍhakaṃ dattvā pācayenmṛdunāgninā || ghṛtametannihantyāśu raktapittamuraḥkṣatam | halīmakaṃ paṇḍurogaṃ varṇabhedaṃ svarakṣayam || vātaraktaṃ mūtrakṛcchraṃ pārśvaśūlaṃ ca kāmalām | śukrakṣayamurodāhaṃ kārśyamojaḥkṣayaṃ tathā || strīṇāṃ caivāprajātānāṃ garbhadaṃ śukradaṃ nṛṇām | kāmadevaghṛtaṃ nāma hṛdyaṃ balyaṃ rasāyanam’ || iti pāṭhāntaram | ↩ 3 pauṃḍā | ↩ 4 gāṇḍā (nnā) | ↩ 5 ‘paravala’ hi.bhā.| ↩ 6 ‘panavāḍa’ hi.bhā.| ↩ 7 nīlāthothā ↩ 8 nāsti ‘kha’ pustake | ↩ 9 prakṣiptam| ↩ 10 samaṅgā mañjiṣṭhā | nalikā sugandhatṛṇaviśeṣaḥ, kunduruskaḥ-dhūpaḥ niryāsaviśepaḥ, turuṣkaḥ sihlakaniryāsaviśeṣaḥ, spṛkkā-mālatī | ↩ 11 prakṣiptam | vāruṇī-indravāruṇī ↩ 12 ‘kṣīrābhyā’miti gūḍhārtha. sammata: pāṭhaḥ | ↩ 13 keśaśātanaṃ khīrāśabdavācyam dī. ↩ 14 ‘durgandhakhadira’ śabdavācyam | ↩ 15 prakṣiptam | naktamāla:-karañja: | ↩ 16 prakṣiptapāṭhā: ↩ 17 prakṣiptapāṭhāḥ ↩ 18 lāṅgalī-kalihārī keṣucitpustakeṣvetat pāṭhabhedatrayaṃ dṛśyate | ↩

title: 10. atha āsavāriṣṭakalpanādhyāyaḥ
text: daśamo'dhyāyaḥ | draveṣu cirakālasthaṃ dramyaṃ yatsaṃdhitaṃ bhavet | āsavāriṣṭabhedaistu procyate bheṣajocitam ||1|| Dī. idānīṃ saṃdhānakalpanāṃ darśayannāha - draveṣviti| tatra sāmānyaṃ yathā draveṣu kalpanāgaṇiteṣu dravadravyeṣu yaddravyaṃ cirakālaṃ saṃdhānībhūtaṃ bhavati tacca āsavāriṣṭādibhedaiḥ kṛtvā madyamityucyate | āsavāriṣṭabhedairiti bahuvacanatvena sīdhusurādikamapi gṛhyate | āsava iti prasiddhaḥ, surā paiṣṭī, āsavo guḍayoniḥ | sūyate toyakāryaṃ kriyate yasmin sa āsavaḥ | sthiramada iti cirakālamattatākārī | ariṣṭamiti dravyapradhānaḥ asya bhedaḥ | sīdhuriti | sīdhuśabdena madyabhedamāhuḥ, taccobhayapradhānam | etadapi trividhamiti kecit | paiṣṭikaṃ mādhvīkaṃ gauḍamiti | maireyaka ityapi bhedo'sya vadantyeke | sa yathā - surāsavayoḥ pratyekaniṣpāditayorekīkṛtya punaḥsandhāno maireya iti saṃkṣepeṇoktā madyabhedāḥ || 1|| Gū. atha āsavāriṣṭādhyāyamāha | yaddravyam auṣadhādidravyeṣu pānīyādiṣu cirakālasthaṃ sandhitaṃ tat ucitaṃ bheṣajaṃ āsavāriṣṭabhedaiḥ procyate | ucitaṃ svarogocitam || 1 || yadapakvauṣadhāmbubhyāṃ siddhaṃ madyaṃ sa āsavaḥ | ariṣṭaḥ kvāthasiddhaḥ syāttayormānaṃ jalonmitam ||2|| Dī. idānīṃ tasya viśeṣalakṣaṇānyāha - yaditi | tayorāsavāriṣṭayormānaṃ pānārthaṃ tulanārūpaṃ jalonmitamiti | jalapānamātraṃ jalapānaṃ tu alpameva kathitaṃ naitanmanoharam, kuto madātyayaviṣayatvāt | nīrujānāṃ tantrāntarīyamānaṃ yat tajjalaśabdena kalpyate | tadyathā - “śuddhakāyaḥ pibet prātaḥ sopadaṃśaṃ paladvayam | madhyāhne dviguṇaṃ tacca snigdhāhāreṇa pāyayet” ityādi vacanāt | eke tripalonmitamiti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca || 2 || Gū. tatrāpi āsavāriṣṭayorbhedamāha -- yat apakvauṣadhāmbubhyāṃ siddhaṃ madyaṃ sa āsavaḥ tadguṇāḥ - ‘chedī madhvāsavastīkṣṇā’ iti procyate | apakvauṣadham ambu ca vahnipākarahitaṃ | yastu kvāthasiddhaḥ sa ariṣṭaḥ syāt | vahniyogādbhūyānbhedaḥ | tayorāsavāriṣṭayormānaṃ bhakṣaṇapramāṇaṃ, tadguṇāstu “yathā dravyaguṇo'riṣṭaḥ sarvamadyaguṇādhikaḥ” || 2 || anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu jalādipramāṇamāha - anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu dravadroṇe tulāṃ guḍam | kṣaudraṃ kṣipedguḍādardhaṃ prakṣepaṃ daśamāṃśikam || 3 || Dī. athāriṣṭeṣu dravyaparimāṇamanuktatvāddarśayannāha - anuktamāneti | dravyadroṇe droṇadvayaparimite drave kvāthādike | tatra tulāmiti sandhānikadravyāṇāṃ kṣipet | tāni madhukapuṣpaprabhṛtīni guḍaparimāṇādardhaparimāṇam | madhviti guḍamānamapi kvāthadravyaparimāṇādardhaṃ boddhavyam | tathāca paribhāṣāyāṃ - “kvāthyadravyasya hi samaṃ kvāthaṃ nītvā tu dhārayet | pātre mṛṇmayake bhūmau nikhāte tu guḍaṃ nyaset | kvāthādardhaṃ tato dravyaṃ pradeyaṃ cāṣṭamāṃśikam | kṣaudraṃ kṣipedguḍādardham śarkarāṃ ca tathā nyaset | karkandhūmūlaprabhṛtīn guḍatulyaṃ pradāpayet | dhātakīkusumaṃ deyaṃ śarkarākṣaudrayordvikam | samyak pakvaṃ tato jñātvā nyasedyantre prasādhayet” iti | prakṣepaṃ daśamāṃśikamiti | prakṣepaṃ paścāddeyaṃ dravyaṃ daśamāṃśikaṃ guḍaparimāṇādityarthaḥ || 3 || Gū. anuktamānāriṣṭeṣu dravadroṇe sati guḍaṃ tulāṃ kṣipet | tulāṃ palaśatapramāṇaṃ, anuktamānaṃ guḍapramāṇaṃ yeṣu evaṃbhūteṣvāsavāriṣṭeṣu kṣaudraṃ madhu guḍādardhaṃ kṣipet | anukta evaṃ prakṣepaṃ cūrṇādiprakṣepam | daśamāṃśikaṃ cūrṇaprakṣepaṃ daśamāśikamiti || 3 || atha kvāthabhedena sīdhulakṣaṇamāha - jñeyaḥ śītarasaḥ sīdhurapakvamadhuradravaiḥ | paripakvānnasandhānasamutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | siddhaḥ pakvarasaḥ sīdhuḥ saṃpakvamadhuradravaiḥ || 4 || Dī. idānīṃ sīdhuprabhṛtīnāṃ pratyekalakṣaṇānyāha - jñeya iti | yaḥ sīdhuḥ apakvamadhuradravairikṣurasaprabhṛtikaiḥ siddho jñātaḥ sa śītarasasaṃjño jñeyaḥ | yaḥ saṃpakvamadhuradravaiḥ siddhaḥ sa pakvarasasaṃjñaḥ etaddvayaṃ tatkarmakārakasakāśādavagantavyam ||4|| Gū. apakvamadhuradravaiḥ siddhaḥ śītarasaḥ sīdhurjñeyaḥ yathā sirakāsam | pakvamadhuradravaiḥ siddhaḥ pakvarasaḥ sīdhurjñeyaḥ, apakvarasasīdhuḥ, pakvarasasīdhuśca bhedadvayaṃ jñeyaṃ, tadguṇāstu - “vātapittakaraḥ sīdhuḥ snehaśleṣmavikārahā | meda:śophodarārśoghnastatra pakvaraso varaḥ? iti ||4|| atha surāprasannādīnāṃ madyabhedānāṃ lakṣaṇamāha - paripakvānnasaṃdhānasamutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | surāmaṇḍaḥ prasannā syāttataḥ kādambarī ghanaḥ || 5 || tadadho jagalo jñeyo medako jagalāddhanaḥ | vakvaso hṛtasāraḥ syātsurābījaṃ ca kiṇvakam ||6|| Dī. idānīṃ surāviśeṣaṇalakṣaṇamāha - paripakvānneti | yat śālyādikaṃ sampācya punaḥ sandhitaṃ bhavati tena yat samutpannaṃ tāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | eṣā paiṣṭī surā loke ‘vaganī’ śabdavācyā vikhyātā | athānye bahavo bhedāstānāha -surāmaṇḍa ityādi | yaḥ surāmaṇḍaḥ uparyaccho bhāgaḥ sā prasannā kathitā, yo ghanaḥ sa eva kādambarīśabdena vācya: | ghanastu surābhāga eva, yaḥ surāyā adhasthito bhavati sa jagalo jñeyaḥ | yo jagalāt kiñcidghanaḥ sa medakasurāsaṃjñaḥ kādambaryā bhinnaḥ kiñciddhanatvāt | yo hṛtasāraḥ sa ‘vakkasa’saṃjñaḥ | surābījaṃ tu kiṇvakamiti | śālipiṣṭaprabhavaṃ kiṇvakamiti kathitam | ete surābhedā darśitāḥ | te ca lokato jñātavyāḥ || 5 || 6 || Gū. atha surā | paripakvasya pācitānnasya yatsadhānaṃ tasmātsamutpannāṃ surāṃ jaguḥ | atha prasannāṃ kādambarīṃ cāha -uktāyāḥ surāyāḥ maṇḍaḥ phenaḥ prasannā syāt tataḥ ghanā dṛḍhā kādambarī syāt | atha jagalaṃ medakaṃ cāha - tadadhaḥ surāyā adhaḥ yo dravabhāgaḥ sa jagalastasmāt yaścyavaḥ medakaḥ | atha surābījaṃ kiṇvakamāha - sa medakaḥ hṛtasāraḥ surābījaṃ bhavati ca punaḥ kiṇvakaṃ bhavati bījamutpattisthānaṃ vivakalahastīti bhāṣāyām || 5 || 6 || atha vāruṇīmāha - yattālakharjūrarasaiḥ saṃdhitā sā hi vāruṇī | Dī. atha vāruṇīlakṣaṇamāha - yattāleti | idamapi surābhedaḥ | tālaḥ tālavṛkṣaḥ, kharjūro vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ, rasa iti phalarasaḥ, sandhitamiti pūrvavat, yadvā tālakharjūravṛkṣayoruparibhāgaṃ chitvā tatra ghaṭamāropya yo raso ghaṭe patitastatraiva cirakālastho bhavati sā vāruṇī; loke ‘sendhī’ śabdavācyā | ‘tadguṇā vāruṇī hṛdyā laghutīkṣṇā nihaṃti ca’ || atha śuktamāha - kandamūlaphalādīni sasnehalavaṇāni ca || 7 || yatra drave'bhiṣūyante tacchuktamabhidhīyate | vinaṣṭamamlatāṃ yātaṃ madyaṃ vā madhuradravam || 8 || vinaṣṭaḥ saṃdhito yastu taccukramabhidhīyate | guḍāmbunā satailena kandamūlaphalaistathā || 9 || saṃdhitaṃ cāmlatāṃ yātaṃ guḍaśuktaṃ taducyate | Dī. adhunā śuktādilakṣaṇaṃ darśayannāha - kandamūleti | etacca sāmānyalakṣaṇamabhihitam, kandamūlaphalādīni iti | kandāni sūraṇaprabhṛtīni, mūlāni mūlakaprabhṛtīni, phalāni karamardakaraṃbhāphalaprabhṛtīni, ādiśabdāt patrapuṣpanālādayo gṛhyante | na kevalaṃ lavaṇatailaṃ, cakārādrājikāharidrādīnāmapi grahaṇaṃ, vyavahāratastu lavaṇatyāgenāpi pracarati | yatra drave pānīyaprabhṛtike etāni vastūni sūyante sandhānībhūtāni kriyante tat śuktamabhidhīyate iti | nanu ‘śuktaṃ cukramucyate’ iti vadanti tatkathamasya śuktasaṃjñā kathyate ? satyam | śuktavat sandhitānāṃ kandādīnāmapi cukrasaṃjñātrāpyabhihitā na tu sākṣāt śuktaṃ coktam | atha atrāpi madyalakṣaṇamāha etadapi śuktabhedamāhuḥ | taduktaṃ guṇāvalyāṃ “gauḍāni rasaśuktāni madyaśuktāni yāni ca | yathāpūrvaṃ gurutarā- ṇyabhiṣyandakarāṇi ca” iti | vinaṣṭamamlatāṃ yātaṃ madyamiti taducyate | sarvaṃ madyaṃ pañcarasaṃ kālāntaravaśād yadā saṃtyajya paramamlatvaṃ yāti śuktaṃ taducyate iti | madhuradravamiti | guḍekṣurasamadhuprabhṛtikam | tathāhi - ‘yanmadhvādau śucau bhāṇḍe saguḍakṣaudrakāñjikam | dhānyarāśau trirātrasthaṃ śuktaṃ cukraṃ taducyate’ iti | vinaṣṭa iti vigatarasaḥ | sandhitaḥ sandhānībhūtaḥ | idānīṃ guḍādiśuktalakṣaṇamāha - guḍeti | guḍaśuktamiti guḍapradhānaṃ śuktamityarthaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 7-9 || Gū. śuktaguṇāḥ - ‘raktapittakaphotkledi śuktaṃ vātānulomanam ? abhiṣūyante kṣipyante, spaṣṭamanyat | cukramāhuḥ cukraṃ madyabhedaḥ, atha guḍaśuktam evamevekṣuśuktam iti madyabhedaḥ || 7-9|| ikṣuśuktam - evamevekṣuśuktaṃ syānmṛdvīkāsaṃbhavaṃ tathā ||10|| Dī. evameveti | guḍaśuktavadikṣurasaśuktaṃ sandheyam | ikṣuśuktamitīkṣurasādikṛtaṃ, mṛdvīkā drākṣā tatsambhavaṃ śuktam | etadapi pūrvavat sandheyam | eke mṛdvīkāsambhavamityasya sthāne ‘madhunā saṃbhava’miti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | madhunā saṃbhavamiti madhukṛtaśuktamucyate taduktaṃ “jambīrāṇāṃ phalarasaṃ pippalīmūlasaṃyutam | madhubhāṇḍe vinikṣipya dhānyarāśau nidhāpayet || tryaheṇa tajjātarasaṃ madhuśuktamudāhṛtam” iti | madhubhāṇḍe madhupūrṇaprāye bhāṇḍe ityarthaḥ | tadguṇāḥ krameṇa “guḍekṣumadyamārdvīkaśuktaṃ laghu yathottaram” || 10 || idānīṃ tuṣāmbukāñjikamapyāha - tuṣāmbu saṃdhitaṃ jñeyamāmairvidalitairyavaiḥ | yavaistu nistuṣaiḥ pakvaiḥ sauvīraṃ saṃdhitaṃ bhavet || 1 1|| Dī. tuṣāmbviti | āmairaparipakvairvidalitaiḥ khaṇḍitaiḥ īdṛśairyavairyat sandhānaṃ kriyate tat tuṣāmbu kathitaṃ, yavaistu nistuṣaiḥ pakvaiḥ sauvīramiti | nistuṣaistuṣarahitaiḥ pakvaiḥ svinnairyavairiti śeṣaḥ, yavaiḥ nistuṣairiti grahaṇenāpi godhūmasaṃbhavamiti sūcayati | tathāhi - ‘sauvīrakaṃ suvīrāmlaṃ jñeyaṃ godhūmasaṃbhavam’ iti | tuṣāmbu sauvīrakaṃ ca kāñjikabhedamāhuḥ, te tu virecanaprakaraṇe prāyaśaḥ pracarataḥ || 11 || Gū. atha tuṣāmbu, vidalitaiḥ āmairapakvaiḥ yavaiḥ saṃdhitaṃ tuṣāmbu jñeyam | atha sauvīraṃ nistuṣaiḥ pakvaiḥ kvathitairyavaiḥ saṃdhitaṃ sauvīraṃ bhavet || 11 || atha kāñjikam - kulmāṣadhānyamaṇḍādi saṃdhitaṃ kāñjikaṃ viduḥ | Dī. saṃprati kāñjikasyāpi lakṣaṇaṃ prakaṭayannāha - kulmāṣeti | kāñjikaṃ dhānyāmlaṃ, kulmāṣāḥ kutsitamāṣāḥ, dhānyaṃ raktaśālyādi, tena ca tṛṇāhvakodravādikamapi gṛhyate | maṇḍaṃ śāliprabhavaṃ prasiddham | eke kulmāṣabhavaṃ dhānyabhavaṃ maṇḍaṃ ca vyākhyānayanti, ādiśabdāt yavacūrṇādikṛtamapi boddhavyam, yataḥ asya bahavo bhedāḥ dṛśyante te tu dakṣiṇe'tīva prasiddhāḥ || Gū. kulmāṣadhānyamaṇḍādi yatsandhitaṃ tatkāñjikaṃ viduḥ | kulmāṣaḥ ardhasvinnamāṣaḥ, dhānyaṃ ṣaṣṭikādi tayormaṇḍasaṃdhitaṃ, tadguṇāḥ - ‘dhānyāmlaṃ bhedi tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ pittakṛtsparśaśītalam ||’ atha saṇḍākī -- saṇḍākī saṃdhitā jñeyā mūlakaiḥ sārṣapādibhiḥ || 12|| Dī. atha saṇḍākīmāha - saṇḍākīti | sandhānakabhedaḥ , mūlakaṃ prasiddham, sārṣapādibhiriti sārṣapaśākena saṃdhānam ādigrahaṇādanyaśākairapi kriyate || 12 || Gū. mūlakaistathā sarṣapādibhiḥ saṃdhitaṃ saṇḍākīnāmnī jñeyā || 12 || atha āsavāḥ - raktapittādau uśīrāsavaḥ - uśīraṃ vālakaṃ padmaṃ kāśmarīṃ nīlamutpalam | priyaṅguṃ padmakaṃ lodhraṃ mañjiṣṭhāṃ dhanvayāsakam ||13 || pāṭhāṃ kirātatiktaṃ ca nyagrodhodumbaraṃ śaṭhīm | parpaṭaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ ca paṭolaṃ kāñcanārakam || 14 || jambūśālmaliniryāsaṃ pratyekaṃ palasaṃmitān | bhāgānsucūrṇitānkṛtvā drākṣāyāḥ palaviṃśatim||15|| dhātakīṃ ṣoḍaśapalāṃ jaladroṇadvaye kṣipet | śarkarāyāstulāṃ dattvā kṣaudrasyaikatulāṃ tathā || 16 || māsaikaṃ sthāpayedbhāṇḍe māṃsīmaricadhūpite | uśīrāsava ityeṣa raktapittavināśanaḥ || 17 || pāṇḍukuṣṭhapramehārśaḥ kṛmiśothaharastathā | Dī. idānīmāsavānāṃ prakārabhedamāha - uśīramiti | etaduśīrāsavavyākhyānaṃ subodhameva | māsaṃ māsaikaparyantaṃ sthāpayet saṃdhānavadityarthaḥ | bhāṇḍe māṃsīmaricadhūpite iti | māṃsī jaṭākhyā bhāṇḍe sādhanapātre kecittu atra māṃsīmaricacūrṇasya prakṣepamāhuḥ, raktapittamiti vyastaṃ militaṃ vā || 13-17|| Gū. uśīraṃ bālakaṃ padmaṃ kamalaṃ, kāśmarī gambhārī, nīlamutpalaṃ nīlakamalaṃ, priyaṅgu, padmakaṃ padmakāṣṭhaṃ, lodhraṃ prasiddhaṃ, mañjiṣṭhā, dhanvayāsakaṃ yavāsā, pāṭhā, bhūnimbaḥ, nyagrodho vaṭaḥ, udumbaro yajñīyavṛkṣaḥ, śaṭhī karcūraḥ, parpaṭaḥ kaṭupatraḥ, puṇḍarīkaṃ śvetakamalaṃ, paṭolaṃ patraṃ, kāñcanāraṃ jambūlā, jambūśālmalīniryāsaḥ mocarasaḥ, etānpratyekānpalasaṃmitāndrākṣā viṃśatipalāni dhātakīpuṣpāṇi ṣoḍaśapalāni jaladroṇadvaye kṣipet, śarkarāyāstulāṃ palaśataṃ kṣaudrasya madhunastulāṃ śatapalaṃ māṃsīmaricadhūpite bhāṇḍe māsamekaṃ sthāpayet | uśīrāsavaḥ raktapittādiharaḥ | iti uśīrāsavaḥ || 13-17 || kumāryāsavaḥ -- (supakvarasasaṃśuddhaṃ kumāryāḥ patramāharet || 18 || yatnena rasamādāya pātre pāṣāṇamṛnmaye | droṇe guḍatulāṃ dattvā ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet ||12 || mākṣikaṃ pakvalohaṃ ca tasminnardhatulāṃ kṣipet | kaṭutrikaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca cāturjātakameva ca || 20|| citrakaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ gajapippalī | cavikaṃ hapuṣā dhānyaṃ kramukaṃ kaṭurohiṇī || 21 || mustā phalatrikaṃ rāsnā devadāru niśādvayam | mūrvā madhurasā dantī mūlaṃ puṣkarasaṃbhavam || 22 || balā cātibalā caiva kapikacchūstrikaṇṭakam| śatapuṣpā hiṅgupatrī ākallakamuṭiṅgaṇam || 23 || punarnavādvayaṃ lodhraṃ dhātumākṣikameva ca | eṣāṃ cārdhapalaṃ dattvā dhātakyāstu palāṣṭakam ||24|| palaṃ cārdhapalaṃ caiva paladvayamudāhṛtam | vapurvayaḥpramāṇena balavarṇāgnidīpanam || 25 || bṛhaṇaṃ rocanaṃ vṛṣyaṃ paṅktiśūlanivāraṇam | aṣṭāvudarajānrogānkṣayamugraṃ ca nāśayet || 26 || viṃśatiṃ mehajānrogānudāvartamapasmṛtim | mūtrakṛcchramapasmāraṃ śukradoṣaṃ tathāśmarīm || 27 || kṛmijaṃ raktapittaṃ ca nāśayettu na saṃśayaḥ |) pippalyāsavaḥ kṣayādau | pippalī maricaṃ cavyaṃ haridrā citrako ghanaḥ ||28|| viḍaṅgaṃ kramuko lodhraḥ pāṭhā dhātryelavālukam | uśīraṃ candanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ lavaṅgaṃ tagaraṃ tathā || 29 || māṃsī tvagelāpatraṃ ca priyaṅgurnāgakeśaram | eṣāmardhapalānbhāgānsūkṣmacūrṇīkṛtānśubhān ||30|| jaladroṇadvaye kṣiptvā dadyādguḍatulātrayam | palāni daśa dhātakyā drākṣā ṣaṣṭipalā bhavet ||31 || etānyekatra saṃyojya mṛdbhāṇḍe ca vinikṣipet | jñātvā''gatarasaṃ tasya pāyayedagnyapekṣayā || 32 || kṣayaṃ gulmodaraṃ kārśyaṃ grahaṇīṃ pāṇḍutāṃ gadam | arśāṃsi nāśayecchīghraṃ pippalyādyāsavastvayam||33|| Dī. atha pippalyāsavamāha - pippalīti | ayaṃ pippalyādyāsavaḥ kṣayādiroge praśastaḥ | atra ghano mustaṃ, kramukaḥ pūgīphalaṃ, dhātrī āmalakī, elavālukaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, kuṣṭhaṃ gandhi kaṭphalasadṛśadravyaviśeṣaṃ, tvak varāṅgaṃ, śeṣaṃ prasiddham | śubhāniti ślakṣṇān vastragālitānityarthaḥ | jñātvāgatarasamiti āgatarasaṃ jñātvā tadanu daṇḍena kṛtvā gharṣayet | paścādvastragālitaṃ prāpayet | eke māsenāgatarasaṃ bhavatīti vadanti samīcīnametat | agnyapekṣayā agnibalāpekṣayā etadāturaviṣayaṃ, svasthānāṃ tu paribhāṣoktamātrayā pānaṃ | tadyathā - ‘dvāvañjalī hyuttamāyāṃ mātrā hīnā ca ṣaṭpalā | catuṣpalā madhyamā ca grāhyā sānnaṃ ca sāmiṣam | ato'nyathā bhakṣaṇe hi śaradgrīṣmaṛtau tathā | śoṣādikaṃ prakurute vidhivat tena gṛhyate’ iti || 28-33 || Gū. ghano mustakaḥ, pūgīphalaṃ, dhātrī āmalakī, elavālukaṃ harivālukaṃ sugandhadravyaṃ, māṃsī jaṭāmāṃsī, pallavaṃ patraṃ, eṣāṃ pippalyādīnām ardhapalāṃścūrṇīkṛtān | jaladroṇadvaye kṣiptvā guḍatulātrayaṃ dadyāt | tulāpalaśataṃ dhātakyā daśapalāni drākṣā ṣaṣṭipalā etāni cātra yojyāni | mṛdbhāṇḍe vinikṣipet āgatarasaṃ prāptarasaṃ jñātvā agnyapekṣayā pāyayet | kṣayaṃ gulmādikaṃ ca nāśayet | ayaṃ pippalyāsavaḥ | iti pippalyāsavaḥ || 28-33 || pāṇḍvādau lohāsavaḥ | lohacūrṇaṃ trikaṭukaṃ triphalāṃ ca yavānikām | viḍaṅgaṃ mustakaṃ citraṃ catuḥsaṃkhyāpalaṃ pṛthak || 34 || dhātakīkusumānāṃ tu prakṣipetpalaviṃśatim | cūrṇīkṛtya tataḥ kṣaudraṃ catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ kṣipet || 35 || dadyādguḍatulāṃ tatra jaladroṇadvayaṃ tathā | ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya nidadhyānmāsamātrakam||36|| lohāsavamamuṃ martyaḥ pibedvahnikaraṃ param | pāṇḍuśvayathugulmāni jaṭharāṇyarśasāṃ rujam || 37 || kuṣṭhaṃ plīhāmayaṃ kaṇḍūṃ kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ bhagandaram | arocakaṃ ca grahaṇīṃ hṛdrogaṃ ca vināśayet || 38 || Dī. idānīṃ lohāsavavivaraṇamāha - lohacūrṇamiti | imaṃ lohāsavaṃ martyaḥ puruṣaḥ pibet, yasmāt paraṃ vahnikaraṃ bhavati lohacūrṇamayacūrṇaṃ, trikaṭukaṃ prasiddham | triphalāṃ harītakyādikaṃ catuṣpalamitaṃ, pṛthagiti pratyekaṃ kuḍavapramāṇamityarthaḥ | ghṛtabhāṇḍa iti cikkaṇatvāddṛḍhatvāt | māsaikaṃ yāvat saṃdhitavyaṃ tato jātarasaṃ bhavati | dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍasya ca ( tulāṃ kṣipet) || 34-38 || Gū. atha lohāsavaḥ | lohacūrṇādikaṃ pṛthak catuḥsaṃkhyāpalaṃ | citraṃ citrakaṃ, kṣaudraṃ madhu catuḥṣaṣṭipalaṃ guḍatulāṃ jaladroṇadvaye ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya māsamātraṃ sthāpayet | imaṃ lohāsavaṃ martyaḥ pibet | spaṣṭamanyat || 34-38 || mṛdvīkāriṣṭaḥ | (mṛdvīkāyāḥ palaśataṃ caturdroṇe'mbhasaḥ pacet | droṇaśeṣe suśīte ca pūte tasminpradāpayet || 39 || tule dve kṣaudrakhaṇḍābhyāṃ dhātakyāḥ prasthameva ca | kaṅkolakaṃ lavaṅgaṃ ca phalaṃ jātyāstathaiva ca || 40 || palāṃśakaṃ ca maricatvagelāpatrakesaram | pippalī citrakaṃ cavyaṃ pippalīmūlareṇuke || 41 || ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya candanāgarudhūpite | karpūravāsito hyeṣa grahaṇyā dīpanaḥ paraḥ || 42 || arśasāṃ nāśane śreṣṭha udāvartasya gulmanut | jaṭharakrimikuṣṭhāni vraṇāstu vividhāstathā || 43 || akṣirogaśirorogagalarogāṃśca nāśayet |) athāriṣṭāḥ, tatrādau kuṭajāriṣṭaḥ jvarādau - tulāṃ kuṭajamūlasya mṛdvīkārdhatulāṃ tathā || 44 || madhūkapuṣpakāśmaryabhāgāndaśapalonmitān | caturdroṇe'mbhasaḥ paktvā kvāthe droṇāvaśeṣite ||45|| dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍasya ca tulāṃ kṣipet | māsamātraṃ sthito bhāṇḍe kuṭajāriṣṭasaṃjñitaḥ ||46|| jvarānpraśamayetsarvānkuryāttīkṣṇaṃ dhanañjayam | Dī. idānīmariṣṭaṃ darśayannāha - tulāmiti | ayaṃ kuṭajāriṣṭaḥ sarvajvarān hanti iti | sarvāniti aṣṭaprakārān | atha ca dhanañjayamagniṃ tīkṣṇaṃ pācanasāmarthyaṃ yathā syāt tathā kuryāt | atra kuṭajo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, mṛdvīkā drākṣā, tulā palaśataṃ jñeyaṃ, madhūkapuṣpakāśmaryaphalānāṃ pṛthak daśapalāni deyāni | kāśmaryaphalābhāve challī grāhyā | etat sakalaṃ māsamātraṃ yāvatsaṃdhitavyam || 44-46 || Gū. kuṭajamūlasya vatsakamūlasya tulāṃ palaśataṃ | mṛdvīkā drākṣā tasyā ardhatulāṃ pañcāśatpalāni, madhukadravā tatpuṣpaṃ, kāśmaryaṃ gambhārī, etau daśapalau bahuvacanaṃ puṣpāṇāṃ bahutvāt, ambhasaścaturdroṇaśeṣe kvāthe dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ guḍasya ca tulāṃ śatapalaṃ kṣipet māsamekaṃ ca sthāpayet | tataḥ pibet | ariṣṭaḥ kvāthasiddhatvāt kvāthakaraṇam || 44-46 || atha viḍaṅgāriṣṭaḥ vidradhyādau - viḍaṅgaṃ granthikaṃ rāsnā kuṭajatvakphalāni ca || 47 || pāṭhailavālukaṃ dhātrī bhāgānpañcapalānpṛthak | aṣṭadroṇe'mbhasaḥ paktvā kuryāddroṇāvaśeṣitam ||48|| pūte śīte kṣipettatra kṣaudraṃ palaśatatrayam | dhātakīṃ viṃśatipalāṃ trijātaṃ dvipalaṃ tathā || 49 || priyaṅgukāñcanārāṇāṃ salodhrāṇāṃ palaṃ palam | vyoṣasya ca palānyaṣṭau cūrṇīkṛtya pradāpayet ||50|| ghṛtabhāṇḍe vinikṣipya māsamekaṃ nidhāpayet | tataḥ pibedyathārhaṃ tu jayedvidradhimutthitam || 52|| ūrustambhāśmarīmehānpratyaṣṭhīlābhagandarān | gaṇḍamālāṃ hanustambhaṃ viḍaṅgāriṣṭasaṃjñakam || 53 || Dī. atha viḍaṅgāriṣṭamāha - viḍaṅgamiti | eṣa viḍaṅgāriṣṭo vidradhiprabhṛtīn rogān jayet | tatrāśmarīrogaṃ | dravyāṇi tu granthikaṃ pippalīmūlaṃ | kecidgranthikasthāne kramukamiti paṭhanti tatra kramukaṃ pūgīphalaṃ, rāsnā surabhī, phalānīti kuṭajaphalāni, pāṭhā ambaṣṭhā, elavālukaṃ prasiddham, dhātrī āmalakī etat pṛthakpañcapalaparimitaṃ pūte vastragālite śīte himasparśe | śītagrahaṇamatra madhumelanatvāt | ‘uṣṇairvirudhyate madhu’ iti vacanāt | trijātamiti trisugandhaṃ vikhyātaṃ,tacca militvā dvipalamityarthaḥ | vyoṣasya trikaṭukasya militvā'ṣṭau palāni | kartavyatā'sya vyavahārato boddhavyā | yathārhamiti yathāyogyaṃ tena doṣāgnyapekṣayā dātavyamityarthaḥ ||47-52 || atha devadārvyādyariṣṭaḥ pramehādau - tulārdhaṃ devadāroḥ syādvāsā ca palaviṃśati: | mañjiṣṭhendrayavā dantī tagaraṃ rajanīdvayam || 53 || rāsnā kṛmighnaṃ mustaṃ ca śirīṣaṃ khadirārjunau | bhāgāndaśapalāndadyādyavānyā vatsakasya ca || 54 || candanasya guḍūcyāśca rohiṇyāścitrakasya ca | bhāgānaṣṭapalānetānaṣṭadroṇe'mbhasa: pacet ||55|| droṇaśeṣe kaṣāye ca pūte śīte pradāpayet | dhātakyāḥ ṣoḍaśapalaṃ mākṣikasya tulātrayam || 56|| vyoṣasya dvipalaṃ dadyāttrijātasya catuṣpalam | catuṣpalaṃ priyaṅgośca dvipalaṃ nāgakeśaram || 57 || sarvāṇyetani saṃcūrṇya ghṛtabhāṇḍe nidhāpayet | māsādūrdhvaṃ pibedenaṃ pramehaṃ hanti durjayam || 458 || vātarogāngrahaṇyarśomūtrakṛcchrāṇi nāśayet | devadārvādiko'riṣṭaḥ kaṇḍūkuṣṭhavināśanaḥ || 59 || Dī. atha devadārvādikāriṣṭamāha - tulārdhamiti | devadāroriti ṣaṣṭhyantatvāt kāṣṭhaṃ grāhyaṃ, vāsā āṭarūṣakastasya mūlaṃ grāhyaṃ, indrayavāḥ kuṭajabījāni, dantī prasiddhā, tagaraṃ prasiddhaṃ, rajanīdvayaṃ haridrādvayaṃ, rāsnā prasiddhā, kṛmighnaṃ viḍaṅgaṃ, śirīṣo vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, khadiro'pi vṛkṣaḥ, arjuna iti ca vṛkṣaviśeṣaḥ, etat sakalaṃ pṛthak daśapalaparimitam| sakalamiti mañjiṣṭhādi arjunāntaṃ yamānyādicitrakāntaṃ pṛthak cāṣṭapalamitaṃ tatra vatsakaḥ kuṭajaḥ rohiṇī kaṭukīśabdavācyā pūte vastragālite śīte śītībhūte vyoṣasya militvā dvipalaṃ trijātasyāpi militvā catuṣpalāni| trijātaṃ trisugandhaṃ | priyaṅgoriti phalāni | eṣa pūrvayuktyā kartavyaḥ dṛṣṭavyavahāreṇa vā ||53-59|| Gū. kṛmighnaṃ viḍaṅgam, arjunaṃ arjunavṛkṣaḥ, vatsakasya kuṭajasya, candanasya raktasya, rohiṇyā kaṭurohiṇyā aṣṭadroṇe jale | spaṣṭamanyat || 53-59 || atha khadirāriṣṭaṃ kuṣṭhādau - khadirasya tulārdhaṃ tu devadāru ca tatsamam | bākucī dvādaśapalā dārvī syātpalaviṃśatiḥ || 60 || triphalā viṃśatipalā hyaṣṭadroṇe'mbhasaḥ pacet | kaṣāye droṇaśeṣe ca pūte śīte vinikṣipet || 61 || tulādvayaṃ mākṣikasya tulaikā śarkarā matā | dhātakyā viṃśatipalaṃ kaṅkolaṃ nāgakeśaram || 62 || jātīphalaṃ lavaṅgailātvakpatrāṇi pṛthakpṛthak | palonmitāni kṛṣṇāyā
