|| 211 || dinānte dāpayetpathyaṃ varjayecchītalaṃ jalam | sarvodaraharaḥ prokto mūḍhavātaharaḥ paraḥ || 212|| Dī. catuḥsūtasyeti | sūtasya pāradasya catvāro bhāgāḥ, gandhakasya cāṣṭau bhāgāḥ | rajanīprabhūtipañcadravyāṇi pṛthag dvibhāgayutāni bhavanti | rajanī haridrā, triphalā harītakyādikaṃ, śivā harītakī anena harītakīdviruktena bhāgāt saiva dviguṇā kāryā | kecicchivāsthāne śilā iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | tatra śilā manaḥśilā, trivṛjjaipālacitrakaṃ pratyekaṃ tribhāgayutaṃ grāhyam | trivṛnniśothaḥ | jaipālaṃ dantibījaṃ, citrakaṃ citrakajaṭātvak, tryūṣaṇaṃ dantī ca jīrakamapi pratyekamaṣṭabhāgaṃ jñeyam | tryūṣaṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ tacca śuṇṭhīmaricapippalīsaṃjñam | dantī prasiddhā, jīrakaṃ śvetam | atha bhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - jayantītyādi | jayantī śākabhedaḥ jīvantītyapare, snukpayaḥ sehuṇḍakṣīraṃ, bhṛṅgaṃ mākavaṃ tacca ghamarāśavdavācyam, na tu bhṛṅgamatra guḍatvak, vahniścitrakaḥ, vātāritailameraṇḍatailam | śeṣaṃ subodham || || 208-212 || Gū. atha vahniraso jalodarādau - śivā harītakī dviguṇā punaruktatvāt | trivṛt nisotaḥ, dantībījaṃ jaipālaṃ, citrakaṃ prasiddham etattribhāgaṃ pratyekaṃ | tryūṣaṇaṃ trikaṭu, dantījaṭā, jīrakaṃ pratyekamaṣṭabhāgaṃ, jayantī śākaviśeṣaḥ, snuk sehuṇḍadugdhaṃ, bhṛṅgaṃ mārkavaḥ, vahniścitrakaḥ, vātāritailam eraṇḍatailaṃ, pratyekena rasena saptasaptavāraṃ bhāvyam ||208-212 || atha vidyādharo rasaḥ gulmaplīhādau - gandhakaṃ tālakaṃ tāpyaṃ mṛtatāmraṃ manaḥśilām | śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ ca tulyāṃśaṃ mardayedbhāvayeddinam ||213|| pippalyāstu kaṣāyeṇa vajrīkṣīreṇa bhāvayet | niṣkārdhaṃ bhakṣayetkṣaudrairgulmaṃ plīhādikaṃ jayet||214|| raso vidyādharo nāma gomūtraṃ ca pibedanu | Dī. atha vidyādhararasamāha - gandhamiti | tāpyamatra suvarṇamākṣikaṃ | śuddhasūtamiti | saṃskāritasūtam etatsakalaṃ samamātraṃ mardayet| bhāvayeddinamiti pūrvaṃ dravyaṃ sakalaṃ saṃmardya paścāduktadraveṇa bhāvayet | dinamiti pratyekaṃ śeṣaṃ sugamam || 213 || 214 || Gū. vajrī sehuṇḍaḥ | śeṣaṃ sugamam ||213||214|| atha trinetro rasaḥ paktiśūlādau - ṭaṅkaṇaṃ hāriṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ svarṇaṃ śulbaṃ mṛtaṃ rasam ||215|| dinaikamārdrakadrāvairmardyaṃ ruddhvā puṭe pacet | trinetrākhyarasasyaikaṃ māṣaṃ madhvājyakairlihet || 216|| saindhavaṃ jīrakaṃ hiṅgu madhvājyābhyāṃ lihedanu | paktiśūlaharaḥ khyāto māsamātrānna saṃśayaḥ ||217|| Dī. saubhāgyakṣāraṃ taccātra bharjitaṃ deyaṃ, svarṇaṃ śulbamapi mṛtamatra deyaṃ | rodhanamatra śarāvasampuṭavidhānaṃ puṭamatra gajapuṭam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 215-217 || Gū. ṭaṅkaṇaṃ saubhāgyaṃ, hāriṇaṃ śṛṅgaṃ, svarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, śuddhaṃ tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ, ruddhvā śarāvasaṃpuṭe vanopalaiḥ pacet | spaṣṭamanyat || 215-217 || atha śūlagajakesarīrasaḥ śūle - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ dvidhā gandhaṃ yāmaikaṃ mardayeddṛḍham | dvayostulyaṃ śuddhatāmraṃ saṃpuṭe tannirodhayet ||218|| ūrdhvādho lavaṇaṃ dattvā mṛdbhāṇḍe dhārayedbhiṣak | tato gajapuṭe paktvā svāṅgaśītaṃ samuddharet ||219|| saṃpuṭaṃ cūrṇayetsūkṣmaṃ parṇakhaṇḍe dviguñjakam | bhakṣayetsarvaśūlārto hiṅgu śuṇṭhī ca jīrakam ||220|| vacāmaricajaṃ cūrṇaṃ karṣamuṣṇajalai: pibet | asādhyaṃ nāśayecchūlaṃ raso'yaṃ gajakesarī ||221 || Dī. atha gajakesarīrasamāha - śuddhaṃ sūtamiti | dṛḍhamardanenātra rasagandhakayoḥ kajjalīṃ kuryādityabhiprāyaḥ | sampradāyastu amlarasaiḥ saha dṛḍhamardanaṃ kāryaṃ na doṣaḥ | dvayostulyaṃ śuddhatāmramiti | dvayoḥ pāradagandhakayoḥ śuddhatāmraṃ mṛtatāmram | eke dvayostulye śuddhatāmrasampuṭe iti paṭhanti vyākhyānayanti ca | sampuṭaṃ cūrṇayediti vacanādayameva pakṣaḥ samīcīnaḥ| tena tāmrasampuṭe eva rasagandhakabhasma rodhayedityartham iti | anupānaṃ hiṃgvādicūrṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ karṣamānaṃ saṃgṛhya caturguṇenoṣṇodakena saha pibet ||218-221|| Gū. sugamam || 218-221 || athāgnituṇḍavaṭīsarasaḥ agnimāndyādau - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhamajamodāṃ phalatrayam | svarjikṣāraṃ yavakṣāraṃ vahnisaindhavajīrakam || 222 || sauvarcalaṃ viḍaṅgāni sāmudraṃ tryūṣaṇaṃ samam | viṣamuṣṭiṃ sarvatulyaṃ jambīrāmlena mardayet || 223 || maricābhāṃ vaṭīṃ khādedvahnimāndyapraśāntaye | Dī. athāgnituṇḍavaṭīrasamāha - śuddhasūtamityādi | eke śuddhasūtasamaṃ gandhamiti paṭhanti viṣaṃ na paṭhanti tadasaṅgataṃ | bahusthāneṣu dṛṣṭatvāt | viṣamuṣṭiḥ kucelāśabdavācyaḥ sa ca sakaladravyaparimāṇena sāmyo yojyaḥ | eke vahnimāndyapraśāntaye ityasyānte tadanupānaślokamekaṃ paṭhanti mānayanti ca ‘pathyā śuṇṭhī guḍaṃ cānu palārdhaṃ bhakṣayet sadā | agnituṇḍā vaṭī khyātā sarvarogakulāntakā’ || 222 || 223 || Gū. vahniścitrakaḥ, viṣamuṣṭiḥ mahānimbaphalaṃ kucelaṃ vā dvayorabhāve samudraphalaṃ vā deyam || 222 || || 223 || athājīrṇakaṇṭako rasaḥ - śuddhaṃ sūtaṃ viṣaṃ gandhaṃ samaṃ sarvaṃ vicūrṇayet || 224 || maricaṃ sarvatulyāṃśaṃ kaṇṭakāryāḥ phaladravaiḥ | mardayedbhāvayetsarvamekaviṃśativārakam || 225 || vaṭīṃ guñjātrayaṃ khādetsarvājīrṇapraśāntaye | ajīrṇakaṇṭakaḥ so'yaṃ raso hanti viṣūcikā || 226 || Dī. athājīrṇakaṇṭakarasamāha - śuddhasūtamityādi | śuddharasaṃ śuddhaviṣaṃ śuddhagandhakaṃ ca etattrikaṃ ca samamātraṃ saṃgṛhya tadanu ebhistribhiḥ sāmyaṃ ca maricacūrṇaṃ kṛtvā khalve taccatuṣkaṃ saṃcūrṇya paścāduktadraveṇa bhāvayet | yāvadekaviṃśatisaṃkhyakaṃ bhavati tāvadbhāvayedityarthaḥ | kaṇṭakāryā iti laghukaṇṭakāriphalāni | kecidanupānārthaṃ ślokamekaṃ paṭhanti | ‘anu syādīśvarīmūlaṃ toyapiṣṭaṃ ca pāyayet | śaṅkhaṃ cāśvatthamūlaṃ vā vāriṇā'jīrṇajidbhavet’ etanna pracarati || 224-226 || Gū. sugamam || 224-226 || kaphādau manthānabhairavarasaḥ | mṛtaṃ sūtaṃ mṛtaṃ tāmraṃ hiṅgu puṣkaramūlakam | saindhavaṃ gandhakaṃ tālaṃ kaṭukīṃ cūrṇayetsamam ||227|| punarnavādevadālīnirguṇḍītaṇḍulīyakaiḥ | tiktakośātakīdrāvairdinaikaṃ mardayeddṛḍham || 228 || māṣamātraṃ lihetkṣaudrai rasaṃ manthānabhairavam | kapharogapraśāntyarthaṃ nimbakvāthaṃ pibedanu || 229 || Dī. atha manthānabhairavarasamāha - mṛtaṃ sūtamityādi | atra puṣkaramūlābhāve kuṣṭhaṃ grāhyam | gandhakaṃ tālamapi śodhitaṃ grāhyam | tālaṃ haritālaṃ taṇḍulīyo meghanādaḥ || 227-229 || Gū. tālaṃ haritālaṃ kaṭukī etatsamaṃ mṛtsūtādyam aṣṭauṣadhaṃ cūrṇitam ebhiḥ punarnavādibhirbhāvayet | punarnavā varṣābhūḥ devadālī nirguṇḍī taṇḍulīyakaṃ meghanādaḥ tiktakośātakī jālinī eṣāṃ drāvairdinaikaṃ mardayet | punardugdhena mardayet | māṣamātraṃ kṣaudrairlihet upari nimbapatrakvāthaṃ pibet | eraṇḍanālena vānti kārayet | kaphakṣayakāsādayo yānti || 227-229 || atha vātanāśano rasaḥ - sūtahāṭakavajrāṇi tāmraṃ lohaṃ ca mākṣikam| tālaṃ nīlāñjanaṃ tutthamahiphenaṃ samāṃśakam ||230|| pañcānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca bhāgamekaṃ vimardayet | vajrīkṣīrairdinaikaṃ tu ruddhvādho bhūdhare pacet || 231 || māṣaikamārdrakadrāvairlehayedvātanāśanam | pippalīmūlajakvāthaṃ sakṛṣṇamanupāyayet || 232 || sarvānvātavikārāṃstu nihantyākṣepakādikān| Dī. atha vātanāśanarasamāha - sūtahāṭakavajrāṇīti | sūtaṃ pāradaṃ, hāṭakaṃ suvarṇaṃ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ | eke mākṣikasthāne gandhakamiti paṭhanti etanmanoharam | tālaṃ haritālaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ prasiddhaṃ tadabhāve sīsakaṃ grāhyam | tatsambhavatvāt abdhiphenaṃ samudraphenam | etatsakalaṃ samamātram | pañcānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ pañcabhāgā ityarthaḥ | ‘sindhusauvarcalopetaṃ biḍaṃ sāmudrajaṃ gaḍam’ iti pañcalavaṇam | ruddhvādho bhūdhare pacediti | tatsakalaṃ dinaikam ekadinaṃ saṃmardya paścādbhūdharayantre pacedityabhiprāyaḥ | bhūdharayantraṃ tu pūrvaṃ darśitameva | anupāne sakṛṣṇamiti pippalīcūrṇaṃ, prakṣepaṇaṃ kuryāt | ayameva raso granthāntare bhūtonmādārthaṃ paṭhitaḥ | atra kvacidviparītatā dṛśyate tathāhi - sūtāyastāmramabhraṃ ca mṛtaṃ svarṇaṃ samaṃ samam | sūtapādaṃ mṛtaṃ vajraṃ tālaṃ gandhaṃ manaḥśilām || tutthaṃ nīlāñjanaṃ śuddhamabdhiphenaṃ samaṃ rasāt | pañcānāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca pratibhāgaṃ rasonmitam || citrakairbhṛṅgarājaiśca vajrīdugdhaiśca mardayet | dinānte golakaṃ kṛtvā ruddhvā gajapuṭe pacet|| mahābhūtāṅkuśo nāma raso guñjādvayaṃ lihet | ārdrakasya rasaireva bhūtonmādapraśāntaye || pippalyā'ktaṃ pibeccānu daśamūlaṃ kaṣāyakam’ (iti) || 230-232 || Gū. sūtaṃ mṛtaṃ pāradaṃ, hāṭakaṃ svarṇaṃ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ, mṛtamabhrakaṃ vā, lohaṃ, mākṣikaṃ svarṇamākṣikaṃ, tālaṃ haritālaṃ, nīlāñjanaṃ, tutthaṃ śuddhaṃ māritaṃ, tadabhāve tāmraṃ vā deyaṃ vamanabhayāt | ahiphenam akūkam etatsamaṃ vajrakṣāraiḥ vimardayet ||230-232 || atha kanakasundaraḥ sannipātādau - kanakasyāṣṭaśāṇāḥ syuḥ sūto dvādaśabhirmataḥ ||233 || gandho'pi dvādaśa proktastāmraṃ śāṇadvayonmitam | abhrakaṃ syāccatuḥśāṇaṃ mākṣikaṃ ca dviśāṇikam ||234|| vaṅgo dviśāṇaḥ sauvīraṃ triśāṇaṃ lohamaṣṭakam | viṣaṃ triśāṇikaṃ kṛtvā lāṅgalī palasaṃmitā ||235|| mardayeddinamekaṃ tu rasairamlaphalodbhavaiḥ | dadyānmṛdupuṭaṃ vahnau tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ vicūrṇayet ||236|| māṣamātro raso deyaḥ saṃnipāte sudāruṇe | ārdrakasvarasenaiva rasonasya rasena vā || 237 || kilāsaṃ sarvakuṣṭhāni visarpaṃ ca bhagandaram | jvaraṃ garamajīrṇaṃ ca jayedrogaharo rasaḥ ||238 || Dī. atha kanakasundararasamāha - kanakasyetyādi | kanakādīnyatra mṛtāni grāhyāṇi śāṇopalakṣitatvādatra bhāga eva boddhavyaḥ yathāsambhavatvāt | kanakamatra suvarṇaṃ, sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, gandho gandhakaḥ, sauvīraṃ sauvīrāñjanaṃ,lohaṃ sārasaṃjñam, lāṅgalī kalihārikā, amlaphalāni bījapūrajambīraprabhṛtīni | mṛdupuṭamatra gajapuṭaviśeṣam | śeṣaṃ sugamam || 233-238 || Gū. kanakasya dhattūrabījasya aṣṭa śāṇāḥ aṣṭa ṭaṅkāḥ, sūtaḥ śuddhaḥ dvādaśa ṭaṅkaḥ, tāmraṃ mṛtaṃ dviśāṇam, abhrakaṃ catuḥśāṇaṃ, mākṣikaṃ mṛtaṃ dviśāṇaṃ, vaṅgo mṛtaḥ dviśāṇaḥ, sauvīraḥ añjanaṃ triśāṇaṃ, lohaṃ mṛtam aṣṭaśāṇam | viṣaṃ triśāṇaṃ, lāṅgalī kalihārī palapramāṇā, amlavetasādyai: mṛdupuṭaṃ dadyāt | punaḥ māṣamātro deyaḥ | ādrakarasena rasonarasena vā kilāsaṃ citrakuṣṭhāni visarpabhagaṃdaraṃ jvaraṃ viṣam ajīrṇaṃ jayet etadrogaharo rasaḥ kanakasundaraḥ || 233-238 || atha sannipātabhairavo rasaḥ -- raso gandhastrikarṣaḥ syāt kuryātkajjalikāṃ tayoḥ | tāmratārāravaṅgāhisārāścaikaikakārṣikāḥ ||239|| śigrujvālāmukhīśuṇṭhībilvebhyastaṇḍulīyakān | pratyekaṃ svarasaiḥ kuryādyāmaikaikaṃ vimardanam || 240 || kṛtvā golaṃ vṛtaṃ vastre lavaṇāpūrite nyaset | kācabhāṇḍe tataḥ sthālyāṃ kācakūpīṃ niveśayet || vālukābhiḥ prapūryātha vahniryāmadvayaṃ bhavet | tata uddhṛtya taṃ golaṃ cūrṇayitvā vimiśrayet ||242|| pravāṇacūrṇakarṣeṇa śāṇamātraviṣeṇa ca | kṛṣṇasarpasya garalairdvivelaṃ bhāvayettathā || 243 || tagaraṃ muśalī māṃsī hemāhvā cetasaḥ kaṇā | nīlinī patrakaṃ cailā citrakaśca kuṭherakaḥ || 244 || śatapuṣpā devadālī dhattūrāgastyamuṇḍikāḥ | madhūkajātīmadanarasaireṣāṃ vimardayet || 245 || pratyekamekavelaṃ ca tataḥ saṃśoṣya dhārayet | bījapūrārdrakadrāvairmaricaiḥ ṣoḍaśonmitaiḥ || 246 || raso dviguñjāpramitaḥ saṃnipāteṣu dīyate | prasiddho'yaṃ raso nāmnā saṃnipātasya bhairavaḥ ||247|| Dī. atha sannipātabhairavarasamāha - raso gandhastrikarṣaḥ syādityādi | rasaḥ pāradaḥ, gandho gandhakaḥ etaddvayaṃ militaṃ trikarṣaṃ syādityarthaḥ | tāmratārāravaṅgāhisārāścaikaikakārṣikā iti | tāmraṃ prasiddham | tāraṃ raupyam, āraṃ pītalohaṃ, vaṅgaṃ raṅgavācyam, ahiḥ sīsakaṃ | sāro lohaḥ etattāmrādikaṃ sarvaṃ mṛtaṃ grāhyamiti sampradāyaḥ | ekaikakārṣikā iti | pratyekaṃ karṣasaṃmitā ityabhiprāyaḥ | aparamapi śigru śobhāñjanaṃ jvālāmukhī jayantī bilvebhya iti | bilvamūlādrasairiti śeṣaḥ | taṇḍulīyaḥ meghanādaśabdavācyaḥ | svarasamatra sadyaskaṃ kvathitarasaṃ vā | atha prakṣepārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - tatra siddharase pravāṇacūrṇakarṣeṇeti | pravāṇacūrṇaṃ viṣacūrṇaṃ ca miśrayet | pravāṇacūrṇaṃ karṣapramāṇaṃ, viṣacūrṇaṃ śāṇamātramiti | pravāṇamiti prakarṣeṇa vāṇaṃ sudhācūrṇamityarthaḥ | eke pravālacūrṇaṃ paṭhanti tatra pravālacūrṇaṃ vidrumacūrṇaṃ| śuktikācūrṇamityapare tadabhāve śaṅkhacūrṇamityasmadīyaḥ sampradāyaḥ | bhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - kṛṣṇasarpasya garalaiḥ kṛtvā tatpūrvoktaṃ dravyaṃ dvivelaṃ yāvadbhāvayet | garalaṃ tadviṣaṃ viśeṣam | tagarādibhiśca tadvāramekaṃ bhāvayet | pratyekamiti pṛthak pṛthak | tagaraṃ prasiddham | māṃsī jaṭākhyā, hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī, vetaso jalavetasaḥ, kaṇā pippalī, nīlinīpatrakamiti nīlikāpatram eke nīlinī patrakaṃ ca dravyadvayaṃ vyākhyānayanti tacca na sarvamataṃ, kuṭherakaḥ prasiddhaḥ, devadālī vallīviśeṣaḥ, muṇḍikā kedāramuṇḍī, madhūkaṃ madhūkavṛkṣaḥ, jātī mālatīraso'tra sadyaskaḥ kvathito vā yathālābhāt | ayaṃ siddharaso dviguñjāpramitaḥ ṣoḍaśamaricānvito bījapūrārdrakarasena saha bhakṣayet ||239|| 247 || Gū. pāradaḥ, gandhakaḥ trikarṣau etau, mṛtaṃ tāraṃ mṛtaṃ rūpyam | abhram abhrakaṃ, vaṅgam, ahiḥ nāgaṃ, sāraṃ loham ete ekaikakarṣakāḥ | śigru śobhāñjanam, jvālāmukhī jayantī, taṇḍulīyakaḥ, ebhirgolakaṃ kṛtvā punarvastrairvṛtaṃ kācapātrasthaṃ lavaṇapūrite bhāṇḍe nyaset | vahniṃ dadyāt | yāmadvayam | tataḥ punaḥ pravālacūrṇakarṣeṇa śāṇamātraviṣeṇa melayitvā kṛṣṇasarpasya garalairbhāvayet divasamekaṃ dinaṃ paścātsthālikāyāṃ haṇḍikāyāṃ ca kupīṃ niveśayet | hemāhvā svarṇakṣīrī, nīlinī aparājitā, kuṭherakaḥ śvetatulasī, devadālī | madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaṃ, jātī mālatī, madanaphalaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 239-247 || atīsārādau grahaṇīkapāṭaḥ - tāramauktikahemāni sāraścaikaikabhāgikāḥ | dvibhāgo gandhakaḥ sūtastribhāgo mardayedimān||248|| kapitthasvarasairgāḍhaṃ mṛgaśṛṅge tataḥ kṣipet | puṭenmadhyapuṭenaiva tata udbhṛtya mardayet ||249|| balārasaiḥ saptavelamapāmārgarasaistridhā | lodhraprativiṣāmustadhātakīndrayavāmṛtāḥ || 250 || pratyekameṣāṃ svarasairbhāvanā syāttridhā tridhā | māṣamātro raso deyo madhunā maricaistathā || 251 || hanyātsarvānatīsārāngrahaṇīṃ sarvajāmapi | kapāṭo grahaṇīroge raso'yaṃ vahnidīpanaḥ || 252 || Dī. atha grahaṇīkapāṭarasamāha - tāramauktikahemānītyādi sugamam | madhyapuṭaṃ tu laghupuṭasaṃjñaṃ tacca ṣoḍaśāṅgulagarte pratipāditam | tathāhi - ‘nipuṇavihitagartaḥ ṣoḍaśairaṅgulairvā mitasakalavibhāgastasya madhye nidhāya | jvalanamativiśuṣkairgomayaiḥ sūtasiddhyai laghugajapuṭamevaṃ pūrvamuktaṃ munīndraiḥ’ iti | maricamānamapyatra māṣamātram | athavā doṣāpekṣayā deyam || 248-252 || Gū. tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ mauktikaṃ, muktāphalaṃ, hema svarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, sāro mṛtalohaḥ, ete pratyekabhāgikāḥ | dvibhāgo gandhaḥ, sūtaḥ pāradaḥ śuddhatribhāgaḥ | etān kajjalīkṛtya kapitthaphalasvarasairmardya mṛgaśṛṅge sthāpayet | mṛtkarpaṭaṃ datvā madhyapuṭe puṭet | balā prasiddhā tadrasaiḥ saptavelaṃ saptavāraṃ bhāvayet | apāmārga ūrdhvakaṇṭakaḥ tadrasaistridhā bhāvayet | lodhraṃ prasiddhaṃ, prativiṣā ativiṣā, mustaṃ nāgaraṃ, dhātakīpuṣpāṇi, indrayavaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī eṣāṃ svarasaiḥ pratyekaṃ tridhā bhāvanā syāt | tadādisiddho māṣamātro deyaḥ | madhunā tathā maricairapi māṣamātraiḥ sarvānatīsārān tathā sarvajāṃ grahaṇīṃ hanyāt || 248-252 || atha grahaṇīvajrakapāṭaḥ - mṛtasūtābhrakaṃ gandhaṃ yavakṣāraṃ saṭaṅkaṇam | agnimanthaṃ vacāṃ kuryātsūtatulyānimānsudhīḥ ||253|| tato jayantījamvīrabhṛṅgadrāvairvimardayet | trivāsaraṃ tato golaṃ kṛtvā saṃśoṣya dhārayet ||254|| lohapātre śarāvaṃ ca dattvopari vimudrayet | adho vahniṃ śanaiḥ kuryādyāmārdhaṃ tata uddharet||255|| rasatulyāṃ prativiṣāṃ dadyānmocarasaṃ tathā | kapitthavijayādrāvairbhāvayetsaptadhā pṛthak ||256|| dhātakīndrayavā mustā lodhraṃ bilvaṃ guḍūcikā | etadrasairbhāvayitvā velaikaikaṃ ca śoṣayet || 257|| rasaṃ vajrakapāṭākhyaṃ śāṇaikaṃ madhunā lihet | vahniṃ śuṇṭhīṃ biḍaṃ bilvaṃ lavaṇaṃ cūrṇayetsamam ||258|| pibeduṣṇāmbunā cānu sarvajāṃ grahaṇīṃ jayet | Dī. atha grahaṇīvajrakapāṭarasamāha - mṛtasūtābhrakamiti | mṛtasūtaṃ pāradaṃ bhavati tāvat parimāṇaṃ pṛthak ṣaḍdravyāṇi grāhyāṇi | eke ṣaḍdravyaṃ tu pāradasāmyaṃ deyamiti manyaṃte tanna sarvamatam| kiṃtu mṛtapāradasyaiko bhāgaḥ | abhrakādīnāṃ ṣaḍbhāgā iti sarvamatam | tatastasmāt | jayantī śākabhedaḥ | jambīraṃ jambīraphalarasaḥ | bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ | trivāsaramityanenaikadravyasyaikāhameva bhāvanā deyetyabhiprāyaḥ | lohapātra ityādinā piṭharīyaṃ vālukābhiḥ prapūryetyasmadīyasampradāyāt kāryo na doṣaḥ | yāmārdhamityanena ghaṭikācatuṣṭayaṃ yāvat etatsiddhaṃ bhavati tadā prativiṣāṃ mocarasaṃ ca pṛthaksiddhaṃ rasatulyaṃ melayitvā paścāduktadravyasya rasaiḥ kṛtvā bhāvayet | prativiṣā ativiṣāśabdavācyā | mocarasaṃ śālmalīniryāsam | eke prativiṣāmocarasayorapi bhāvanāmāhuḥ | vijayā'tra bhaṅgā, saptadhā bhāvanā ekadravyeṇa kāryā, anyeṣāṃ vakṣyamāṇānāṃ pṛthagekavāraṃ tatra dhātakī dhātakīkusumāni, indrayavaṃ kuṭajabījaṃ, rāsnā surabhī, madhvatra lehane yāvattāvanmānaṃ deyam | anupānārthadravyeṣu vahniścitrakajaṭā, biḍaṃ biḍalavaṇaṃ, lavaṇaṃ saindhavam || 253-258 || Gū. mṛtasūtaṃ mṛtapāradam, abhrakaṃ, gandhakaṃ, yavakṣāraṃ, saubhāgyam, agnimantho, vacā etāni sūtatulyāni kuryāt | yāvat sūtaṃ pratyekabhāgaṃ mataḥ | tato jayantyādibhirvimardayet | trivāsaraṃ tridinaṃ tato golaṃ kṛtvā saṃśoṣya lohapātre kaṭāhikādau dhṛtvā upari śarāvaṃ datvā mudrayet | śanairyāmārdhaṃ vahṇiṃ kuryāt | golakatulyāṃ prativiṣāṃ tathā mocarasaṃ datvā kapitthādibhiḥ saptasapta bhāvayet | vijayā bhaṅgā, kapitthaṃ prasiddhaṃ, tairdhātakyādibhirvāraikaṃ bhāvayet | dhātakīpuṣpāṇi, indrayavaḥ mustaṃ, lodhraṃ, bilvaṃ, guḍūcī etaiḥ śāṇaṃ ṭaṅkaṃ madhunā lihet | vahniścitrakaṃ, śuṇṭhī, biḍaṃ biḍalavaṇaṃ, saindhavam etadanupānaṃ pibet || 253-258 || atha madanakāmadevo vājīkaraṇe - tāraṃ vajraṃ suvarṇaṃ ca tāmraṃ sūtakagandhakam || 259 || lohaṃ kramavivṛddhāni kuryādetāni mātrayā | vimardya kanyakādrāvairnyasetkācamaye ghaṭe || 260 || vimudrāṃ piṭharīmadhye dhārayetsaindhavāvṛte | piṭharīṃ mudrayetsamyak tataścullyāṃ niveśayet||261 || vahniṃ śanaiḥ śanaiḥ kuryāddinaikaṃ tata uddharet | svāṅgaśītaṃ ca saṃcūrṇya bhāvayedarkadugdhakaiḥ || 262 || aśvagandhā ca kākolī vānarī muśalīkṣurā | tritrivelaṃ rasairāsāṃ śatāvaryāśca bhāvayet || 263 || padmakandakaserūṇāṃ rasaiḥ kāśasya bhāvayet | kastūrī vyoṣakarpūrakaṅkolailālavaṅgakam || 264 || pūrvacūrṇādaṣṭamāṃśametaccūrṇaṃ vimiśrayet | sarvai: samāṃ śarkarāṃ ca dattvā śāṇonmitāṃ pibet ||265 || godugdhadvipalenaiva madhurāhārasevakaḥ | asya prabhāvātsaundaryaṃ balaṃ tejo'bhivardhate ||266|| taruṇī ramayedvahvīḥ śukrahānirna jāyate | Dī. atha madanakāmadevarasamāha - tāramityādi | tāraṃ raupyaṃ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ, tadabhāve vaikrāntaṃ grāhyamiti vyavahārāt | sūtakaḥ pāradaḥ lohaṃ sārasaṃjñam | atra kramavṛddhistu pūrvadravyāduttaravṛddhirboddhavyā, asmatsampradāye tu rajatādīni dravyāṇi atra mṛtāni deyānīti vyavahāro'pi dṛśyate | kanyakā kaumārī | vimudrāmiti kācakupīmiti śeṣaḥ | saindhavacūrṇaṃ ca kācakupīmubhayato deyam | siddharasasyabhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - arkadugdhamarkabhavaṃ kṣīraṃ, kālolī prasiddhā, vānarī kapikacchūḥ, muśalī kandaviśeṣaḥ, ikṣukaḥ kokilākṣaḥ tālamūlī, padmakandaḥ kamalakandaḥ kaseruko'pi vikhyātaḥ kāśatṛṇasaṃjñaḥ prasiddhaḥ | paścāccūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - kastūrītyādi | kastūrī mṛganābhijā, vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukaṃ, pūrvacūrṇādbhāvanābhiḥ pratipāditadravyādaṣṭamāṃśaṃ dadyāt | tena pūrvacūrṇaṃ saptabhāgaṃ kastūrīpramukhaṃ caikabhāgamiti ||259-266 || Gū. tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ vajraṃ hīrakam abhrakaṃ vā, suvarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, gandhakaṃ, sūtakaṃ śuddhaṃ, tīkṣṇam etāni kramavṛddhāni tāraṃ bhāgaikaṃ, vajraṃ dvibhāgaṃ, suvarṇaṃ tribhāgaṃ, tāmraṃ caturbhāgaṃ, sūtaṃ saptabhāgaṃ, lohamaṣṭabhāgam evam arkadugdhairmardya kācakupyāṃ vālukāyantre pācayet | tato'śvagandhādibhirmardya bhakṣayet | arkadugdhaṃ yadyapi bhāvanādravye likhitaṃ tathāpi kumāryā sahaiva deyam arkadugdhasya bhakṣaṇānucitatvāt | vānarī kapikacchūḥ, muśalī, ikṣurā tālamūlī, spaṣṭamanyat || 259-266 || vājīkaraṇe kandarpasundararasamāha - sūto vajramahirmuktā tāraṃ hemāsitābhrakam ||267|| rasaiḥ karṣāṃśakānetānmardayedirimedajaiḥ | pravālacūrṇaṃ gandhaṃ ca dvidvikarṣaṃ vimiśrayet ||268|| tato'śvagandhāsvarasairvimardya mṛgaśṛṅgake | kṣiptvā mṛdupuṭe paktvā bhāvayeddhātakrīrasaiḥ ||269|| kākolī madhukaṃ māṃsī balātrayabiseṅgude | drākṣāpippalavandākaṃ varī parṇīcatuṣṭayam || 270 || parūṣakaṃ kaseruśca madhūkaṃ vānarī tathā | bhāvayitvā rasaireṣāṃ śoṣayitvā vicūrṇayet||271|| elātvakpatrakaṃ vāṃśī lavaṅgāgarukeśaram | mustaṃ mṛgamadaḥ kṛṣṇā jalaṃ candraśca miśrayet ||272|| etaccūrṇaiḥ śāṇamitai rasaṃ kandarpasundaram | khādecchāṇamitaṃ rātrau sitā dhātrī vidārikā ||273|| etāsāṃ karṣacūrṇena sarpiṣkarṣeṇa saṃyutam | tasyānu dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibetsusthitamānasaḥ ||274|| ramaṇī ramayedbahvīrna hāniṃ kvāpi gacchati | Dī. sūta ityādi | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, vajraṃ hīrakam, ahiḥ sīsakaṃ, muktā prasiddhā, tāraṃ raupyaṃ, hema suvarṇam, asitābhrakaṃ kṛṣṇābhrakam etatsarvamapi māritaṃ grāhyamityatra vyavahāraḥ | eteṣāṃ mānamapi karṣapramāṇaṃ pratyekam | irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ, sa ca loke ‘reoja’ śabdavācya tasya tvak grāhyā | aparadravyadvayamapi melanārthaṃ dvidvikarṣaṃ pratyekaṃ deyam | tacca pravālacūrṇaṃ vidrumacūrṇaṃ, gandhaṃ gandhakaṃ, mṛgaśṛṅgake mṛgaśṛṅgasampuṭe tadauṣadhaṃ dhāryamityabhiprāyaḥ | mṛdusampuṭaṃ ca laghugajapuṭamityarthaḥ | paścādbhāvanārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - dhātakī dhātakīkusumāni, kākolī svanāmakhyātā, madhukaṃ madhukayaṣṭī, māṃsī jaṭākhyaṃ sugandhadravyam | balātrayaṃ prasiddham tacca balā atibalā nāgabaleti, bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ, bhasīṇḍaśavdavācyaṃ loke, iṅgudaṃ vṛkṣeṅgudaṃ, drākṣā prasiddhā, pippalavandākamiti pippalavṛkṣasya vandā, vandā ca viṭapalagno gulmaviśeṣaḥ, eke pippalavandākaṃ dravyadvayaṃ varṇayanti tatra pippalaḥ pippalatvak vandāvṛkṣaḥ vandā prasiddhā apare pippalīvandākamiti vyākhyānayanti, vāṇaḥ sahacaraḥ eke vāṇasthāne varīti paṭhanti, parṇīcatuṣṭayamiti | māṣaparṇī mudgaparṇī, śālaparṇī, pṛṣṭhiparṇī, ceti, parūṣakaṃ phālasāśabdavācyaṃ kaserukaṃ prasiddham | madhūkaṃ bhadhūkavṛkṣapuṣpāṇi, vānarī kapikacchūḥ, eteṣāṃ svarasena pratyekaṃ bhāvayedityarthaḥ | atha cūrṇārthaṃ dravyāṇyāha - elātvakpatrakamityādi | vāṃśī tvakkṣīrī vaṃśarocanā iti prasiddhā, agaru prasiddham, keśaraṃ nāgakeśaraṃ, mustaṃ prasiddham, mṛgamadaḥ kastūrī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, jalaṃ vālakaṃ, candraḥ karpūraḥ etatsakalaṃ śāṇamitaṃ ṭaṅkapramāṇaṃ bhakṣaṇārthaṃ rātrau niśāmukhe | anupānamāha - dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet, kathambhūtam ? sitādīnāṃ dravyatrayāṇāṃ cūrṇaṃ melayitvā karṣamātraṃ saṃgṛhya karṣamānena ca ghṛtena saha saṃmardya tanmiśritam | sitā matsyaṇḍī, dhātrī āmalakī, vidārī vidārīkandaḥ, sukhitamānasaḥ svasthaḥ, na tu āturaḥ, tasya vihitatvāt na hāniṃ kvāpi gacchatīti sa puruṣaḥ | vīryahāniṃ na prāpnoti ityarthaḥ || 267-274 || Gū. atha kandarpasundaro rasaḥ | sūtaḥ pāradaḥ, vajraṃ hīrakaṃ vā abhrakam, ahiḥ sīsakaḥ, muktā prasiddhā, tāraṃ raupyaṃ, mṛtaṃ hema svarṇaṃ mṛtaṃ, sitābhrakaṃ, śvetābhrakaṃ māritam, etān karṣāṃśikān pratyekān irimedo viṭkhadiraḥ tena mardayet | pravālo vidrumaḥ dvikarṣo gandhako dvikarṣaḥ | aśvagandhāsvarasairmardyaḥ, mṛgaśṛṅgake kṛtvā mṛdupuṭe pacet | tato dhātakīrasairbhāvayet| parūṣakaphalaviśeṣaḥ kaseruḥ prasiddhaḥ, madhūkaṃ guḍapuṣpaḥ, vānarī kapikacchūḥ eṣāṃ rasairbhāvayitvā śoṣayitvā vicūrṇayet | elādikaiḥ pratyekaṃ śāṇamitairmiśrayet | punaḥ kandarpasundaraṃ śāṇamitaṃ rātrau, sitā dhātrī vidārikā eteṣāṃ karṣacūrṇena yutaṃ sarpiḥ karṣeṇa saṃyutaṃ khādet | tasyānu dvipalaṃ kṣīraṃ pibet | susthiramānasaḥ ramaṇī ramayet | elā kṣudrailā, patraṃ patrajaṃ, vāṃśī rocanā, lavaṅgam, agaru, kesaraṃ mustaṃ, mṛgamadaṃ kastūrī, kṛṣṇā pippalī, jalaṃ vālakaṃ, candraḥ karpūraḥ, sitā prasiddhā, dhātrī āmalakī, vidārīkandaṃ, sarpirghṛtaṃ, spaṣṭamanyat || 267-274 || atha loharasāyanam - śuddhaṃ rasendraṃ bhāgaikaṃ dvibhāgaṃ śuddhagandhakam ||275|| kṣipetkajjalikāṃ kuryāttatra tīkṣṇabhavaṃ rajaḥ | kṣiptvā kajjalikātulyaṃ praharaikaṃ vimardayet ||276|| tataḥ kanyādravairgharme tridinaṃ parimardayet | tataḥ saṃjāyate tasya soṣṇo dhūmodgamo mahān ||277|| atyantaṃ piṇḍitaṃ kṛtvā tāmrapātre nidhāpayet | madhye dhānyakuśūlasya tridinaṃ dhārayedbudhaḥ || 278 || uddhṛtya tasmātkhalve ca kṣiptvā gharme nidhāya ca | rasaiḥ kuṭhāracchinnāyāstrivelaṃ paribhāvayet || 279 || saṃśoṣya gharme kvāthaiśca bhāvayettrikaṭostridhā | vāsāmṛtācitrakāṇārasairbhāvyaṃ kramāttridhā ||280|| lohapātre tataḥ kṣiptvā bhāvayettriphalājalaiḥ | nirguṇḍīdāḍimatvagbhirbisabhṛṅgakuraṇṭakaiḥ || 281 || palāśakadalīdrāvairbījakasya śṛtena ca | nīlikālambuṣādrāvairbabbūlaphalikārasaiḥ || 282 || bhāvayettritrivelaṃ ca tato nāgabalārasaiḥ | śatāvarīgokṣurubhiḥ pātālagaruḍīdravaiḥ || 283 || tritrivelaṃ yathālābhaṃ bhāvayedebhirauṣadhaiḥ | tataḥ prātarlihetkṣaudraghṛtābhyāṃ kolamātrakam||284|| palamātraṃ varākvāthaṃ pibedasyānupānakam| māsatrayaṃ śīlitaṃ syādvalīpalitanāśanam ||285|| mandāgniṃ śvāsakāsau ca pāṇḍutāṃ kaphamārutau | pippalīmadhusaṃyuktaṃ hanyādetanna saṃśayaḥ ||286 || vātāsraṃ mūtradoṣāṃśca grahaṇīṃ gudajāṃ rujam | aṇḍavṛddhiṃ jayedetacchinnāsattvamadhuplutam || 287 || balavarṇakaraṃ vṛṣyamāyuṣyaṃ paramaṃ smṛtam | jayetsarvāmayānkālādidaṃ loharasāyanam || 288 || kūṣmāṇḍaṃ tilatailaṃ ca māṣānnaṃ rājikāṃ tathā | madyamamlarasaṃ caiva tyajellohasya sevakaḥ ||289|| Dī. atha loharasāyanamāha - śuddhaṃ rasendrabhāgaikam ityādi | śuddhaṃ saṃskāritaṃ, rasendraḥ pāradaḥ tasyaiko bhāgaḥ, śuddhagandhakasya dvau bhāgau, gandhakaśuddhiśca pūrvaṃ kathitaiva | tatra kajjalikāyāṃ tīkṣṇabhavaṃ raja iti | lohacūrṇaṃ śuddhaṃ mṛtasāracūrṇam ityeke | tacca pūrvakajjalikāsāmyaṃ grāhyam | praharaikaṃ mardanaṃ kevalaṃ kajjalikā lohacūrṇayoreva kathitaṃ na tu svarasādinā, vakṣyamāṇasvarasaireva tridinaṃ yāvadityabhiprāyaḥ | gharma iti kharatarasūryāṃśutāpite ata eva tasya soṣṇo mahān dhūmodgamo bhavati iti | tenaivaṃ lohamṛtiḥ syādityeke | svamate tu dhānyakuśūloṣitaṃ trirātraṃ yāvadbhavati paścād yaduddharet tatkālameva gharme dhāraṇena mṛtiḥ syāt | atyantapiṇḍitamityanena eraṇḍapatraveṣṭanādikamabhipretam | paścātkāryamāha - rasairityādi | kuṭhāracchinnā loke tipānīśabdavācyā | kurejā ityapare | trivelamityanenāparadravyāṇāmapi saṃbandhaḥ | tenaikaikarasena trivelaṃ bhāvayedityarthaḥ | gharme ca pratyekaṃ śoṣaṇamapi vihitam | trikaṭoḥ tryūṣaṇasya ‘śuṇṭhīmaricapippalyastrikaṭusttryūṣaṇaṃ smṛtam’ iti | vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ, amṛtā guḍūcī | lohapātre tat kṣiptveti pūrvaṃ mṛtpātre dhāryamiti prāptam | pāṣāṇakhalve vā triphalājalaiḥ triphalākvāthaiḥ triphalāharītakyādi dāḍimatvak valkalaṃ, vāsā āṭarūṣakaḥ bhṛṅgo mārkavaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ sahacaraḥ, palāśakadalīdrāvairiti palāśaḥ prasiddhaḥ, tasya drāvaḥ svaniryāsaḥ, kadalīdrāvaḥ kadalīkandaniryāsaḥ, vījako vijayasāro vṛkṣaviśeṣastasya śṛtena kvāthena, nīlikā nīlī, alambuṣā muṇḍī, babbūlaphalikā babbūlavṛkṣasya phalānītyarthaḥ, nāgabalā gāṅgerukī, śatāvarī, gokṣurakau prasiddhau, pātālagaruḍī chirahaṇṭiśabdavācyā | anupāne varākvāthaṃ triphalākvātham, chinnāsatvaṃ guḍūcīsatvaṃ | śeṣaṃ subodham ||275-289|| Gū. śuddhaṃ rasendraṃ bhāgaikaṃ, dvibhāgaṃ gandhakaṃ śuddhaṃ tayoḥ kajjalikāṃ kṛtvā tatra tīkṣṇabhavaṃ cūrṇaṃ sarvatulyaṃ kanyādrāvairmardayet, tato golakaṃ kṛtvā eraṇḍapatrairveṣṭayitvā tāmrasampuṭe dhānyarāśau sthāpayet tataḥ kuṭhāra- chinnādyairbhāvayet | kuṭhārachinnā, bisaṃ mṛṇālaṃ, bhṛṅgo bhṛṅgarājaḥ, kuraṇṭakaḥ pītavāsā, nīlikā aparājitā, alambuṣā muṇḍī, varī śatāvarī || 275-289 || jaipālaśodhanam - (jaipālaṃ rahitaṃ tvagaṅkurarasajñābhirmale māhiṣe nikṣiptaṃ tryahamuṣṇatoyavimalaṃ khalve savāso'rditam liptaṃ nūtanakharpareṣu vigatasnehaṃ rajaḥsaṃnibhaṃ nimbūkāmbuvibhāvitaṃ ca bahuśaḥ śuddhaṃ guṇāḍhyaṃ bhavet ||290|| viṣaśodhanam | viṣaṃ tu khaṇḍaśa: kṛtvā vastrakhaṇḍena bandhayet | gomūtramadhye nikṣipya sthāpayedātape tryaham ||291|| gomūtraṃ ca pradātavyaṃ nūtanaṃ pratyahaṃ budhaiḥ | tryahe'tīte samuddhṛtya śoṣayenmṛdu peṣayet ||292|| śuddhyatyevaṃ viṣaṃ tacca yogyaṃ bhavati cārtijit | khaṇḍīkṛtya viṣaṃ vastraparibaddhaṃ tu dolayā || 293 || ajāpayasi saṃsvinnaṃ yāmataḥ śuddhimāpnuyāt | ajādugdhābhāvatastu gavyakṣīreṇa śodhayet ||294|| ) iti śrīdāmodarasūnunā śārṅgadharācāryeṇa viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharasaṃhitāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe rasakalpanā nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ | samāpto'yaṃ madhyamakhaṇḍaḥ || Dī. vividhamuninibandhā ye mahatsu prasiddhāḥ sumatiduravabodhāste mayā naiva dṛṣṭāḥ | tadapi gurusakāśādyacchrutaṃ tadvyalekhi hyaḍhamalabhiṣajā'syāṃ bhāvasiṃhātmajena || iti śrīvāstavyānvayaprakāśavaidyaśrībhāvasiṃhātmajenāḍhamallena viracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharadīpikāyāṃ madhyamakhaṇḍe saṃsiddharasādhyāyo dvādaśaḥ || 12 || Gū. iti śrīkāśīrāmavaidyaviracitāyāṃ śārṅgadharagūḍhārthadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne rasakarma nāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||
